Berakhot 34b:18-26: Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim kullan lo nitnabbeu ella lammassi bitto letalmid chacham, velaose perakmatya letalmid chacham, velamhanne talmid chacham minnechasav. aval talmide chachamim atzman — "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo".
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim kullan lo nitnabbeu ella limot hammashiach, aval leolam habba, "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha".
Ufeliga dishmuel, deamar shemuel: en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchuyot bilvad. shenneemar: "ki lo yechdal evyon mikkerev haaretz".
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim kullan lo nitnabbeu ella levaale teshuva, aval tzaddikim gemurim "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha".
Ufeliga derabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu: makom shebbaale teshuva omdin — tzaddikim gemurim enam omdin, shenneemar: "shalom shalom larachok velakkarov". "larachok" beresha, vahadar "lakkarov".
Verabbi yochanan amar lecha: may "rachok" — shehaya rachok middevar avera meikkara. umay "karov" — shehaya karov lidvar avera, venitrachek mimmennu hasheta.
May "ayin lo raata"? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ze yayin hameshummar baanavav mishsheshet yeme bereshit. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ze eden, shello shalta bo en kol beriyya.
Shemma tomar: adam harishon hechan haya? baggan.
Veshemma tomar: hu gan, hu eden, talmud lomar: "venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan", gan lechud veeden lechud.
Chullin 138a:3-13: Vechamma noten lo kulei. tana – lo sheyyelabbenennu veyittenennu lo, ella sheyyelabbenennu kohen veyaamod al chamesh selaim.
Kede laasot beged katan. menahane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: amar kera "laamod lesharet" – davar shehu rauy lesherut. may nihu? avnet.
Ema meil! tafasta merubbe – lo tafasta, tafasta muat – tafasta.
Veema kippa shel tzemer, detanya: kippa shel tzemer hayta munnachat berosh kohen gadol, vealeha tzitz natun, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "vesamta oto al petil techelet".
Amar kera "hu uvanav", davar hashshave leaharon ulevanav.
Avnet name la shave. hanicha leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol lo zehu avneto shel kohen hedyot – shappir.
Ella leman deamar zehu avneto shel kohen hedyot, may ikka lememar? shem avnet baolam.
Lo hispik litteno vechulei. ittemar: gazaz umachar rishona, rav chisda amar: chayyayv, rabbi natan bar hoshaya amar: patur.
Rav chisda amar chayyayv, deha gazaz. rabbi natan bar hoshaya amar patur, beiddana deka male shiura baenan "tzoncha", velekka.
Tenan: hallokeach gez tzono shel goy, patur mereshit haggez. ha tzono ligzoz – chayyayv. ammay? kol chad vechad batar gizza nafka la mershuteh!
Targema rav chisda allibba derabbi natan bar hoshaya: kegon shehiknan lo kol sheloshim yom.
Gittin 59b:6-17: Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav matna, deamar kera: "vayyichtov moshe et hattora hazzot vayyittenah el hakkohanim bene levi" – attu ana la yadana dechohanim, bene levi ninhu? ella kohen beresha, vahadar levi.
Rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar, mehacha: "veniggeshu hakkohanim bene levi" – attu anan la yadinan dechohanim, bene levi ninhu? ella kohen beresha, vahadar levi.
Rav ashe amar mehacha: "bene amram aharon umoshe, vayyibbadel aharon lehakedisho kodesh kodashim".

Rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar mehacha: "vekiddashto" – lechol davar shebbikdushsha. tana deve rabbi yishmael: "vekiddashto" – lechol davar shebbikdushsha; liftoach rishon, ulevarech rishon, velittol mana yafa rishon.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mippene darche shalom?! deorayyta hi! amar leh: deorayyta, umippene darche shalom.
Kol hattora kullah name mippene darche shalom hi, dichtiv: "deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom"!

Ella amar abbaye: lechidmar; detanya: shenayim – mamtinin ze laze bakkeara. shelosha – en mamtinin. habbotzea – hu poshet yado techilla, veim ba lachlok kavod lerabbo o lemi sheggadol mimmennu – harshut beyado.
Veamar mar ala: lo shanu ella bisuda, aval bevet hakkeneset lo, deatu leinnetzoye.
Amar rav matna: ha deamrat bevet hakkeneset lo, la amaran ella beshabbatot veyamim tovim – dishchichi rabbim, aval besheni uvachamishi – la.
Ini?! veha rav huna kare bechahane beshabbatot veyom tov! shane rav huna, daafillu rabbi amme verabbi assi – kahane chashivi deeretz yisrael – mechaf havo kayyfi leh.
Amar abbaye, naktinan: en sham kohen – nitparda chavila. veamar abbaye, naktinan: en sham levi – kore kohen.
Ini?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: kohen achar kohen lo yikra, mishshum pegamo shel rishon. levi achar levi lo yikra mishshum pegam shenehem! ki kaamrinan, beoto kohen.
I Samuel 11:14-12:4: Vayyomer shemuel el-haam lechu venelcha haggilgal unechaddesh sham hammelucha
Vayyelchu chol-haam haggilgal vayyamlichu sham et-shaul lifne Adonai baggilgal vayyizbechu-sham zevachim shelamim lifne Adonai vayyismach sham shaul vechol-anshe yisrael ad-meod {p}
Vayyomer shemuel el-kol-yisrael hinne shamati vekolchem lechol asher-amartem li vaamlich alechem melech
Veatta hinne hammelech ׀ mithallech lifnechem vaani zakanti vasavti uvanay hinnam ittechem vaani hithallachti lifnechem minneuray ad-hayyom hazze
Hinni anu vi neged Adonai veneged meshicho et-shor <small>׀</small> mi lakachti vachamor mi lakachti veet-mi ashakti et-mi ratztzoti umiyyad-mi lakachti chofer vealim enay bo veashiv lachem
Vayyomru lo ashaktanu velo ratztzotanu velo-lakachta miyyad-ish meuma
I Samuel 12:14-19: Im-tiru et-Adonai vaavadtem oto ushematem bekolo velo tamru et-pi Adonai vihyitem gam-attem vegam-hammelech asher malach alechem achar Adonai elohechem
Veim-lo tishmeu bekol Adonai umeritem et-pi Adonai vehayta yad-Adonai bachem uvaavotechem
Gam-atta hityatztzevu ureu et-haddavar haggadol hazze asher Adonai ose leenechem
Halo ketzir-chittim hayyom ekra el-Adonai veyitten kolot umatar udeu ureu ki-raatchem rabba asher asitem beene Adonai lishol lachem melech {s}
Vayyikra shemuel el-Adonai vayyitten Adonai kolot umatar bayyom hahu vayyira chol-haam meod et-Adonai veet-shemuel
Vayyomru chol-haam el-shemuel hitpallel bead-avadecha el-Adonai elohecha veal-namut ki-yasafnu al-kol-chattotenu raa lishol lanu melech
I Samuel 12:20-24: Vayyomer shemuel el-haam al-tirau attem asitem et kol-haraa hazzot ach al-tasuru meachare Adonai vaavadtem et-Adonai bechol-levavchem
Velo tasuru ki ׀ achare hattohu asher lo-yoilu velo yatztzilu ki-tohu hemma
Ki lo-yittosh Adonai et-ammo baavur shemo haggadol ki hoil Adonai laasot etchem lo leam
Gam anochi chalila li mechato laAdonai mechadol lehitpallel baadchem vehoreti etchem bederech hattova vehayeshara
Ach ׀ yerou et-Adonai vaavadtem oto beemet bechol-levavchem ki reu et asher-higdil immachem
I Samuel 12:5-8: Vayyomer alehem ed Adonai bachem veed meshicho hayyom hazze ki lo metzatem beyadi meuma vayyomer ed {p}
Vayyomer shemuel el-haam Adonai asher asa et-moshe veet-aharon vaasher heela et-avotechem meeretz mitzrayim
Veatta hityatztzevu veishshafta ittechem lifne Adonai et kol-tzidkot Adonai asher-asa ittechem veet-avotechem
Kaasher-ba yaakov mitzrayim vayyizaku avotechem el-Adonai vayyishlach Adonai et-moshe veet-aharon vayyotziu et-avotechem mimmitzrayim vayyoshivum bammakom hazze
I Samuel 12:9-13: Vayyishkechu et-Adonai elohehem vayyimkor otam beyad sisra sar-tzeva chatzor uveyad-pelishtim uveyad melech moav vayyillachamu bam
Vayyizaku el-Adonai (vayyomer) [vayyomru] chatanu ki azavnu et-Adonai vannaavod et-habbealim veet-haashtarot veatta hatztzilenu miyyad oyvenu venaavdekka
Vayyishlach Adonai et-yerubbaal veet-bedan veet-yiftach veet-shemuel vayyatztzel etchem miyyad oyvechem missaviv vatteshvu betach
Vattiru ki-nachash melech bene-ammon ba alechem vattomru li lo ki-melech yimloch alenu vaAdonai elohechem malkechem
Veatta hinne hammelech asher bechartem asher sheeltem vehinne natan Adonai alechem melech
Mishnah Eduyot 1:13-2:2: Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad, divre vet hillel. amru lahem bet shammay, tikkantem et rabbo, veet atzmo lo tikkantem. lissa shifcha, eno yachol. bat chorin, eno yachol. libbatel, vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya ureviyya, shenneemar (yeshaya ma), lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah. ella, mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ven chorin vechotev shetar al chatzi damav. chazru vet hillel lehorot kevet shammay:

Keli cheres matztzil al hakkol, kedivre vet hillel. uvet shammay omrim, eno matztzil ella al hoochalin veal hammashkin veal kele chares. amru lahem bet hillel, mippene ma. amru lahem bet shammay, mippene shehu tame al gav am haaretz, veen keli tame chotzetz. amru lahem bet hillel, vahalo tihartem ochalim umashkin shebbetocho. amru lahem bet shammay, keshettiharnu ochalim umashkin shebbetocho, leatzmo tiharnu. aval keshettiharta et hakkeli, tiharta lecha valo. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:

Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim heid arbaa devarim. mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millisrof et habbasar shennitma bivlad hattuma im habbasar shennitma beav hattuma, af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato. hosif rabbi akiva, mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millehadlik et hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom bener shennitma vitme met, af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato:

Amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim, miyyamay lo raiti or yotze levet hasserefa. amar rabbi akiva, middevarav lamadnu, shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa, sheyyeotu hakkohanim beoro. vachachamim omrim, lo rainu eno reaya, ella yotze levet hasserefa:
Mishnah Eduyot 1:8-12:
Karshine teruma, bet shammay omrim, shorin veshafin betohora, umaachilin betuma. bet hillel omrim, shorin betohora, veshafin umaachilin betuma. shammay omer, yeachlu tzarid. rabbi akiva omer, kol maasehem betuma: 
Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni, bet shammay omrim, bechol hassela maot, uvet hillel omrim, beshekel kesef uveshekel maot. rabbi meir omer, en mechallelin kesef uferot al hakkesef. vachachamim mattirin: 
Happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim, bet shammay omrim, bechol hassela maot, uvet hillel omrim, beshekel kesef uveshekel maot. haddanim lifne chachamim omrim, bishlosha dinarim kesef uvedinar maot. rabbi akiva omer, bishlosha dinarim kesef uvirviit kesef birviit maot. verabbi tarfon omer, arbaa aspere chasef. shammay omer, yannichenna vachanut veyochal kenegdah: 
Kisse shel kalla shennittelu chippuyav, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin. shammay omer, af malben shel kisse tame. kisse shekkevao vaareva, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin. shammay omer, af heasuy bah: 
Ellu devarim shechazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay. haishsha shebbaa mimmedinat hayyam veamra met bali, tinnase. met bali, tityabbem. uvet hillel omrim, lo shamanu ella bevaa min hakkatzir bilvad. amru lahem bet shammay, achat habbaa min hakkatzir veachat habbaa min hazzetim veachat habbaa mimmedinat hayyam, lo dibberu vakkatzir ella vahove. chazru vet hillel lehorot kevet shammay. bet shammay omrim, tinnase vetittol ketubbatah. uvet hillel omrim, tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah. amru lahem bet shammay, hittartem et haerva hachamura, lo tattiru et hammamon hakkal. amru lahem bet hillel, matzinu sheen haachim nichnasin lannachala al piha. amru lahem bet shammay, vahalo missefer ketubbatah nilmod, shehu chotev lah, sheim tinnasi leacher, titteli ma shekkatuv lich. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
Mishnah Eduyot 2:3-6: Af hu heid al kefar katan shehaya vetzad yerushalayim, vehaya vo zaken echad vehaya malve lechol bene hakkefar vechotev bichtav yado vaacherim chotmim, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiru. lefi darkecha atta lamed, shehaishsha kotevet et gittah vehaish kotev et shovro, sheen kiyyum hagget ella vechotmav. veal machat shennimtzet babbasar, shehassakkin vehayyadayim tehorot, vehabbasar tame. veim nimtzet bapperesh, hakkol tahor:

Shelosha devarim amar rabbi yishmael lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne. al betza terufa shehi netuna al gabbe yarak shel teruma, shehi chibbur. veim hayta chemin kova, enah chibbur. veal shibbolet shebbakkatzir veroshah maggia lakkama, im niktzera im hakkama, hare hi shel baal habbayit, veim lav, hare hi shel aniyyim. veal ginna ketanna shehi mukkefet aris, im yesh bah kimlo votzer vesallo mikkan umelo votzer vesallo mikkan, tizzarea. veim lav, lo tizzarea:

Shelosha devarim amru lifne rabbi yishmael, velo amar bahem lo issur vehetter, ufershan rabbi yehoshua ben matya. hammefis mursa beshabbat, im laasot lah pe, chayyav, veim lehotzi mimmenna lecha, patur. veal hatztzad nachash bashshabbat, im mitassek shello yishshechennu, patur, veim lirfua, chayyav. veal lefasin ironiyyot, shehem tehorot beohel hammet utemeot bemassa hazzav. rabbi elazar ben tzadok omer, af bemassa hazzav, tehorot, mippene shello nigmera melachtan:

Shelosha devarim amar rabbi yishmael velo hoda lo rabbi akiva. hashshum vehabboser vehammelilot sherissekan mibbeod yom, sherabbi yishmael omer, yigmor mishshettechshach, verabbi akiva omer, lo yigmor:
Mishnah Eduyot 2:7-3:1: Shelosha devarim amru lifne rabbi akiva, shenayim mishshum rabbi eliezer veechad mishshum rabbi yehoshua. shenayim mishshum rabbi eliezer, yotzet ishsha veir shel zahav, umafriche yonim pesulim leedut. veechad mishshum rabbi yehoshua, hashsheretz befi chulda umehallechet al gabbe chikkarot shel teruma, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tahor:

Shelosha devarim amar rabbi akiva, al shenayim hodu lo veal echad lo hodu lo. al sandal shel sayyadim, shehu tame midras. veal sheyare tannur arbaa, shehayu omrim shelosha. vehodu lo. veal echad lo hodu lo, al kisse shennittelu shenayim mechippuyav ze betzad ze, sherabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin:

Hu haya omer, haav zoche labben, bannoy, uvakkoach, uvaosher, uvachachma, uvashshanim, uvemispar haddorot lefanav, vehu hakketz, shenneemar (yeshaya ma) kore haddorot merosh, af al pi shenneemar (Bereshit 15), vaavadum veinnu otam arba meot shana, veneemar (sham), vedor revii yashuvu henna:

Af hu haya omer, chamishsha devarim shel shenem asar chodesh. mishpat dor hammabbul, shenem asar chodesh. mishpat iyyov, shenem asar chodesh. mishpat hammitzriyyim, shenem asar chodesh. mishpat gog umagog leatid lavo, shenem asar chodesh. mishpat reshaim begehinnom, shenem asar chodesh, shenneemar (yeshaya 66), vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, min happesach vead haatzeret, shenneemar umidde shabbat beshabbatto:

Kol hametammein beohel shennechleku, vehichnisan letoch habbayit, rabbi dosa ben harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammein. ketzad. hannogea bechishne chatzae zetim min hannevela o nosan, uvammet, hannogea bechachatzi zayit umaahil al kachatzi zayit o nogea bechachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav, umaahil al kishne chatzae zetim, maahil al kachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav, rabbi dosa ben harekinas metaher vachachamim metammein. aval hannogea bechachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit, o maahil al kachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit, tahor. amar rabbi meir, af baze rabbi dosa metaher vachachamim metammein. hakkol tame, chutz min hammagga im hammassa, vehammassa im haohel. ze hakkelal, kol shehu mishshem echad, tame. mishshene shemot, tahor:
Mishnah Eduyot 3:2-5:
Ochel parud, eno mitztaref, divre rabbi dosa ben harekinas. vachachamim omrim, mitztaref. mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, en mechallelin. matbilin yadayim lachattat, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, im nitmeu yadav, nitma gufo: 
Mee avattiach ukenivat yarak shel teruma, rabbi dosa mattir lezarim, vachachamim osrin. chamesh rechelot gezuzot mane mane uferas, chayyavot bereshit haggez, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, chamesh rechelot kol shehen: 
Kol hachotzalot temeot teme met, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, midras. kol hakkeliot tehorot, chutz mishshel galgilon, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, kullam temeot, chutz mishshel tzammarim: 
Hakkela shebbet kibbul shellah arug, temea. veshel or, rabbi dosa ben harekinas metaher vachachamim metammein. nifsak bet etzba shellah, tehora. bet happakia shellah, temea:
Mishnah Eduyot 3:6-9:
Hashshevuya ochelet batteruma, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim, yesh shevuya ochelet veyesh shevuya sheenah ochelet. ketzad. haishsha sheamra nishbeti utehora ani, ochelet, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shennishbet, vehi omeret tehora ani, enah ochelet: 
Arbaa sefekot rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharin. ketzad. hattame omed vehattahor over, hattahor omed vehattame over, tuma birshut hayyachid vetohora birshut harabbim, tohora birshut hayyachid vetuma birshut harabbim, safek naga safek lo naga, safek heehil safek lo heehil, safek hesit safek lo hesit, rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharin: 
Shelosha devarim rabbi tzadok metamme, vachachamim metaharin. masmer hashshulchani, vearon shel garosot, umasmer shel even shaot, rabbi tzadok metamme vachachamim metaharin: 
Arbaa devarim rabban gamliel metamme, vachachamim metaharin. kissuy teni shel mattachot shel baale vattim, uteloy hammagredot, vegalme chele mattachot, vetavla shennechleka lishnayim. umodim chachamim lerabban gamliel betavla shennechleka lishnayim, echad gadol veechad katan, haggadol tame vehakkatan tahor:
Mishnah Parah 10:4-11:1:
Hattahor lechattat shennaga betannur, beyado, tame. uveraglo, tahor. haya omed al gabbe tannur ufashat yado chutz lattannur, vehallagin betocho, vechen haesel shehu natun al gabbe hattannur uvo shene kelalot, echad mikkan veechad mikkan, rabbi akiva metaher, vachachamim metammein: 
Haya omed chutz lattannur ufashat yadav lachallon venatal et hallagin veheeviro al gabbe hattannur, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. aval omed hu hattahor lechattat al gabbe tannur uveyado keli rekan hattahor lechattat, uvemayim sheen mekuddashin: 
Lagin shel chattat shennaga beshel kodesh veshel teruma, shel chattat, tame. veshel kodesh veshel teruma, tehorin. shenehen bishte yadav, shenehen temeim. shenehem bishne neyarot, shenehem tehorim. shel chattat binyar veshel teruma beyado, shenehen temein. shel teruma binyar veshel chattat beyado, shenehen tehorin. rabbi yehoshua omer, shel chattat, tame. hayu netunin al gabbe haaretz venaga bahem, shel chattat, tame. shel kodesh veshel teruma, tehorim. hesitan, rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharin: 
Tzelochit shehinnichah megulla, uva umetzaah mechussa, pesula. hinnichah mechussa uva umetzaah megulla, im yechola hachulda lishtot hemenna, o nachash ledivre rabban gamliel, o sheyyarad bah tal ballayla, pesula. hachattat enah nitztzola betzamid patil. umayim sheenan mekuddashin nitztzolin betzamid patil:
Mishnah Parah 11:2-5:
Kol hassefek tahor litruma, tahor lechattat. kol hattaluy litruma, nishpach lechattat. im asu al gabbav tohorot, teluyot. harfafot, tehorot lekodesh velitruma ulechattat. rabbi eliezer omer, haradot, temeot lechattat: 
Devela shel teruma shennafla letoch me chattat unetalah vaachalah, im yesh bah kabbetza, ben temea ben tehora, hammayim temein, vehaochlah chayyav mita. en bah kabbetza, hammayim tehorin, vehaochlah chayyav mita. rabbi yose omer, bithora, hammayim tehorim. hattahor lechattat shehichnis rosho verubbo letoch me chattat, nitma: 
Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre tora, metamme et hakkodesh veet hatteruma veet hachullin veet hammaaser, veasur al biat hammikdash. leachar biato, metamme et hakkodesh, ufosel et hatteruma, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, posel bakkodesh uvatteruma, umuttar bachullin uvammaaser. veim ba el hammikdash, ben lifne viato ben leachar biato, chayyav: 
Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim, metamme et hakkodesh, ufosel et hatteruma, umuttar bachullin uvammaaser, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim osrim bammaaser. leachar biato, muttar bechullan. veim ba el hammikdash, ben lifne viato uven leachar biato, patur:
Mishnah Parah 11:6-9:
Kol hattaun biat mayim, ben middivre tora ben middivre sofrim, metamme et me chattat veet efer chattat veet hammazze me chattat, bemagga uvemassa. haezov hammuchshar, vehammayim sheenan mekuddashim, ucheli rekam hattahor lechattat, bemagga uvemassa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bemagga aval lo vemassa: 
Kol ezov sheyyesh lo shem levay, pasul. ezov ze, kasher. ezov yavan, ezov kochalit, ezov romi, ezov midbari, pasul. veshel teruma temea, pasul. veshel tehora, lo yazze. veim hizza, kasher. en mazzin lo veyonkot, velo vitmarot. en chayyavin al hayyonkot al biat hammikdash. rabbi eliezer omer, af lo al hattemarot. ellu hen hayyonkot, givolin shello gamalu: 
Ezov shehizza vo, kasher letaher bo et hammetzora. likketo leetzim venaflu alav mashkin, menaggevo vehu chasher. likketo leochalin venaflu alav mashkin, af al pi shenniggevo, pasul. likketo lechattat, kimlukkat leochalin, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, kimlukkat leetzim: 
Mitzvat ezov, shelosha kelachim uvahem shelosha givolin. rabbi yehuda omer, shel shelosha shelosha. ezov sheyyesh bo shelosha kelachim, mefassego veogdo. pissego velo agado, agado velo fissego, lo fissego velo agado, kasher. rabbi yose omer, mitzvat ezov, shelosha kelachim, uvahem shelosha givolim, usheyarav shenayim, vegardummav kol shehu:
Mishnah Parah 8:11-9:3:
Beer achav umearat pamyas, keshera. hammayim shennishtannu veshinnuyan mechamat atzman, kesherin. ammat hammayim habbaa merachok, keshera, uvilvad sheyyishmerenna shello yafsikenna adam. rabbi yehuda omer, hare hi vechezkat mutteret. beer shennafal letochah charsit o adama, yamtin lah ad shettitztzal, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, eno tzarich lehametin: 
Tzelochit shennafal letochah mayim kol shehen, rabbi eliezer omer, yazze shete hazzayot. vachachamim poslin. yarad letochah tal, rabbi eliezer omer, yannichenna vachamma vehattal ole. vachachamim poslin. nafal letochah mashkin ume ferot, yeare vetzarich lenaggev. deyo, komos, vekankantom, vechol davar shehu roshem, yeare veeno tzarich lenaggev: 
Nafal letochah shekatzim uremasim venitbakkeu, o shennishtannu marehem, pesulin. chippushit, ben kach uven kach poselet, mippene shehi chishfoferet. rabbi shimon verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim, haddira vehakkinna shebbattevua kesherim, mippene sheen bahem lecha: 
Shatat mehen behema o chayya, pesulin. kol haofot poslin, chutz min hayyona, mippene shehi motzetzet. kol hashsheratzim enam poslin, chutz min hachulda, mippene shehi malleket. rabban gamliel omer, af hannachash, mippene shehi mekia. rabbi eliezer omer, af haachbar:
Mishnah Parah 9:4-7:
Hachoshev al me chattat lishtot, rabbi eliezer omer, pasul. rabbi yehoshua omer, kesheyyatte. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, bemayim sheenam mekuddashim. aval bemayim hamekuddashin, rabbi eliezer omer, kesheyyatte. rabbi yehoshua omer, kesheyyishte. veim girger, kasher: 
Me chattat shennifselu, lo yegabbelem betit, shello yaasem takkala laacherim. rabbi yehuda omer, batlu. para sheshshatat me chattat, besarah tame meet leet. rabbi yehuda omer, batlu vemeeha: 
Me chattat veefer chattat, lo yaavirem benahar uvisfina, velo yeshitem al pene hammayim, velo yaamod betzad ze veyizrekem letzad ze. aval over hu vammayim ad tzavvaro. over hu hattahor lechattat uveyadav keli rekam hattahor lechattat, uvemayim sheenam mekuddashin: 
Efer kasher shennitarev beefer mikle, holchin achar harov letamme, veen mekaddeshin bo. rabbi eliezer omer, mekaddeshin bechullan:
Mishnah Parah 9:8-10:3:
Me chattat shennifselu, metammein et hattahor litruma, veyadav uvegufo. veet hattahor lechattat, lo veyadav velo vegufo. nitmeu, metammeim et hattahor litruma veyadav uvegufo. veet hattahor lechattat, beyadav, aval lo vegufo: 
Efer kasher shennetano al gabbe hammayim sheenan reuyin lekaddesh, metammein et hattahor litruma, beyadav uvegufo. et hattahor lechattat, lo veyadav velo vegufo: 
Kol harauy littamme midras, maddaf lechattat, ben tame ben tahor. veadam, kayyotze vo. kol harauy littamme teme met, ben tame ben tahor, rabbi eliezer omer, eno maddaf. rabbi yehoshua omer, maddaf. vachachamim omrim, hattame, maddaf. vehattahor, eno maddaf: 
Hattahor lechattat shennaga bemaddaf, tame. lagin shel chattat shennaga bemaddaf, tame. hattahor lechattat shennaga beochalim umashkim, beyado, tame. uveraglo, tahor. hesitan beyado, rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharim: 
Kalal shel chattat shennaga besheretz, tahor. netano al gabbav, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammeim. naga beochalim umashkin uvechitve hakkodesh, tahor. netano al gabbehen, rabbi yose metaher, vachachamim metammeim:
Mishnah Pesachim 10:1-4:
Arve fesachim samuch lammincha, lo yochal adam ad shettechshach. vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael lo yochal ad sheyyasev. velo yifchatu lo mearba kosot shel yayin, vaafillu min hattamchuy: 
Mazgu lo chos rishon, bet shammay omrim, mevarech al hayyom, veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. uvet hillel omrim, mevarech al hayyayin, veachar kach mevarech al hayyom: 
Heviu lefanav, metabbel bachazeret, ad shemmaggia lefarperet happat. heviu lefanav matztza vachazeret vacharoset ushene tavshilin, af al pi sheen charoset mitzva. rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer, mitzva. uvammikdash hayu meviim lefanav gufo shel pasach: 
Mazgu lo chos sheni, vechan habben shoel aviv, veim en daat babben, aviv melammedo, ma nishtanna hallayla hazze mikkol hallelot, shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin chametz umatztza, hallayla hazze chullo matztza. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin shear yerakot, hallayla hazze maror. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin basar tzali, shaluk, umevushshal, hallayla hazze chullo tzali. shebbechol hallelot anu matbilin paam achat, hallayla hazze shete feamim. ulefi dato shel ben, aviv melammedo. matchil bignut umesayyem beshevach, vedoresh mearammi oved avi, ad sheyyigmor kol happarasha chullah:
Mishnah Pesachim 10:5-8:
Rabban gamliel haya omer, kol shello amar shelosha devarim ellu befesach, lo yatza yede chovato, veellu hen, pesach, matztza, umaror. pesach, al shum sheppasach hammakom al batte avotenu vemitzrayim. matztza, al shum shennigalu avotenu vemitzrayim. maror, al shum shemmerru hammitzrim et chayye avotenu vemitzrayim. bechol dor vador chayyav adam lirot et atzmo cheillu hu yatza mimmitzrayim, shenneemar (Shemot 13), vehiggadta levincha bayyom hahu lemor, baavur ze asa Adonai li betzeti mimmitzrayim. lefichach anachnu chayyavin lehodot, lehallel, leshabbeach, lefaer, leromem, lehadder, levarech, lealle, ulekalles, lemi sheasa laavotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu, hotzianu meavdut lecherut, miyyagon lesimcha, umeevel leyom tov, umeafela leor gadol, umishshibud ligulla. venomar lefanav, haleluyah: 
Ad hechan hu omer, bet shammay omrim, ad em habbanim semecha. uvet hillel omrim, ad challamish lemayeno mayim. vechotem bigulla. rabbi tarfon omer, asher gealanu vegaal et avotenu mimmitzrayim, velo haya chotem. rabbi akiva omer, ken Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu yaggienu lemoadim velirgalim acherim habbaim likratenu leshalom, semechim bevinyan irecha vesasim baavodatecha, venochal sham min hazzevachim umin happesachim kulei, ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael: 
Mazgu lo chos shelishi, mevarech al mezono. revii, gomer alav et hahallel, veomer alav birkat hashshir. ben hakkosot hallalu, im rotze lishtot, yishte. ben shelishi larvii, lo yishte: 
Veen maftirin achar happesach afikoman. yashnu miktzatan, yochlu. kullan, lo yochelu. rabbi yose omer, nitnamnemu, yochlu. nirdemu, lo yochelu:
Mishnah Pesachim 10:9: Happesach achar chatzot, metamme et hayyadayim. happiggul vehannotar, metammein et hayyadayim. berach birkat happesach patar et shel zevach. berach et shel zevach, lo fatar et shel pesach, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, lo zo foteret zo, velo zo foteret zo:
Mishnah Pesachim 8:7-9:2:
En shochatin et happesach al hayyachid, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose mattir. afillu chavura shel mea sheen yecholin leechol kazzayit, en shochatin alehen. veen osin chavurat nashim vaavadim uketannim: 
Onen tovel veochel et pischo laerev, aval lo vakkadashim. hashshomea al meto, vehamelakket lo atzamot, tovel veochel bakkadashim. ger shennitgayyer beerev pesach, bet shammay omrim, tovel veochel et pischo laerev. uvet hillel omrim, happoresh min haarla keforesh min hakkaver: 
Mi shehaya tame o vederech rechoka velo asa et harishon, yaase et hashsheni. shagag o neenas velo asa et harishon, yaase et hashsheni. im ken, lamma neemar tame o shehaya vederech rechoka, sheellu peturin mehikkaret, veellu chayyavin behikkaret: 
Ezo hi derech rechoka, min hammodiim velachutz, uchemiddatah lechol ruach, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, measkuppat haazara velachutz. amar rabbi yose, lefichach nakud al Adonai, lomar, lo mippene sherchoka vadday, ella meiskuppat haazara velachutz:
Mishnah Pesachim 9:3-7:
Ma ben pesach rishon lashsheni, harishon asur beval yerae uval yimmatze, vehashsheni, matztza vechametz immo babbayit. harishon taun hallel baachilato, vehashsheni eno taun hallel baachilato. ze vaze taun hallel baasiyyatan, veneechalin tzali al matztzot umerorim, vedochin et hashshabbat: 
Happesach shebba vetuma, lo yochlu mimmennu zavin vezavot niddot veyoldot. veim achlu, peturim mikkaret. rabbi eliezer poter af al biat mikdash: 
Ma ben pesach mitzrayim lefesach dorot, pesach mitzrayim mikkacho mibbeasor, vetaun hazzaa vaaguddat ezov al hammashkof veal shete mezuzot, veneechol bechippazon belayla echad, ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva: 
Amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati shettemurat happesach kereva, utemurat happesach enah kereva, veen li lefaresh. amar rabbi akiva, ani afaresh. happesach shennimtza kodem shechitat happesach, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyikkach bedamav shelamim, vechen temurato. achar shechitat happesach, karev shelamim, vechen temurato: 
Hammafrish nekeva lefischo o zachar ben shete shanim, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. hammafrish pischo vamet, lo yeviennu veno acharav leshem pesach, ella leshem shelamim:
Mishnah Pesachim 9:8-11:
Happesach shennitarev bizvachim, kullan yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, veyafsid hammotar mibbeto. nitarev bivchorot, rabbi shimon omer, im chavurat kohanim, yochelu: 
Chavura sheavad pischah, veamra leechad, tze uvakkesh ushechot alenu, vehalach umatza veshachat, vehem lakchu veshachatu, im shello nishchat rishon, hu ochel mishshello, vehem ochlim immo mishshello, veim shellahen nishchat rishon, hem ochlin mishshellahen, vehu ochel mishshello. veim eno yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon, o sheshshachatu shenehen keechad, hu ochel mishshello, vehem enam ochlim immo, veshellahen yetze levet hasserefa, ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni. amar lahen, im echarti, tzeu veshachatu alay. halach umetzao, veshachat, vehen lakchu veshachatu, im shellahen nishchat rishon, hen ochlin mishshellahen, vehu ochel immahen. veim shello nishchat rishon, hu ochel mishshello, vehen ochlin mishshellahen. veim eno yadua eze mehem nishchat rishon, o sheshshachatu shenehem keechad, hen ochlin mishshellahen, vehu eno ochel immahen, veshello yetze levet hasserefa, ufatur millaasot pesach sheni. amar lahen veamru lo, ochlin kullam min harishon. veim en yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon, shenehem yotzin levet hasserefa. lo amar lahen velo amru lo, enan acharain ze laze: 
Shete chavurot shennitarvu fischehen, ellu moshchin lahen echad veellu moshchin lahen echad, echad meellu va lo etzel ellu, veechad meellu va lo etzel ellu, vechach hem omrim, im shellanu hu happesach hazze, yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shellanu, veim shellecha hu happesach hazze, yadenu meshuchot mishshellanu venimnenu al shellach. vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha, veshel asara asara, moshchin lahen echad mikkol chavura vachavura, vechen hem omrim: 
Shenayim shennitarvu fischehem, ze moshech lo echad, veze moshech lo echad, ze mamne immo echad min hashshuk, veze mamne immo echad min hashshuk, ze va etzel ze, veze va etzel ze, vechach hem omrim, im shelli hu fesach ze, yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shelli. veim shellecha hu fesach ze, yaday meshuchot mishshelli venimneti al shellacha:
Mishnah Shekalim 1:1-4:
Beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim veal hakkilayim. bachamishsha asar bo korin et hammegilla bakkerakkin, umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet mikveot hammayim, veosin kol tzarche harabbim, umetzayyenin et hakkevarot, veyotzin af al hakkilayim: 
Amar rabbi yehuda, barishona hayu okrin umashlichin lifnehem. mishsherabbu ovre avera, hayu okrin umashlichin al hadderachim, hitkinu sheyyehu mafkirin kol hassade kullah: 
Bachamishsha asar bo, shulchanot hayu yoshvin bammedina. beesrim vachamishsha, yashvu bammikdash. mishsheyyashvu bammikdash, hitchilu lemashken. et mi memashkenin, leviyyim veyisreelim, gerim vaavadim meshuchrarim, aval lo nashim vaavadim uketannim. kol katan shehitchil aviv lishkol al yado, shuv eno posek. veen memashkenin et hakkohanim mippene darke shalom: 
Amar rabbi yehuda, heid ben bucheri beyavne, kol kohen sheshshokel eno chote. amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay, lo ki, ella kol kohen sheeno shokel chote, ella shehakkohanim dorshim mikra ze leatzman, (Vayikra 6) vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel, hoil veomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim shellanu, heach neechalim:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Mi shehitpallel velo kivven et libbo yachazor veyitpallel bechavvana. veim kivven et libbo bivracha rishona shuv eno tzarich. mi shettaa beachat mishshalosh berachot harishonot chozer larosh. veim taa beachat mishshalosh berachot acharonot yachazor laavoda. veim taa beachat min haemtzaiyyot chozer litchillat beracha shettaa bah umashlim tefillato al hasseder. vechen sheliach tzibbur shettaa keshehu mitpallel bekol ram al derech zo hu chozer:

Aval im taa sheliach tzibbur keshehu mitpallel belachash ani omer sheeno chozer umitpallel paam sheniyya mippene torach tzibbur ella somech al hattefilla shemmitpallel bekol ram. vehu shello taa beshalosh rishonot sheim taa bahem leolam chozer kemo shehayyachid chozer:

Sheliach tzibbur shettaa venivhal velo yada mehechan yatchil veshaha shaa yaamod acher tachtav. veim taa bevirkat haeppikorsin en mamtinin lo ella miyyad yaamod acher tachtav shemma eppikorsut nizreka bo. vehu shello hitchil bah aval im hitchil bah mamtinin lo shaa. velo yehe hashsheni sarvan beotah shaa:

Umehechan hu matchil, mittechillat beracha shettaa bah rishon im taa beachat min haemtzaiyyot. aval im taa beachat min hashshalosh rishonot matchil hashsheni min harosh. veim taa beachat min haacharonot yatchil hashsheni min haavoda:
Haomer eni yored lifne hatteva mippene shebbegaday tzevuim af bilvanim lo yaavor beotah tefilla. amar eni over mippene sheyyesh beragli sandal af yachef lo yaavor:

Mi shennistappek lo im hitpallel im lo hitpallel eno chozer umitpallel ella im ken mitpallel tefilla zo al daat shehi nedava. sheim ratza yachid lehitpallel kol hayyom tefillat nedava yitpallel. mi shehaya omed bitfilla venizkar shekkevar hitpallel posek vaafillu beemtza beracha. veim hayta tefillat arvit eno posek shello hitpallel otah mittechilla ella al daat sheenah chova:

Mi shettaa vehitpallel shel chol beshabbat lo yatza. veim nizkar vehu betoch hattefilla gomer beracha shehitchil bah vechozer umitpallel shel shabbat. bamme devarim amurim bearvit o beshacharit o bemincha. aval bemusaf posek afillu beemtza habberacha. vechen im hishlim tefilla shel chol al daat shehu musaf chozer umitpallel musaf. echad shabbat veechad yom tov veechad rosh chodesh:

Beshabbatot veyamim tovim kesheggomer sheliach tzibbur tefillat shacharit bekol ram omer kaddish veachar kach <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" vechulei veomer kaddish. umitpallelin musaf belachash veachar kach mitpallel musaf bekol ram kederech sheasa beshacharit. veomer kaddish achar tefillat musaf vehaam niftarin. veen omrin kedushsha vetachanunim achar tefillat shacharit kishar hayyamim ella omer otah kodem tefillat hammincha. ketzad. kore tehilla ledavid veomer seder hayyom vedivre tachanunim veomer kaddish umitpallelin mincha vechozer umashmia tefillat mincha bekol ram veomer kaddish:
Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed omer seder kedushsha kodem tefillat musaf. bemotzae shabbat omer seder hayyom gam achar tefillat haerev veomrim kaddish veachar kach mavdil:

Baerev kol haam yoshvin vehu omed veomer <small>(Tehillim 78 lach)</small> "vehu rachum" kulei barchu et Adonai hamevorach vechulei vehem onin baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed. umatchil lifros al shema veomer kaddish veachar kach hakkol omdim umitpallelin belachash. ucheshemmashlimin omer kaddish vehem niftarin. veeno chozer lehitpallel bekol ram arvit lefi sheen tefillat arvit chova lefichach lo yevarech berachot levattala sheen kan adam shennitchayyev bahem kede lehotzio yede chovato:

Belele shabbatot chozer shatz achar shemmitpallel belachash im hatztzibbur umitpallel bekol ram. aval eno mitpallel sheva ella beracha achat meen sheva. vechen hu omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora el elyon kone berachamav shamayim vaaretz. magen avot bidvaro mechayye metim bemaamaro hael hakkadosh sheen kamohu hammeniach leammo beshabbat kadsho ki vam ratza lehaniach lahem lefanav naavod beyira vafachad venode lishmo bechol yom tamid meen habberachot el hahodaot adon hashshalom mekaddesh hashshabbat umevarech hashshevii umeniach bikdushsha leam medushshene oneg zecher lemaase vereshit. elohenu velohe avotenu retze na bimnuchatenu vechulei baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat. veomer kaddish veniftarin kol haam:

Velamma tikkenu chachamim ze. mippene sherov haam bain lehitpallel arvit belele shabbatot veyihye sham mi shennitacher lavo velo hishlim tefillato veyishshaer levaddo bevet hakkeneset veyavo lide sakkana. lefichach chozer sheliach tzibbur umitpallel kede sheyyitakkevu kol haam ad sheyyashlim hammitacher veyetze immahem:

Lefichach yom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat o yom hakkippurim o rosh chodesh en sheliach tzibbur hayyored arvit lifne hatteva mazkir inyan hayyom bivracha zo aval chotem bah mekaddesh hashshabbat bilvad lefi shello nitchayyev hayyom bivracha zo:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:8-9:
Hannotel tzipparnav o searo o sefamo o zekano hare ze toledet gozez vechayyav. vehu sheyyittol bichli. aval im netalan beyado ben lo ben leacher patur. vechen hachotech yabbelet miggufo ben beyad ben bichli patur ben lo ben leacher. umuttar lachtoch yabbelet bammikdash beyad aval lo bichli. veim hayta yevesha chotchah af bichli veoved avoda: 
Hannotel searo bichli kamma yittol veyihye chayyav. shete searot. veim likket levanot mittoch shechorot afillu achat chayyav. tzipporen sheppersha rubbah vetzitzin shel or sheppershu rubban im pershu kelappe mala umetzaarot oto muttar littol otan beyado aval lo bichli. veim netalan bichli patur. veim enan metzaarot oto afillu bayyad asur. veim lo pershu rubban afillu metzaarot oto asur lenatlan beyado veim netalan bichli chayyav:
Niddah 22b:8-11: Hammappelet kemin dagim. veliflog name rabbi yehuda beha!

Amar resh lakish: bemachloket shenuya, verabbanan hi. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam ella gabbe chaticha, deaved dam dekaresh vehave chaticha, aval beriyya — la have.
Ulehach lishshana deamar rabbi yochanan, bei efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam kamippalgi, liflog name rabbi yehuda beha!
Man dematne hach lishshana, matne hachi: rabbi yochanan veresh lakish, deamri tarvayyhu, bemachloket shenuya, verabbanan hi.
Pesachim 50b:2-10: Gemara may irya arve fesachim? afillu arve shabbatot vearve yamim tovim name! detanya: haose melacha bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim min hammincha ulemala eno roe siman beracha leolam! hatam, min hammincha ulemala hu deasur, samuch lammincha — la. hacha — mechatzot. i name: hatam, siman beracha hu dela chaze, aval shammote la meshammetinan leh. hacha — shammote name meshammetinan leh.

Gufa: haose melacha bearve shabbatot uvearve yamim tovim min hammincha ulemala, uvemotzae shabbat uvemotzae yom tov uvemotzae yom hakkippurim, uvechol makom sheyyesh sham nidnud avera, leetoye taanit tzibbur — eno roe siman beracha leolam.

Tanu rabbanan: yesh zariz veniskar, veyesh zariz venifsad. yesh shafal veniskar, veyesh shafal venifsad. zariz veniskar — deaved kulle shabbeta, vela aved bemaale shabbeta. zariz venifsad — deaved kulle shabbeta, veaved bemaale shabbeta. shafal veniskar — dela aved kulle shabbeta, vela aved bemaale shabbeta. shafal venifsad — dela aved kulle shabbeta, veaved bemaale shabbeta. amar rava: hane neshe demachoza, af al gav dela avdan avidta bemaale shabbeta — mishshum mefannekuta hu, deha kol yoma name la ka avdan. afillu hachi — shafal veniskar karenan lehu.

Rava rame: ketiv "ki gadol ad shamayim chasdecha", uchetiv "ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha". ha ketzad? kan beosin lishmah, vechan beosin shello lishmah. vechidrav yehuda. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam betora umitzvot af al pi shello lishmah, shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah.

Tanu rabbanan: hametzappe lischar ishto verechayim — eno roe siman beracha leolam. sechar ishto — matkuleta. richyay — agrata. aval avda umezabbena — ishtabboche mishtabbach bah kera dichtiv: "sadin asta vattimkor".

Tanu rabbanan: hammistakker bekanim uvekankannim — eno roe siman beracha leolam. may tama? kevan dinfish afchazayyhu — shalta behu ena. tanu rabbanan: taggare simta, umegaddele behema dakka, vekotztze ilanot tovot, venotnin enehen bechelek yafe — eno roe siman beracha leolam, may tama? detahu beh inashe.
Tanu rabbanan, arba perutot en bahen siman beracha leolam: sechar kotvin, usechar meturegmanin, usechar yetomim, umaot habbaot mimmedinat hayyam.
Bishlama sechar meturegmanin — mishshum demichaze kischar shabbat. umaot yetomim name — lav bene mechila ninhu. maot habbaot mimmedinat hayyam — mishshum delav kol yoma mitrechish nissa.

Ella sechar kotvin may tama? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: esrim vearba taaniyyot yashvu anshe keneset haggedola al kotve sefarim tefillin umezuzot shello yitashsheru, sheilmale mitashsherin — en kotvin. tanu rabbanan: kotve sefarim tefillin umezuzot, hen, vetaggarehen, vetaggare taggarehen, vechol haoskin bimlechet shamayim, leetoye mochre techelet — enan roin siman beracha leolam. veim oskin lishmah — roin.

Sanhedrin 70a:5-15: Gemara amar rabbi zera: tartemar ze eni yodea mahu, ella mittoch shekkafal rabbi yose beyayin, nimtza kofel af babbasar, venimtza tartemar chatzi mane.
Amar rav chanan bar molada amar rav huna: eno chayyayv ad sheyyikkach basar bezol veyochal, yayin bezol veyishte, dichtiv: "zolel vesove".

Veamar rav chanan bar molada amar rav huna: eno chayyayv ad sheyyochal basar chay veyishte yayin chay. ini? veha rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu: achal basar chay veshata yayin chay eno naase ben sorer umore! amar ravina: yayin chay – mezig vela mezig, basar chay – beshil vela beshil, kivsar kiva deachli gannave.

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu: achal basar maliach veshata yayin miggitto, en naase ben sorer umore. tenan hatam: erev tisha beav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin, velo yochal basar, velo yishte yayin. vetana: aval ochel hu basar maliach veshote yayin miggitto.
Bevasar maliach, ad kamma? amar rabbi chanina bar kahana: kol zeman shehu kishlamim.
Veyayin miggitto, ad kamma? kol zeman shehu toses. vehatanya: yayin toses en bo mishshum gilluy. vechamma tesisato? shelosha yamim.
Hacha may? hatam mishshum simcha hu, kol zeman shehu kishlamim name it beh simcha. hacha mishshum immeshoche hu, uvechol shehu la mimmeshich. veyayin – ad arbaim yom.
Amar rav chanan: lo nivra yayin baolam ella lenachem avelim, uleshallem sachar larshaim, shenneemar: "tenu shechar leoved veyayin lemare nafesh".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "al tere yayin ki yitaddam"? al tere yayin shemmaadim penehem shel reshaim baolam hazze, umalbin penehem laolam habba. rava amar: "al tere yayin ki yitaddam" – al tere yayin sheacharito dam.
Rav kahana rame: ketiv "tirash" vekarenan "tirosh". zacha – naase rosh, lo zacha – naase rash.
Rava rame: ketiv "yeshammach" vekarenan "yesammach". zacha – mesammecho, lo zacha – meshammemehu. vehayeynu deamar rava: chamra verechane pakkachin.
Zohar, Korach 2: Vayyakumu lifne moshe vegomer. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay. ribbi shimon amar, kerie moed kerie ketiv, chaser yod, amay kerie. ella hachi hu, malchuta deara keen malchuta dirkia. veraza da, kol innun kitrin illain, dishma kaddisha itachid behu, kullehu zeminin meatar deikre kodesh, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 23:2) mikrae kodesh. veematay (98) beshaata demoed zammin bealma, kegavvna deinnun kitrin illain, dizminin mikodesh illaa, hachi name kodesh tatta zammin lecheloy, leatera ulealaa lehu.

Kodesh illaa yedia, kodesh tattaa chachmat shelomo, hachi name ihi zeminat lechol chelaha. veinnun chayyaylin kullehu, zeminin leitattera behay kodesh tattaa, bezimna demoed sharyay bealma. uchegavvna dechelaha kayymin leella, hachi name kayyme memanan deamma, kedugema dilah letatta, veal da ikrun kerie moed. uvegin deinnun letatta, kerie moed chaser, (kegavvna dilella) aval bishlimu yattir innun.

Anshe shem vadday, vela anshe Adonai. veda hu raza, benakvo shem yumat, veokimna. veal da ikre hacha, anshe shem vadday, kevan demisitra digvura ka atyayn, anshe shem innun, ha shevacha dilhon yattir, aval innun natlu legarmayyhu. veitachadu bemachloket.
Zohar, Korach 4: Vayyippelu al penehem vayyomru el elohe haruchot lechol basar. ta chaze, moshe veaharon masru garmayyhu lemmita. bema, begin dichtiv vayyippelu al penehem vayyomru el elohe haruchot, ruchat ketiv, chaser vav. uvegin kach ilana demota hu, uvechol atar nefilat anpin lehahu atar havi. veal da el elohe, el: hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom. elohe haruchot, deihu atar tzerora denishmatin dealma, vechol nishmatin tamman sallekin, umittamman atyayn. (nusach acher tamman itchazyayn)

Ribbi yehuda patach, (iyyov 34:2) shimu chachamim millay veyodim haazinu li. hay kera elihu amaro. ta chaze, ma ketiv (iyyov 32:3) uvishloshet reav chara appo al asher lo matzu maane vegomer. deha innun haviv amrin millin, veiyyov la hava itnechim alayyhu. mehacha olifna, man deal lenachama leavel, bae leyasseda millin bekadmita, deha chavrayyay deiyyov havo amre mille keshot, aval lenachama leh lav, begin devae millin deihu yode alayyhu, (beorach keshot) ucheden yekabbel aleh dina, veyode lemalka kaddisha aleh. ma ketiv, (iyyov 32:4) veeliyyahu chikka et iyyov bidvarim vegomer. deode levatar lekudesha berich hu, vekabbil aleh dina dishmayya.

Ta chaze, ketiv (iyyov 34:10) lachen anshe levav shimu li chalila lael meresha veshadday meavl. lachen anshe levav shimu li, shelemin becholla, leavchana millin. chalila lael meresha, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom. veshadday meavl, da samich lokovla da, (veha ukemuha) el shadday. (iyyov 34:10) ki foal adam yeshallem lo, ha bar nash azil behay alma, veavid avidtoy vechate kamme mareh, hahu ovada talya aleh, leshallama leh dina, hada hu dichtiv ki foal adam yeshallem lo, hahu ovada yeshallem lo.

Veim kol da, im yashim elav libbo, kevan devar nash shavvi libbeh ureuteh leatava kamme mareh, keden el elohe haruchot rucho venishmato elav yeesof leittzarra bitzrora dechayye, vela shavik lenafsheh levar, leittedna bedina achara.

Ribbi yose amar, hay milla raza (achara) hu, bedinin temirin dekudesha berich hu. ki poal adam yeshallem lo, leittedna bedine, uveinun ovdin devar nash avid behay alma, vesalik leh leitdana keovadoy, veyitavid mealma, ma ketiv batreh, mi fakad alav artza umi sam tevel kullah. mi fakad alav artza, da hu achuha defarik leh. umi sam tevel kullah, devane beta, uvane binyayn alma, vetikkuna veyishshuva. ma ketiv batreh, im yashim elav libbo. hay bar nash, defakid aleh lemivne binyayna, bae lechavvevna libba ureuta legabbeh dehahu mita. mikkan, bar nash deate al hahi itteta, begin shepiru vetiuveta dilah, ha binyayn alma la itbene, deha reuta velibba la itkevvavn legabbe mita.

Uvegin kach ketiv, im yashim elav libbo, biruta delibba dichavvin legabbeh, keden rucho venishmato elav yeesof, veitmeshach gabbeh, leitbanaa behay alma, ma ketiv batreh, yigva kol basar yachad veadam al afar yashuv, yigva kol basar yachad, hahu gufa yitbele beafra, vechol hahu bisra. vehasheta, adam al afar yashuv, ha chadtutin devinyana kemillekaddemin, veyetuv al afra devinyayna degufa achara, kema dehava bekadmita. veal da, rucha venishmeta bidoy dekudesha berich hu, vechayes alayyhu divne nasha, dela yitavidu mehay alma, umealma achara, begin kach el elohe haruchot lechol basar.
Zohar, Korach 6: Ribbi elazar (nusach acher rabbi abba) amar, (Bamidbar 4:18) al tachritu et shevet mishpechot hakkehati mittoch haleviyyim, begin deinnun giza vesharsha delevae. vezot asu lahem vechayu velo yamutu, devae kahana leatkena lehu, deaf al gav dikrivin innun lekudesha, la yealun ella betikkuna dechahana, dehu yada simana deyimtun legabbeh, vela yattir. vechad mechasseya lemane kudesha, keden kissuya achara share, veasir lon lekarva lemecheme, deha milla bachashay la it legabbayyhu, ella lechahana, (veal da) demilla dilhon veovada dilhon beraza uvachashay velevae learama kala.

Begin kach kahane bachashay uveraza, veal da asir lon chamra, dechamra learama kala, ulegallaa razin ihu. begin kach levae itmesaru learama kala, deha bedina itachad, dina beitgalyay ihu, ulefarsema milla kamme kolla. aval kahana, kol milloy beraza uvachashay, velav beitgalyay (simana decholla semol tehe doche, veyamin mekarevet). begin deihu yemina (mikkerev), kad dinin sharyayn bealma missitra dismala, yemina yehe mikkerava, uvema. bikketoret, deihu bachashay, beraza dakik, ufenimaa mikkolla.

Ta chaze, kad hay madbecha achara, share leatteara ittearuta, kad la yishtechachu zakkain, madbecha penimaa ittear legabbeh, vekaim lokovleh, vedinin mishtachche. veal da kayyeyma lokovel da, ucheden dina istallak.

Ribbi elazar amar, (Bamidbar 4:4) zot avodat bene kehat beohel moed kodesh hakkodashim, beshaata divne kehat natlin kodesh kodashim, keden ate kahana, vechafe kolla, ad la yikrevun lenatla leh, vela havo chaman lealmin ma deinnun natlin, ella kolla bechissuyay minnayyhu. kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 4:Adonai) uva aharon uvanav binsoa hammachane vehoridu et parochet hammasach. verov kissuyay demane makdesha, techelet ihu, begin ditchelet ha (123 amud bet) ukemuha veittemar. batar deitkasyay kolla, mekarvin bene kehat denatlin, vela mekarvin ella beinnun baddim denafkin levar. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 4:15) vechila aharon uvanav lechassot et hakkodesh vegomer, binsoa hammachane veachare chen yavou vene kehat laset vegomer.

Begin kach ketoret deihi penimaa, vechol ma di beraza, lechahana itmesar. veal da (Bamidbar 7) vayyikkach aharon kaasher dibber moshe vayyaratz el toch hakkahal vayitten et hakketoret, deihi penimaa, raza dechahana, keden vaychapper al haam vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim, ben ilana dechayye, uven ilana demota, keden yemina kariv da beda, vatteatzar hammaggefa, zakkaa chulaka dechahana, dechahana it leh chela leella, veit leh chela letatta, vehu garim shelama leella vetatta, uvechol zimna, semala palach limina, hada hu dichtiv veyilavu alecha visharatucha, vimina bismala mishtakkeche bamikdash.
Zohar, Korach 7:28-8:43: Ribbi elazar hava kaim kammeh deribbi shimon avuha, amar leh, ketiv (Kohelet 9:9) ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta kol yeme chayye hevlecha. amar leh, ta chaze, ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta (sefer acher vahava amar rabbi shimon ketiv (Kohelet 9:9) raa chayyim im ishsha asher ahavat) da hu raza, devae bar nash leachlela chayyim baatar da, da bela da la azla. uvae bar nash leachlela middat yom ballayla, umiddat layla bayom. veda hu ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta may taama begin ki hi chelkecha bachayim, dechayim la sharan ella al da. uvaamalcha asher atta amel tachat hashshamesh, kema deamar (Mishlei 3:6) bechol derachecha daehu vehu yeyashsher orchotecha.

Veta chaze kol milloy dishlomo malka, kullehu setimin lego bechachmeta, vehane kerae itchazun dehuttara retzua, kema dichtiv batreh, (nusach acher amar leh rabbi elazar ketiv) kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase ki en maase vecheshbon vegomer. hay kera it leistakkela beh, (Kohelet 9:10) kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase, vechi shelomo dechachmeta illaa beh, yattir al kol bene alma, amar hachi.

Ella (nusach acher amar leh) kol milloy dishlomo malka al raza dechachmeta ittemaru. ta chaze, kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase, da hu devae bar nash leachlela semala bimina, vechol ma dehu avid, mibbae leh dela yehon ella kelilan bimina. kol asher timtza yadcha, da semala. laasot bechochacha: da hu yemina, kema deat amer (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach. vechevan devar nash yizdehar dechol ovadoy yehon lesitra dimina, veyachlil semala bimina, keden kudesha berich hu share begavvivy behay alma, veyachnish leh legabbeh lehahu alma deate.

Vela yemma bar nash beshaata daatena lehahu alma, keden etba min malka rachame, veetuv kammeh, ella ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma, batar deyistelak bar nash mehay alma, ella i bae bar nash, demalka kaddisha yanhir leh lehahu alma, veyitten leh chulaka lealma deate, yishtedal behay alma, leachlela ovadoy bimina, vechol ovadoy yehon lishma dekudesha berich hu, deha levatar kad yitkenish mehay alma, leittedna bedina takkifa, bedina degehinnam, let tamman eta vechachma vesachletanu leishtezava min dina.

Davar acher ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bashsheol. begehinnam, it beh madorin al madorin. madora tattaa sheol. madora tattaa minneh, avaddon. veda samich leda. man denachit lishol, yedunun leh umittamman yetzaftzef veole. hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:6) morid sheol vayyaal. uman denachit laavaddon, tu la salik lealmin.

Man deit beh ovada tava, o deihu (sefer acher i tava ihu) mare dechushebana, ha ukemuha divchol lelya velelya ad la yishkav, vead la naim, bae bar nash lemebad chushebana meovadoy deavad kol hahu yoma, veyetuv minnayyhu, veyive alayyhu rachame. may tama behahi shaata. begin dehahi shaata ilana demota share bealma, vechol bene alma taamin taama demota, uvae behahi shaata lemebad chushebana meovadoy, veyode alayyhu, begin deihi shaata demota, veillen ikrun mare dechushebana.

Vechen man deishtedal bedaat uvechachma leminda lemareh, kad yaavrun leh leistachaa uleistakkela beinnun chayyayvin deitteridu bagehinnam, uvedarga dishol, vechullehu tzavvchin meinnun dargin, hu la yishtear tamman, vela yishtekach benayyhu, veal da en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bishol, vela yishtechach ella leella leella, baatar dechamma nehorin uvutzinin, vechamma kisufin sharan beh, vekudesha berich hu ate (beh) (sefer acher vateayb leh) leishtashea im shear tzaddikayyay di began eden. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay behay alma, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha.

(Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu et avodat ohel moed vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Yeshayahu 40:22) hayyoshev al chug haaretz vegomer. ta chaze, kad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma, salik biruta kammeh, uvara leh beorayyta. (sefer acher kad salik biruta kammeh kudesha berich hu lemivre alma istakkal beorayyta uvara leh) uva ishtachlal. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:27) bahachino shamayim sham ani. uchetiv (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon. veha ukemuha, al tikre amon, ella uman.

Kad atte lemivre adam, veha ittemar, amra tora vechi lemaggana itkeriat erech appayim verav chesed. behahi shaata denafik adam lealma, hava ziv partzufa dileh meella umittatta, vahavu dachalin minneh kol biryayn, veokmuha. ta chaze, la itkayyaym alma, vela ishtelim, ad hahi shaata denafak adam bishlimu decholla, veitkaddash yoma, veittekan kurseyay kaddisha lemalka, keden ishtelimu illae vetattae, veishtechachu chedvavn bechullehu almin.

Behahi shaata devaa yoma leitkaddesha, havo nafke ruchehon deshedin leitbere gufa dilhon, veitkaddash yoma, vela itberiu, veishtear alma kema deitpegim meavidata veistachar (sefer acher vaatachesar), kevan deitkaddashu (almin) yisrael, veishtelimu bedargehon, veishtechachu levae bistar semala, kad (sefer acher keden) ishtelim hahu pegima dealma, demissetar semala.

Veal da baan leitdakkea levae, ucheden kolla itkelil bimina, vealma la itpegim, uvegin kach ketiv, veavad hallevi hu. hu ashlim listar semala. hu ashlim lifgimu dealma. vaafillu hahu sitra detzafon, deishtear chaser bealma, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma. levaa baarona ashlim lecholla. may baarona. behahu matula dehavo natle bemashkena, ishtelim kol hahu pegimu al yedeh.

Hu: leella lismala. hu: itkelil bimina, tu hu: da attika. (sefer acher ta chaze 39 min tu) ilmale dina la ishtechach bealma, la havo yade bene nasha mehemnuta illaa, vela yishtaddelun bene nasha beorayyta, vela yitkayymu pikkude orayyta, pulechana shelemuta deyishtechach bealma legabbe malka kaddisha, man avid leh. havi omer da levaa.

Vetu veavad hallevi hu, kema deat amer (Devarim 4:35) ki Adonai hu haelohim. hu ashlim shelemuta, lemehevi kolla chad. hu: peshita lekabbela likkeneset yisrael, kema deat amer, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi, begin lechabbera ziuuga kachada. man ittear rechimuta. havi omer hu. tu hu kema deat amer (sefer acher tu hu da attika kema deat amar ki Adonai hu haelohim) (Tehillim 100:3) hu asanu velo anachnu ammo. begin kach hu: letatta. hu: leella. hu: itgalyay. hu satim. hu elohim.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, zammin kudesha berich hu leanhara lesihara, kinhora deshimsha. unehora deshimsha yehe al chad sheva zimnin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma vegomer. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 60:20) lo yavo od shimshech virechech lo yeasef. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 60:19) lo yihye lach od hashshemesh vegomer.

Raya mehemna (Bamidbar 18:15) kol peter rechem lechol basar vegomer, veet bechor habbehema hatemea tifde. pikkuda da lifdot peter chamor, lifdot lealma deate. vei kodem deazil lehahu alma, la yifde nafsheh verucheh venishmateh beorayyta, atid leachzera lehay alma kidbekadmeta. (iyyov 33:25) yashuv lime alumav, velokovel nafsha verucha venishmeta.

Ketiv (iyyov 33:29) hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver. veyisrael, begin defidyon dilhon hava bela tora, deihu kesef kissufa dealma deate, ahadru telat zimnin acharanin begaluta, uvefurekana batrayyta defurekana dilhon yehe beorayyta, la yehadrun lealam begaluta. atu rabbanan uvarichu leh, veamru raya mehemana, kudesha berich hu yifde lach, vechol yisrael yippadun al yedach, vetitchaddesh immehon, veinnun immach.
Zohar, Korach 8: (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu et avodat ohel moed vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Yeshayahu 40:22) hayyoshev al chug haaretz vegomer. ta chaze, kad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma, salik biruta kammeh, uvara leh beorayyta. (sefer acher kad salik biruta kammeh kudesha berich hu lemivre alma istakkal beorayyta uvara leh) uva ishtachlal. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:27) bahachino shamayim sham ani. uchetiv (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon. veha ukemuha, al tikre amon, ella uman.

Kad atte lemivre adam, veha ittemar, amra tora vechi lemaggana itkeriat erech appayim verav chesed. behahi shaata denafik adam lealma, hava ziv partzufa dileh meella umittatta, vahavu dachalin minneh kol biryayn, veokmuha. ta chaze, la itkayyaym alma, vela ishtelim, ad hahi shaata denafak adam bishlimu decholla, veitkaddash yoma, veittekan kurseyay kaddisha lemalka, keden ishtelimu illae vetattae, veishtechachu chedvavn bechullehu almin.

Behahi shaata devaa yoma leitkaddesha, havo nafke ruchehon deshedin leitbere gufa dilhon, veitkaddash yoma, vela itberiu, veishtear alma kema deitpegim meavidata veistachar (sefer acher vaatachesar), kevan deitkaddashu (almin) yisrael, veishtelimu bedargehon, veishtechachu levae bistar semala, kad (sefer acher keden) ishtelim hahu pegima dealma, demissetar semala.

Veal da baan leitdakkea levae, ucheden kolla itkelil bimina, vealma la itpegim, uvegin kach ketiv, veavad hallevi hu. hu ashlim listar semala. hu ashlim lifgimu dealma. vaafillu hahu sitra detzafon, deishtear chaser bealma, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma. levaa baarona ashlim lecholla. may baarona. behahu matula dehavo natle bemashkena, ishtelim kol hahu pegimu al yedeh.

Hu: leella lismala. hu: itkelil bimina, tu hu: da attika. (sefer acher ta chaze 39 min tu) ilmale dina la ishtechach bealma, la havo yade bene nasha mehemnuta illaa, vela yishtaddelun bene nasha beorayyta, vela yitkayymu pikkude orayyta, pulechana shelemuta deyishtechach bealma legabbe malka kaddisha, man avid leh. havi omer da levaa.

Vetu veavad hallevi hu, kema deat amer (Devarim 4:35) ki Adonai hu haelohim. hu ashlim shelemuta, lemehevi kolla chad. hu: peshita lekabbela likkeneset yisrael, kema deat amer, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi, begin lechabbera ziuuga kachada. man ittear rechimuta. havi omer hu. tu hu kema deat amer (sefer acher tu hu da attika kema deat amar ki Adonai hu haelohim) (Tehillim 100:3) hu asanu velo anachnu ammo. begin kach hu: letatta. hu: leella. hu: itgalyay. hu satim. hu elohim.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, zammin kudesha berich hu leanhara lesihara, kinhora deshimsha. unehora deshimsha yehe al chad sheva zimnin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma vegomer. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 60:20) lo yavo od shimshech virechech lo yeasef. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 60:19) lo yihye lach od hashshemesh vegomer.

Raya mehemna (Bamidbar 18:15) kol peter rechem lechol basar vegomer, veet bechor habbehema hatemea tifde. pikkuda da lifdot peter chamor, lifdot lealma deate. vei kodem deazil lehahu alma, la yifde nafsheh verucheh venishmateh beorayyta, atid leachzera lehay alma kidbekadmeta. (iyyov 33:25) yashuv lime alumav, velokovel nafsha verucha venishmeta.

Ketiv (iyyov 33:29) hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver. veyisrael, begin defidyon dilhon hava bela tora, deihu kesef kissufa dealma deate, ahadru telat zimnin acharanin begaluta, uvefurekana batrayyta defurekana dilhon yehe beorayyta, la yehadrun lealam begaluta. atu rabbanan uvarichu leh, veamru raya mehemana, kudesha berich hu yifde lach, vechol yisrael yippadun al yedach, vetitchaddesh immehon, veinnun immach.
Zohar, Vayakhel 13: Ta chaze, kevan deal shabbeta, veittammar hahu maddura, kol eshshin deeshsha kashya ittemaru veitkafyayn, vaafillu eshsha degehinnam, vechayyayvin degehinnam, it lon nayycha. vecholla tatta veella it lehu nayycha. kad nafak shabbeta, umevarchin yisrael al nura, keden nafkin kol eshshin demittammeran, kol chad vechad leatreh. uvegin dela leitteara eshsha achara, ketiv (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, eshsha demadbecha amay.

Ella kad al shabbeta, karoza kare bechullehu rekiin, ittekanu retichin, ittekanu mashiryayn, lekadmut marechon. keden nafik chad rucha missitra dedarom, vehahu rucha itperash al kol innun chelin umashiryayn delistar yemina, veitlabbeshan beh, vehahu rucha ikre levusha dikar deshabbeta. keden patore dehay alma, mittakkenan bechad hechala. zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, desiddura defatoreh itchaze tamman kedka yaut, vekayyeyma kolla mittakkena, bela kissufa, inish kefum cheleh.

Kad al shabbeta, itzterichu innun amma kaddisha leaschaa garmayyhu (136 amud bet) mishshimusha dechol, may taama. begin divchol, rucha achara azla veshatya veshara al amma. vechad bae bar nash lenafka min hahu rucha, uleaala berucha achara kaddisha illaa, bae leaschaa garmeh, lemishre aleh hahu rucha illaa kaddisha.

Ta chaze raza illaa demilla, kol innun shit yomin, (keyama milla decholla) itachadan beraza dechad nekuda kaddisha, vechullehu yomin itachadan beh. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin levar besitra achara. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin lego (hakedama Adonai amud bet) meiggula kaddisha, veitachadan binkuda kaddisha.

Veyisrael kaddishin, vechol innun demitassekin bikdushsha, kol yoma deshabbeta, itachadan kol innun shit yomin, beinnun shit yomin dilgo deitachadan behahi nekuda, itachadan behay, begin lenatra lon. vechol innun shit yomin (davar acher veinnun shit yomin dilgo) deshabbeta, hahi nekuda temira ihi. kevan deal shabbeta, keden salleka hahi nekuda, veitattera veitachada leella, vechullehu temirin begavvah.

Ta chaze, it yamim veit yamim. yeme chol, kema deittemar, veillen kayyeymin levar leammin. yeme hashshabbat, deinnun yeme hashavua, kayyeymin leyisrael. vechad salleka hay nekuda, kolla itgeniz, veihi salleka, kevan deihi salleka, ikre shabbat.

Mahu shabbat. i tema begin shevita, dichtiv ki vo shavat, yaut hu. aval raza demilla, kevan desalleka hay nekuda, unehora nahir, keden mitattera ihi baavahan, kevan demitattera ihi baavahan, keden itchabberat veitachadat behu, lemehve chad, veikre kolla shabbat. shabbat: 300 bat. 300 ha ukemuha, raza ditlat avahan, demitachadan bevat yechida, veihi mitattera behu, veinnun bealma deate. vecholla ihu chad. veda ihu 300 bat, lemeheve kolla chad.

Vei tema, shabbat haggadol, veihu leella, amay ikre shabbat. ella vadday hachi hu. veraza demilla, bechol atar nekuda deihi ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 17:8) shamreni keishon bat ayin, begin deihi (nekuda) ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat.

Alma deate, ihu (180 amud alef) hechala lehahi nekuda illaa, vechad ihi kayyeyma, venatla begadpaha laavahan, leitattera leella ikre kolla shabbat. vechad avahan mitatteran leella, bego nekuda illaa, ikre shabbat. nekuda tattaa (70 amud bet) kad mitattera baavahan ikre shabbat.

rashi: Veet haesh. shebbetoch hammachtot:
Zere halea. laaretz meal hammachtot:
Ki kadeshu. hammachtot vaasurin bahanaa, shehare asaum kele sharet:
ohc: Emor el elazar. taam elazar, letzad shello hechshiv Adonai haddavar sheyyease al yede aharon shehu kohen gadol, o letzad sheal yede aharon naasa hammishpat umetu makrive hammachtot, lo ratza Adonai sheyyease al yado haramat hammachtot.

Veyarem et hammachtot. tzarich ladaat lamma amar veyarem beVav kevan shezze hu hatechalat hammitzva. venire shennitkavven lehosif al inyan rishon shehu beliat korach vaadato, sherau am bene yisrael ki meAdonai yatza devar kehunnat aharon, veod hosif tokef vechozek hakkehunna beyad aharon ledorot, sheyyarem hammachtot vegomer veasu otam rikkue fachim vegomer veyihyu leot livne yisrael vegomer zikkaron livne yisrael vegomer.

Hibbadlu mittoch vegomer. lo al moshe veaharon hu omer, ki leelle lo tifga middat haddin hagam sheyyihyu betoch haeda hakkala chas veshalom, veze lecha haot – aharon shehaya betoch adat korach venivkea haadama tachtehem velo nifga. ella kavvanat maamar Adonai hu al hatztzaddikim shehayu betoch haeda, kihoshua vechalev ushear hatztzaddikim uvene battehem shel moshe veaharon veshel shear hatztzaddikim. velaze amar kodem lemaamar "hibbadlu" vaydabber Adonai el moshe vegomer lemor, veim al moshe veaharon hu omer lo haya tzarich lomar tevat lemor, ella lemor laadat hatztzaddikim habbechunim etzlam velivnehem uvene betam shehayu betoch haeda.

Vaachalle otam keraga. tzarich ladaat lamma amar keraga, veim lehodia ki hu saggi choach laharog shishshim ribbo kerega, kevar hodia ze mikkodem, dichtiv (Shemot 33:5) "rega echad eele vekirbecha vechilliticha".

Venire lefi divre hammidrash (Bamidbar Rabba) shehevi Rashi befasuk "vayyippol al panav" (Bamidbar 22:4), ze beyadam sirchon revii: baegel, bammitonnim, bammeraggelim vechulei, ad kan. im ken avon hammeraggelim kadam lemachloket korach, vesham perashti ki gezerat kelaya sheggazar Adonai al haddor hahu nitkayyema, ella shehoila tefillat moshe shello yamut haam keish echad ella behemshech zeman aroch. im ken haeda kevar hi mechuyyevet kelaya. laze ba maamar Adonai kan bechiddush haggezera sheyyihye keraga, perush, shello yaarich lahem hazzeman kemo shennitratztza mikkodem. ulederech ze matzanu nachat ruach lekushya shebbainyan, lamma yigzor Adonai mita al adat yisrael shello hayta yadam bammaal, uchemo shennitgalla mimmaamar moshe besamuch. velidvarenu, letzad shekkevar hayu yisrael mechuyyeve mita meavon hammeraggelim ella she heerich lahem zeman, veamru zichronam livracha (shabbat lev.) shehassatan mekatreg bishat hassakkana, vetziuu lemi sheyyesh beyado sicha ben yishtabbach leyotzer lachzor meorche hammilchama (yerushalmi berachot 5:1), hagam sheen bachet kede lehamit. uchemo chen bema shellefanenu, kevan shehayu mechuyyeve mita en nimlatim betzet hammashchit veyichlu beefes tikva.

Shuv hitztzatzti veraiti ki divre Adonai kan hem refua uteala laadat yisrael, ki im lo haya Adonai omer hibbadlu mittoch haeda vehaya yotze hammashchit, hayu nimlatim hatztzaddikim shello hayu bichlal gezerat hammeraggelim, vechol shehayu bichlal gezerat hammeraggelim haya hammashchit mechalle otam. velomar Adonai leyisrael sheyyihyu nivdalim mehem leval yiker lahem mikre ra, lo haya lahem zechut laze, shehare sof sof haya beyadam shemetz mehachet shello michu bekorach, veadrabba bau lirtzono. laze nitchakkem Adonai vetzivva lemoshe veaharon lehavedil hatztzaddikim veheiro levakkesh rachamim alehem, uveemtzaut zechuto shel moshe amar Adonai elav dabber el haeda vegomer healu missaviv vegomer (Bamidbar 16:24). ulederech ze nuchal lefaresh ki maamar Adonai sheamar lemoshe veaharon hibbadlu lo ba haddibbur ella lahairam lehitpallel, lo shehaya tzarich moshe lehavedil leval yissafu bechattat korach. veulay ki hu ze ma sheramaz bemaamar lemor, perush, shettachlit hammaamar haamur bainyan hu lemor maamar habba acharav shehu inyan havedalat yisrael meadat korach, ki leinyan moshe veaharon en tzerichin lehibbadel. uchefi ze en anu tzerichin lema shepperashnu shebba haddibbur al bene battehem veal hatztzaddikim shekkayyotze bahem.

rashi: Hinne elle reshaim. hem veovrim al torato, vahare hem shelevim baolam umagdilim koach veosher:
Veshalve olam. leshon shalva:

Hisgu. higdilu, umenachem peresh "yashuv ammo halom" (tehillim 10:10), yashuv harasha lahalom et ammo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. veharishon lamadti middevarav shel rabbi meir bar yitzchak sheliach tzibbur zatzal:
targum: Ha ilen rashiaya deyatvin beshalvata bealma haden adbiku nichsin kenu chela:

rashi: Yoshev beseter elyon. mi shehu chose beseter kanfe hashshechina, hu yitlonan betzillo, shehakkadosh baruch hu megin alav. hare moshe rabbenu ze massi et bene haadam lachasot bechanfe hashshechina:
Yoshev beseter elyon. kemo "betzillo chamadti veyashavti" (Shir HaShirim 2:3):
Shadday. leshon chozek:
targum: Deashre shechinteh beraza ilaa bitlal anane yekara deshaday yevit:

rashi: Vayyotze parach. kemashmao:
Tzitz. hu chanatat happeri keshehapperach nofel:

Vayyigmol shekedim. keshehukkar happeri hukkar shehen shekedim, leshon "vayyigdal hayyeled vayyiggamal" (Bereshit 21), velashon ze matzuy bifri hailan, kemo "uvoser gomel yihye nitztza" (Yeshayahu 18), velamma shekedim? hu happeri hamemaher lehafriach mikkol happerot, af hamorer al hakkehunna puranuto memaheret lavo, kemo shemmatzinu veuzziyyahu "vehatztzaraat zorcha vemitzcho" (Divrei Hayamim 2 26); targumo "vechafit shigdin", kemin eshkol shekedim yachad kefutim ze al ze:
ohc: Vayyigmol shekedim. razal amru (Bamidbar Rabba 18,23) taam shekedim – lehair shekkol hammearer al hakkehunna pureanuto memaheret lavo, ad kan. venire shehuchrechu lomar ken, sheen rauy levaal hannes levakkesh peri hammemaher lehaferiach, shennire chas veshalom hafechatat hayyecholet shemmevakkesh achar peri shemmemaher. laze amru ki yesh taam baddavar shehutzrach lehaferiach shekedim velo peri acher, lomar shemmemaher lippara vechulei, shezzulat ze haya motzi charuv.

rashi: Vayyakom moshe. kesavur sheyyisseu lo fanim velo asu:
ohc: Vayyakam moshe vayyelech vegomer. tzarich ladaat taam amro vayyakam, veim lehodia shehaya yoshev ma yatza lanu mehodaa zo? achen yirtze al derech amro (Mishlei 16:18) "lifne shever gaon velifne chavod anava", veamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 45,5) hishpalti – higbahti, vehu maamar hakkatuv "vayyakam moshe" – kima hayta lo bema shehalach ledatan velaaviram haanashim harshaim asher cherfuhu velo ratzu lavo etzlo, vehishpil atzmo hu vehalach etzlam. alehem neemar "lifne shever gaon", veal moshe "velifne chavod anava".

rashi: Ach rik zikkiti levavi. kol ze musav al veamru echa yada el, vegam omer: ach larik veal chinnam anu shomrim mitzvotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, vahare anu neguim kol hayyom:
targum: Beram lisrikuta zachvat livvi veshezvet bivriru yeday:

rashi: Vayyichar lemoshe meod. nitztaer ad limod:

El tefen el minchatam. lefi feshuto hakketoret shehem makrivin lefanecha machar al tefen alehem; umidrasho: amar, yodea ani sheyyesh lahem chelek vitmide tzibbur, af chelkam lo yekubbal lefanecha leratzon, tannichennu haesh velo tochlennu (tanchuma):

Lo chamor echad mehem nasati. lo chamoro shel echad mehem natalti. afillu keshehalachti mimmidyan lemitzrayim vehirkavti et ishti veet banay al hachamor, vehaya li littol oto hachamor mishellahem, lo natalti ella mishelli; vetau "shecharit", leshon arammi kach nikret angarya shel melech "shachavar":
ohc: Vayyomer el Adonai al tefen vegomer. hakkavvana letzad sheraa hafelaat sinat harshaim immo, mizze hikkir heyotam bechinat hara gamur asher tivo lisno bechinat hattov sinat mavet belo sibba, velaze amar el Adonai al tefen el minchatam. vehakkavvana baze letzad sheen lecha adam sheen beyado mitzvot umaasim tovim, uchevar kadam lanu sheen hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach sechar kol beriyya uveriyya vaafillu shel reshaim, dichtiv (Devarim 32:4) "el emuna veen avel", vetze ulemad missechar pesiotav shel oto rasha (sanhedrin tzav.), asher al ken chash moshe shettaamod lahem eze mitzva shebbeyadam shehazzechut tola, laze bikkesh meAdonai veamar al tefen el minchatam, perush, afillu zechut shekkevar higgia mincha laAdonai lo yifen lah velo yabbit eleha.
Veim tomar, ech yevattel middato yitbarach laanashim hahem leavvet mishpatam?

Da ki hatztzaddikim yesh koach bahem lehafekia zechut hannimtzet larshaim kesheyyiru shehem muchlatim bara, vehu sod (Shmuel 2 23:3) "tzaddik moshel yirat elohim", perush, moshel beyirat Adonai sheyyaase haadam, im yerae beenehem lehafekia zechuto mimmennu yesh koach beyadam, ma sheen hakkadosh baruch hu kivyachol ose. vetimtza bedin shellematta kayyotze baddavar, sheyyecholin bet din lehafekir nichse adam rasha, keamram (gittin lo:) "hefker bet din hefker".

Veim tomar, lamma lecha moshe lehafeli ansham shel ellu, veim letzad sinatam oto, lo mippene ze yitchayyevu kol kach onesh. gam yesh levaal haddin lachush kan velomar, en adam nechshad al davar ella im ken yesh bo (moed katan 18:), veim en bo kullo yesh bo miktzato. laze amar lifne Adonai taam hammaspik lechayyevam, vehitchil lehasir mechush hachashad veamar lo chamor vegomer, perush, en lahem makom lechashdeni mimmennu bisrara, shehare derech hammelachim lakachat tzarchehem mehaam uvifrat beinyanim shehem letzorech haam, vehu afillu chamor echad shehaya tzarich lo lavo alav ulegoolam lo nasa, veim ken minnayin lahem makom lechashdo bisrara.

Vehosif lomar velo hareoti vegomer, perush, tomar sheyyesh lahem sina immi leezo sibba sheggaramti lahem bedavar haragil baolam, sheyyeeru devarim ben bene adam shemmehem yumshechu evot – lo hareoti vegomer, perush, miyyamay lo asiti lahem raa shettimmashech lahem sina immi missibbatah.

Vedikdek lomar et achad mehem, perush afillu behameshachat hara meechad mehem lachavero lo sibbavti, kemo shettomar lo bau lefanay laddin vechiyyavti et hazzakkay o zikkiti et hachayyav shehera hu et echad mehem, perush shekkeshemmechayyev mamon leechad latet lachavero, haraa nimshechet lo mechavero shennotel mimmennu ma sheeno chayyav lo, vaafillu ze lo asa alav hashshalom letzad shehaya dan binvua din emet laamitto, uchemo sheamru zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 2 78.) befasuk "ki yihye lahem davar ba elay". meatta en sibba lesinatam vachashadam beshum ofen, veen ze ella letzad heyotam chelek ra gamur veteva hara lisno hattov sina azza tivit belo sibba. meatta kol kayyotze baze mitzva leakro ulehafkia zechuto leval yifen Adonai leminchatam ki baavod reshaim rinna. vesover ani ki haanashim harshaim haelle enam bichlal adat korach shenneemar alehem (sanhedrin kach.) "morid sheol vayyaal", sheellu avda tikvatam shekkullan anaf hakkelippa, ken yovdu kol oyve Adonai.

Vayyillonu kol vegomer lemor attem vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro lemor, achar shehatteluna hi al moshe veal aharon, ma makom lomar lemor? veulay ki haam lo amru haddevarim kichtavan "attem hamittem et am Adonai", ella amru divre telunot shekkavvanat kelalut divrehem hi "attem hamittem" vegomer, laze amar vayyillonu vegomer, vechavvanat telunatam hi lemor lahem "attem hamittem" vegomer.

Od yirtze behair od ech tach merot enehem laasot teluna al moshe belo sibba, ma pisho uma chattato, uma gam achar sherau kamma hishpil atzmo lifne datan vaaviram ulay yashuvu vechulei, ze yaggid shehishtaddel leval yamutu. achen taromet haeda hayta al ma sheasa moshe hammivchan shel hakketoret bechullan yachad, shehaya lo laasot hammivchan bekorach levad, ucheshehaya Adonai ose bo hammishpat lo hayu niggashim hammatayim vachamishshim nesie eda velo hayu metim. vehu amro lemor attem hamittem vegomer, perush bemaamarchem sheamartem lahem "kechu ish machtato vegomer chamishshim umatayim", baze hamittem et am Adonai. velo hitraamu haeda al mitat korach datan vaaviram, ella al hammatayim vachamishshim shekkullan hayu rashe sanhedraot. uledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru shettaromet haeda hayta lema shetztzivvam lehaketir hakketoret shehi avoda yoter kedosha vachamura velo asa hammivchan beechad mishshear avodot, yitbaer gam ken al ze hadderech lemor attem hamittem, perush bemaamarchem sheamartem lahem lehaketir ketoret attem heyitem sibba sheyyamutu.
Vaydabber el haeda lemor. perush lemor, sheyyomar lahem shekken neemar lo mippi hakkadosh baruch hu lomar lahem:

Suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim. nitchakkem alav hashshalom lezakkotam benoam devarav, beemtzaut sheyyaarichum beerech reshaim, vehu amro haanashim harshaim, perush, sheyyihyu beenehem erech reshaim veyasuru mealehem, ki yaaminu bechilyonam veyiru pen tidbakem haraa, uvischar ze yechonnem Adonai. vahagam shekkevar nitratztza Adonai lomar lahem "healu", im kol ze hatztzaddikim chafetzim letzaddek bene doram leechol mipperi darkam.

rashi: Vayyikkach korach. parasha zo yafe nidreshet bemidrash rabbi tanchuma:

Vayyikkach korach. lakach et atzmo letzad echad lihyot nechelak mittoch haeda leorer al hakkehunna, vezehu shettirgem unkelos "veitpeleg" — nechelak mishear haeda lehachazik bemachaloket, vechen "ma yikkachacha libbecha" (Iyov 15) — lokeach otecha lehafligecha mishear bene adam. daa: vikach korach, mashach rashe sanhedraot shebbahem bidvarim, kemo shenneemar "kach et aharon" (Vayikra 8), "kechu immachem devarim" (Hoshea 14):

Ben yitzhar ben kehat ben levi. velo hizkir "ben yaakov", shebbikkesh rachamim al atzmo shelo yizzacher shemo al machlekotam, shenneemar "bikhalam al techad kevodi" (Bereshit 49), vehechan nizkar shemo al korach? behityachasam al hadduchan bedivre hayyamim, shenneemar (20 6) "ben evyasaf ben korach ben yitzhar ben kehat ben levi ben yisrael":

Datan vaaviram. bishvil shehaya shevet reuven sharuy bachaniyyatam temana shachen likhat uvanav hachonim temana, nishtattefu im korach bemachalokto — "oy larasha oy lishcheno". uma raa korach lachalok im moshe? nitkanne al nesiuto shel elitzafan ben uzziel, shemminnahu moshe nasi al bene kehat al pi haddibbur, amar korach, ache abba arbaa hayu, shenneemar (Shemot 6) "uvene kehat" vego', amram habbechor natelu shene vanav gedulla, echad melech veechad kohen gadol, mi rauy littol et hasheniyya? lo ani sheani ben yitzhar, shehu sheni leamram, vehu minna nasi et ben achiv hakkatan mikkullam, hareni cholek alav umevattel et devarav. me asa? amad vechanas rn rashe sanhedraot — rubban mishevet reuven shechenav vehem elitzur ben shedeur vachaverav vechayyotze vo, shenneemar nesie eda kerie moed ulehallan hu omer (Bamidbar 1) "elle kerue haeda" — vehilbishan tallitot shekkullan techelet, bau veamedu lifne moshe, ameru lo tallit shekkullah shel techelet chayyevet betzitzit o fetura? amar lahem chayyevet, hitchilu lischok alav, efshar tallit shel min acher chut echad shel techelet poterah, zo shekkullah techelet lo tiftor et atzmah? (tanchuma):
Bene reuven. datan vaaviram veon ben pelet:
