ohc: Vayyikkach korach vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro vayyikkach, verazal amru (Bamidbar Rabba 98) lakach atzmo letzad echad, ulederech ze chaser "atzmo", ki zichron korach hu lomar mi hu hacholek vechaser hannechlak, veim kavvanato lomar kedivre uneklos "veitpelig", en shiur tevat "veitpelig" keshiur tevat "vayyikkach", ella shehattargum mefaresh hammechuvvan. vahagam sheddivrehem emet od yesh leeloah millin ledayyek tevat "vayyikkach" al nachon. 2 yesh lehair al devar emet lamma yazkir Adonai zichron hatztzaddikim yitzhar kehat levi bemaase bilti hagun kaze uma tzorech yesh baddavar, verazal amru (sham) shehitpallel yaakov al atzmo shello yizzacher bemaase ze, mashma shetztzarich haya lizzacher ella shehitpallel, vaani mitpalle gam al otam shehizkir. 3 yesh ladaat kavvanat hakkatuv bemaamar vedatan vaaviram ma kavvanat hakkatuv bezichronam ma maasehem, im lomar sheggam hem chalku atzman, haya lo lechallan ballekicha veyomar "vayyikchu korach vegomer vedatan vaaviram", veim kavvanato lomar shekkorach lakach otam haya lo lomar "vayyikkach korach vegomer datan vaaviram" vegomer. 4 amro vayyakumu lifne moshe ma yaggid hakkatuv bekima zo, im lomar shebbau lachlok, achare chen hu omer "vayyikkahalu vegomer vayyomru" vegomer, veim lomar sheamdu bekoma zekufa lefanav, haya lo lomar "vayyakumu" achar "vayyikkahalu" al ze hadderech "vayyikkahalu vegomer vayyakumu vegomer vayyomru" vegomer, velamma hifsik ben "vayyakumu" levayyikkahalu" bemaamar "vaanashim mibbene yisrael" vegomer?

Achen nitkavven hakkatuv lehodia yesod devar hammachloket, sheyyomar adam minnayin ala al daat korach lachlok al navi neeman asher tzadku nevuato, vekorach chacham gadol haya, veech nishtatta laasot haddavar hazze, halo kol yisrael yirgemu oto aven? laze amar hatteamim shellakach bedato lavo lariv. rishona – ben yitzhar, perush heyoto ben yitzhar shehu gadol mishshene achim habbaim acharav bivne kehat veenam yecholin lehachetzif penehem kenegdo ki gadol mehem. sheniyya – ben kehat hu hammeulle shebbivne levi shehayu nosim kodesh hakkodashim, veamru razal (sota 13.) korach minnose haaron haya, veen gershon umerari yedabberu kenegdo. ben levi shehu shevet meulle mikkol yisrael, veen shear hashshevatim mekappechin oto bedabbero lifne moshe, ki meulle hu mikkol shear hashshevatim, gam mikkol bene levi, gam beanfe kehat hu madrega rishona lishne haachim habbaim acharav shehem chevron veuzziel.

Veamro vedatan vaaviram vegomer, perush, gam otam lakach kede learer gam mikkocham shehem gedole shevet reuven habbechor leyaakov, uveemtzaut ze hechshivu atzman. vayyakumu lifne moshe, perush, kima umaala behashevaa im moshe, korach lema shehu kannizkar, vedatan vaaviram letzad heyotam gedole reuven shehu gadol mikkol haachim vegam millevi. veamro vaanashim vegomer, perush, gam ellu lakach immo letzad heyotam gedole yisrael kede lechazzek zerootav, aval ellu lo bau legader ze lakum lifne moshe ella shennikhalu lehachezik divre korach vaadato, velaze hikdim lomar "vayyakumu" kodem zichron chamishshim umatayim vegomer, uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv behakedim divrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 18:2) sheamru sheikkar machlokto shel korach hu al elitzafan ben uzziel shennatan lo moshe hannesiut, vehodia hakkatuv shellakach korach maarechet hassetirot bemaase moshe. rishona taanat heyoto ben yitzhar, mimma nafshach: im atta ba achar haggadol shebbabbanim velaze natatta hakkehuna leaharon letzad heyoto ben amram, im ken mehattaam atzmo li yeot hannesiut letzad sheani ben yitzhar, sheni leamram shehu ben kehat, shehu heanaf atzmo shebba mimmennu aharon vekodem lechevron veuzziel, velamma natatta hannesiut leelitzafan? hare maasecha mochichot sheen gedulla laggadol shebbabbanim, im ken chozer haddin lema shennatan hakkehuna leaharon mittaam sheamram hu habbechor – en taam ze taam. umeatta kevan shemmatzu divre moshe seturim, im ken nichnas bivchinat devar sheker chas veshalom, vegam bichhunat aharon lo yeamnu devarav lelech bo achar hakedamat amram, ella kol shevet levi behashevaa hu, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar "ben levi".

Uletzad shechash korach shello yekubbelu taanotav ella levattel nesiut elitzafan, aval lomar sheen lachush likdimat amram leyitzhar en shomea lo, ki mudaat zot shehaggadol kodem bammaala. laze hikkif betaanat reuven habbechor lechol hashshevatim velakach gedole reuven, vehu maamar datan vaaviram vegomer bene reuven, lomar, ki im tachrichu lomar hallech achar haggadol nelech achar habbechor shebbechol haachim velo yuttan hakkehunna. veamro vayyakumu lifne moshe perush laaroch maarechet hassetirot lehappil devarav. veamro vaanashim mibbene yisrael vegomer, heviam lehaarich lifnehem hochachot merivato shello yidchennu bechoach hasserara.

Velrazal raiti sheamru (sanhedrin kat:) taam shehizkir hakkatuv zichron molidav, veze leshonam: "korach" – sheasa karcha beyisrael, "ben yitzhar" – shehirtiach et haolam katztzohorayim, "ben kehat" – shekkiha shinne molidav, "ben levi" – shennaasa levaya laggehinnom, velichshuv gam "ben yaakov" sheakav atzmo laggehinnom? yaakov bikkesh rachamim vechulei, ad kan. uveenay yippale lamma yechanne devarim haraim lishmot hatztzaddikim, velo day ze ella shemmakshe baal hadderasha "velichshuv ben yaakov" vechulei, asher lo nachon lehazekir shem mivchar haavot bederech ze. od yesh lehair beamram sheakav atzmo laggehinnom, halo kevar amar "ben levi" shennitlavva laggehinnom, velamma yichpol haddavar shete peamim?

Ulehair or tora asadder shenayim shelosha gargerim missitre tora. ha ki anfe hakkedushsha asher hechin vesidder hammaatzil baruch hu hem shevile umishpete hattora asher chakak Adonai beyad moshe avdo, vechol hammachlif seder missidro hinne hu oker heanaf hahu besod bechinat nishmato veose heanaf hahu anaf ra ki yistallek mimmennu koach hammekaddesh. veze lecha haot sod hakkarban asher yitpaggel veyechashev tame bemachshevet chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo uvenotar, veyered mikkevod kedushshato lihyot tame umechayyev ochlav karet.

2, Ki heanaf atzmo shebbo paal aven hu kodem lishloach bo yad, besod (yirmeya 2:19) "teyasserech raatech", nimtzeta omer ki anaf hakkedushsha yehafech leraa veyihye hodo lo lemashchit rachamana litztzelan.
3. Da ki bechinat hanneshamot asher nata Adonai beammo hem otiyyot hattora, kayyadua leyode chen:

4) Da ki keshebbara Adonai et haadam, bara neta echad shebbo kelulim kol anfe hakkedushsha, ucheshechata venifgam nifgemu kol hanneshamot shehayu teluyim bo, vechol sheyyatzu mimmennu pegumim hayu, ad sheyyatzta nefesh avraham avinu venitlabbena beemtzaut eser nisyonot venitbarer happesolet beyishmael, veyatzta nishmat yitzchak venitlabbena baakeda, venitbarer happesolet betigboret haesh hu esav, veyatzta nishmat yaakov belo shum dofi. vehu ma sheheirunu razal bemaamaram (bava metzia 84.) shufereh deyaakov avinu meen shufereh deadam kadmaa, ad kan, perush, shello haya bo pesolet keadam kodem shechata.

Nimtzenu omrim shehailan hu yaakov, veyatzu mimmennu shenem asar anafim, veechad mehem hu levi. anaf ze heenif shelosha anafim: gershon, kehat umerari, ukehat heenif arbaa anafim: amram, yitzhar, chevron veuzziel, veanfe yitzhar hu korach. vehinne bevo korach lehachelif anfe hakkedushsha ulehappech hakkehunna mimmekomah, nifgemu anfe hakkedushsha shebbeshoresh nishmato shehayu kullan lishvach, vehitchil mimmatta lemala. barishona heanaf atzmo shehu korach, bitchilla haya nikra korach tahor, "ben yitzhar" shehaya meir laolam katztzohorayim, "ben kehat" shehaya makhe shinne kol roe gedullato umaalato, "ben levi" shennitlavva miyyom ledato lehakkadosh baruch hu bechamma maalot. veachshav heanaf atzmo shennikra korach nifgam veasa bo karcha, velo anfo levad ella gam shoresh heanaf shebba mimmennu, shehu yitzhar, nehpach leraa keshoresh nishmato vehirtiach kol haolam kullo katztzohorayim. velo shoresh echad levad ella gam shoresh shellemala mimmennu, shehu ben kehat, nehpach leraa lehakehot shinne molidav. velo zo bilvad ella gam shoresh heanaf harishon sheyyatza miyyaakov, shoresh shel nefesh korach asher sham neekra nifgema veasta bo nekama lelauoto laggehinnom. umimma shello hizkir hakkatuv "ben yaakov", adayin shoresh harishon shehu beikkar hailan shehu yaakov lo nodu maasav im gam adav higgia happegam venimtza neekar sharsho shel korach meikkaro o lo.

Veda sheyyesh machloket razal (sanhedrin kach.) bekorach vaadato im yesh lahem chelek laolam habba. leman deamar en lo chelek laolam habba, gam sharsho beyaakov namak, vehu ma sheshshaal hashshoel "velichshuv ben yaakov", vedikdek lomar sheakav atzmo legehinnom, perush lo nitlavva levad shehu lizman muat ella ad sof haolam, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar sheakav atzmo, leshon sof vetachlit, kaakevim shehem sof techunat haadam, verazal yishtammeshu belashon ze keamram (sota mat:) "beikkevot meshicha" vechulei. veteretz lefi shehitpallel al atzmo vechulei, perush, leolam shekken hu, ella she asa nachat ruach leyaakov shehitpallel vechulei. o efshar shessover sheyyesh lo chelek laolam habba, vezo hayta tefillato shel yaakov shello yaggia koach hachet ad ikkar hashshoresh shebbeyaakov velo yinnatek chevel hakkesef meikkaro veyesh tikva leacharitam. vehu maamar hattanna (sanhedrin sham): alehem amar hakkatuv (Shmuel 1 2:6) "morid sheol vayyaal". veraiti ledakdek amro "vayyaal" velo amar "umaale" keshiur sheamar besamuch "Adonai memit umechayye", uchemo chen amar achar kach "Adonai morish umaashir". achen nitkavven lomar divre hattanna atzmo sheal adat korach hu medabber, laze amar "vayyaal", perush, kevar heela otam kodem shehoridam, shehare kadma tefillat yaakov liridatam umeaz nichtevu besefer haaliyya.

rashi: Hityatztzevu ureu vegomer. ucheshem sheal yede tefillati ani yachol leshannot et haittim, kach im paga bachem milchama, haya koach bitfillati laamod al haoyev, velo heyitem tzerichim lishol melech bechayyay, veaf al pi sheani zaken:
targum: Af kean itattadu vachazo yat pitgama rabba haden dayya aved leenechon:

rashi: Velo yihye chekorach. kede shello yihye chekorach:

Kaasher dibber Adonai beyad moshe lo. kemo alav — al aharon dibber el moshe sheyyihyu hu uvanav kohanim, lefichach "lo yikrav ish zar asher lo mizzera aharon" vego'; vechen kol li velo velahem hassemuchim etzel dibbur, pitronam kemo al. umidrasho — al korach, umahu "veyad moshe" velo chatav "el moshe"? remez lacholekim al hakkehunna shellokin betzaraat kemo shellaka moshe beyado, shenneemar "vayyotziah vehinne yado metzoraat kashaleg" (Shemot 4), veal ken laka uzziyyahu betzaraat (Divrei Hayamim 2 26):
ohc: Lemaan asher lo yikrav vegomer velo yihye vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar velo yihye vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sanhedrin 110.) shebbaa azhara lammachzik bemachloket sheover belav shel "velo yihye" vegomer. vechutz middarkam zichronam livracha nire shennitkavven Adonai latet taam lamma hutzrach lezikkaron ze velo hispik baazhara battora "lo yikrav ish zar" vechol hakkarev vegomer tivlaennu haaretz, laze amar velo yihye chekorach perush, im ani metzavve belo zikkaron ze ani choshesh shello yoil leeze adam mehem beazhara veyamut kekorach vaadato, vezikkaron ze yoil shello yesubbav lo lihyot kemo shehaya lekorach velaadato.

Kaasher dibber Adonai beyad moshe lo. perush, letzad sheamar velo yihye chekorach vegomer, mimmotza davar atta lamed shekkol haomed mikkodem learer al hakkehunna yihye lo kekorach vechaadato, vedavar ze lo matzinu shehitra Adonai ken. laze amar kaasher dibber Adonai beyad moshe lo, perush lekorach. ha lamadta shehaddevarim sheamar moshe lekorach "veim beria yivra Adonai ufatzta haadama et piha" vegomer, hayu divre Adonai beyad moshe lehateroto, velo amaran moshe meatzmo. vehu amro beyad moshe lo, perush lekorach hammuzkar besamuch.

rashi: El elohe haruchot. yodea machashavot; en middatecha kemiddat basar vadam, melech basar vadam shessorcha alav miktzat medina, eno yodea mi hachote, lefichach keshehu choes nifra mikkullam, aval atta, lefanecha geluyot kol hammachashavot veyodea atta mi hachote (sham):
Haish echad. hu hachote veatta al kol haeda tiktzof; amar hakkabbah, yafe amartem, ani yodea umodia mi chata umi lo chata (sham):
ohc: Vayyomru el elohe haruchot vegomer. amar shem el, letzad sheraa hitorrut tigboret haddinim, hizkir chesed el lemattek haddinim.

Veamro elohe haruchot lechol basar, taan taana hannishmaat lifne habbore, ki Adonai chafetz shekkol haruchot yekabbelu elohuto alehem beodam babbasar baolam hazze. vehu amro elohe haruchot, perush, haruchot hu leshon machshava veratzon, al derech amro (Yechezkel 20:32) "haola al ruchachem". veim ken, hagam shehammishpat asher yaase lechallotam kerega hu mishpat emet, uchemo shekkatavti hattaam lemala, im kol ze lefi hannire bammaase hu sheish echad yecheta veal kol haeda tiktzof, sheen kol haeda bechet ze veatta memit kullan, umeatta chas veshalom haruach temaen beelohut kaze.

Od nitkavven ledabber lefanav divre ritztzuy hammitkabbel lefanav, al pi ma shekkadam lo bidiat haderagat hachefetz sheyyesh labbore. haechad hu shevach vehallel asher yittenu lo tzeva mala, lemala mimmennu shevach vehallel asher yittenu lo nishmot hatztzaddikim mishshene otzrot hachayyim: otzar echad shel neshamot sheadayin lo bau laolam hazze, shealehem amru zichronam livracha (yevamot sav.) "ad sheyyichlu neshamot shebbagguf", veotzar sheni shel neshamot shekkevar bau laolam hazze vechazru venittenu beotzar hachayyim, vechullam notnim shir veshevach vehodaa labbore yitalle shemo besod (Mishlei 16:4) "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu". lemala mehem hashshir vehashshevach haole mehanneshamot asher hem baolam hazze, asher hem toch habbasar vehu monam mehakkir Adonai, vehem mitatztzemim leehov Adonai uleshabbecho ulehodot lemaamaro. ze elyon vechashuk etzel habbore lemala mehakkol, uchemo shemmevoarim haddevarim beharechava besefer hazzohar gam bedivrehem zichronam livracha.

Velaze nitchakkem moshe veritztza Adonai baddavar shehu chafetz bo, veamar elohe haruchot lechol basar, sheatta chafetz sheelohutecha tihye laruchot bizman shehem babbasar, veim atta memitam atta chaser ratzon ze, veen nachon lehagebir haddinim sheyyesovvu hefsed kabbalat elohutecha laruchot shebbabbasar shehu rum tachlit cheshkecha.
Veamar "haish echad yecheta", lomar shekkefi haddin en lahem chiyyuv, ki chullan lo chatu lechayyevam, ella atta ba alehem beketzef shehu tigboret haddin, vehu amro "tiktzof".
Haish echad yecheta. amar leshon atid, letzad sheadayin lo chata chet shechayyav alav mita shehi hahakrava, ki ad atta lo asa ella liglug, veim haya chozer bo en alav chiyyuv.

rashi: Asher yarimu lh' teruma. hakkatuv kerao teruma ad sheyyafrish mimmennu terumat maaser:
ohc: Ki et masar vegomer al ken vegomer. ulemala hu omer velivne levi natatti kol maaser beyisrael vegomer chelef avodatam, nire ki mattenat maaser ze shennatan Adonai lalviyyim yesh bo shene devarim: haechad chelek hannogea lahem baaretz, vehashsheni sheenam torchim baaretz laasot sheva melachot hatztzerichot ad sheyyihyu chittim memorachim. laze amar hakkatuv shene devarim: chelef chelkam baaretz vechelef avodatam, yisrael omdim veosim melachtam kede sheyyihyu mufenim laavodat ohel moed. vehinne balviyyim lo amar "ani chelkecha" vegomer, sheen haleviyyim zochim bechelek Adonai, velaze gam hem notnim chelek Adonai terumat maaser min hammaaser. vehem umaasram eno ella kischirut hedyotot lesharet hakkadosh shehu hakkohen veohel moed.

rashi: Vetochachti. niret kol hayyom tamid, mibboker levoker mitchaddeshot tzarot chadashot:
targum: Vahaveti chattish kol yoma umachsenuti letzafrire:

ohc: Kechalloto vegomer et kol haddevarim. perush, lo ichara velo kadma, ella himtina ad sheamar kol haddevarim hatztzerichin bainyan, vetechef lechalloto nivkea.

Vattibbaka haadama vegomer vattiftach haaretz vegomer. velo hispik lomar vattiftach vegomer o vattibbaka, od amar babbekia "haadama" uvappeticha haaretz. ulay ki lo haya sham pe haaretz bimkom derisat raglehem, laze nivkea haadama asher hayu omdim aleha venizdammen sham pe haaretz veniftecha, velaze keneged hammakom shehayu omdim bo amar vattibbaka haadama, ucheneged pi haaretz amar vattiftach haaretz vegomer:

rashi: Vattitten lanu. haddavar musav al "lo" haamur lemala, kelomar lo haviotanu velo natatta lanu nachalat shode vacherem; amarta lanu "aale etchem meoni mitzrayim el eretz tova" vego' (Shemot 3), misham hotzetanu, velo el eretz zavat chalav udevash haviotanu, ella gazarta alenu lahamitenu bammidbar, sheamarta lanu "bammidbar hazze yippelu figrechem" (Bamidbar 14):
Haene haanashim hahem tenakker vegomer'. afillu atta sholeach lenakker et enenu im lo naale elecha, lo naale:
Haanashim hahem. keadam hattole kilelato bachavero:
ohc: Af lo el eretz vegomer. kashe, achar sheamru lahamitenu bammidbar, ma makom lehitraem al madrega ketanna mimmenna? verashi zichrono livracha yishshev bedochak. veulay shennitkavvenu lomar sheshshelilat halichatam etzlo lo letzad geder haraa shekkibbelu mimmennu shehotziam lahamitam bammidbar, ella afillu letzad heder hattov hammuvtachim mimmennu levad, vehu amro af lo el vegomer, perush af letzad lo el eretz vegomer, letaam ze levad haene haanashim vegomer, umikkol shekken shessibbevam hakeravat hannezek.

Haene vegomer lo naale. perush, bocharim nikkur enehem mimmaala asher yuvtechu bah mimmennu. baze gillu otzem hafelagat hassina asher senua tovat hatztzaddik etzlam yoter minnikkur enehem, laze chara appo shel moshe meod:

rashi: Veim beria. chadasha:
Yivra Adonai. lehamit otam bemita shello met bah adam ad henna, uma hi habberia?

Ufotzta haadama et piha vetivlaem, az vidatam ki natzv hem et hakkabbah, vaani mippi haggevura amarti; verabbotenu fereshu: veim beria fe laaretz misheshet yeme vereshit mutav, veim lav yivra Adonai (Sanhedrin 110):
ohc: Veim beria vegomer. kafal lomar beria yivra Adonai, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 37:) befasuk "arur vechulei haadama asher patzta et piha", shemmeoto yom nistam venechtam pi haaretz, ucheshehi rotza lomar shira lifne Adonai kederech kol hannivraim sheomrim shira lifne habbore hi omeret bichnafeha, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 24:16) "mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu". vechan kesheratza moshe lehaanish harshaim hahem amar veim beria, perush, otah beria shekkevar bara Adonai shehi pi haaretz, veal yede maase nistam vehaya kelo haya, atta yachzor Adonai livro otah habberia sheyyihye lah pe, ufatzta haaretz et piha shehaya lah mikkodem uvala otam. veulay ki ze yihye lah tikkun lema sheppatzta livloa ish tzaddik, atta tiftze piha livloa oyve Adonai.

rashi: Et shor mi lakachti. laavodati:
Vachamor mi lakachti. keshehayiti holech meir leir lishpot otam al iske tzarchehem, hayiti holech al hachamor shelli, vehaya li littol mishshellahem:
Et mi ratztzoti. kol leshon meratztze hassamuch leoshek, leshon ashuk veratzutz hu, chomes dallim verotzetz:
Vealim enay bo. kede lehaalim enay min hammishpat bishvil hammamon:
Veashiv lachem. kol ma shettomru:
targum: Ha ad di ana kayam ashidu vi kodam Adonai vekadam meshicheh yat tora deman dabbarit vachamara deman shecharit veyat man ashakit veyat man anasit umiyad man kabbelit mamon dishkar ucheveshit enay bedina mineh vaatev lechon:

rashi: Vayyakrev otecha. leoto sherut shehirchik mimmennu shear adat yishorael:
ohc: Vayyakrev vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hi hahavdala sheamar bappasuk shellifne ze, uma hi hakkeriva sheamar kan? veulay shennitkavven lishte haderagot: haachat hu havedalat shevet levi meadat yisrael bederech kelal, ucheneged ze amar ki hivdil vegomer meadat yisrael, vehashsheniyya hakeravat bene kehat shehikrivam yoter mishshear haleviyyim laset kodesh kadashim. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Bamidbar 4:2) "naso et rosh bene kehat", ucheneged ze amar vayyakrev otcha veet kol achecha perush anaf hakkehatim bene levi, vedikdek lomar otcha ramaz lo shekkullan nismachin alav vehu gadol shebbechullan.

rashi: Vayyippol al panav. mippene hammachaloket, shekkevar ze veyadam sirchon revii, chateu vaegel, "vaychal moshe" (Shemot 32), bammitonenim, "vayyitpallel moshe" (Bamidbar 11), bammeraggelim, "vayyomer moshe el Adonai veshameu mitzrayim" (Sham 14), bemachalokto shel korach nitrashelu yadav, mashal leven melech shessarach al aviv, ufiyyes alav ohavo paam ushettayim veshalosh, keshessarach reviit, nitrashelu yede haohev hahu, amar ad matay atriach al hammelech? shemma lo yekabbel od mimmenni (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayyishma moshe vayyippol vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar vayyishma achar sheamar hakkatuv "vayyomru alehem", minnayin yaale al haddaat shello yishma? od tzarich ladaat ma zot nefila. venire ki letzad shehammelaglegim lo gamru gezerat hammechuvvan shel hatztzaat haddevarim, hodia hakkatuv shehevin moshe tachlit haddevarim hagam shello pershu divrehem. veamro vayyippol vegomer, neged ma sheamru shehem mitnasseim al kehal Adonai, shekkallu bedivrehem moshe veaharon. keneged ma shennogea lemoshe nafal al panav lehareot ketze haacharon hahachnaa, veshivva nafsho kaafar haaretz keeved hammishtachave lifne hasserara. ucheneged gedullat aharon amar vaydabber el korach vegomer boker vegomer, perush, lo tatzdiku devaray baze ad shettavchinu im mimmenni yatzu haddevarim im meAdonai yatza haddavar.

rashi: Kol hakkarev hakkarev vegomer'. en anu yecholin lihyot zehirin bechach, kullanu rashain lehikkanes lachatzar ohel moed, veechad sheyyakriv atzmo yoter mechavero veyikkanes letoch ohel moed yamut:
Haim tamnu ligvoa. shemma hufkarnu lemita?:
ohc: Kol hakkarev hakkarev vegomer. nitorru atta velo kodem, hagam shekkevar neemar lahem davar ze, al derech amram (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:2:3) man denachit leh chivya mechevla vechulei:

rashi: Ki himru imre el. en pureanut baa al haadam ella baavono:
targum: Arum sarivu al memreh deelaha umilkat ilaa rachiku:

rashi: Vayyomer shemuel vegomer unechaddesh sham hammelucha. lefi shebbarishona hayu orrim al haddavar, veatta nitratztzu kullam:
targum: Vaamar shemuel leama itu venezil legilgala unechadat taman malchuta:

rashi: Rav lachem. harbe yoter midday lekachtem leatzmechem gedulla:
Kullam kedoshim. kullam shameu devarim besinay mippi haggevura:
Umaddua titnasseu. im lakachta atta malchut, lo haya lecha livror leachicha kehunna, lo attem levaddechem shematem besinay "anochi Adonai elohecha", kol haeda shameu (sham):
ohc: Rav lachem ki chol haeda vegomer umaddua vegomer, perush, rabbanut gedola netaltem leatzmechem yoter meharauy, veim tomar ma hi harabbanut haggedola? ki chol haeda kullam kedoshim, veod lahem shebbetocham Adonai, ma shello hissiga umma baolam, veattem rabbanim alehem. od ramzu bemaamar ze lomar ki hashshechina shachna lichvod yisrael lo lichvod aharon, vehu maamar betocham Adonai.

Veamro umaddua vegomer, perush, lamma attem mosifin hekker harommut leatzmechem alehem? hakkavvana baze shehem omrim sheish yisrael hakkarev laggader sheomed bo aharon chayyav mita, zo yaflig hannesiut al kehal Adonai, veen rauy lezalzel kol kach bekahal kadosh kerove el elyon lefaslam levilti hakerev laavod laAdonai elohehem.

rashi: Lachen. bishvil kach atah vakal adatak hanadim ittecha al Adonai, ki veshlichuto asiti latet kehunna leaharon, velo lanu hu hammachaloket hazze (sham):
ohc: Lachen atta vechol vegomer. amro lachen hu shevua, vehashshevua hi shennoadim al Adonai, veze hu shiur haddavar: atta vechol adatcha hannoadim bishvua sheal Adonai attem noadim listor devarav, veamar ken ulay yeratu veyiradu millehachzik bammachloket.

Vayyikkach aharon kaasher vegomer. perush, samuch ledibburo shel moshe, lelammedcha shello shaha afillu rega. od yirtze, letzad shehainyan kan hu hefech haddin lehaketir ketoret chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, laze amar vayyikkach aharon, vetaam "vayyikkach" hu "kaasher dibber moshe", perush, al pi navi, veyeamen navi kesheyyomar laavor al mitzva achat mimmitzvot hattora lefi shaa, ucheeliyyahu behar hakkarmel (Melachim 1 18,30).

rashi: Beretzach beatzmotay cherfuni tzorray. nidme li keillu horgim oti, kach atzur beatzmotay (Yirmeyahu 20:9) ma shetztzorray machisin umecharfin oti:
targum: Bidkatlin garmi bizman dimcharfin yati meikay kad amrin li kol yoma an hu elahach:

rashi: Asappera el chok. amar david: chok katzuv hu, umekabbel alay lesapper zot ulehodia:
Adonai amar elay. al yede natan vegad ushemuel (Shmuel 2 7:4; Shmuel 1 3:21):

Beni atta. rosh leyisrael, hakkeruyin battora "beni vechori" (Shemot 4:22), vehem yitkayyemu al yadcha. kemo shenneemar beavner (Shmuel 2 3:18): "ko amar Adonai beyad david avdi oshia et ammi yisrael", uvishvilam atta lefanay keven, shekkullam teluyin becha:
Ani hayyom. shehimlachticha alehem:

Yelidticha. lihyot karuy beni, vechaviv alay keven bishvilam; kemo shenneemar (divrei hayamim 1 14:2) "vayyeda david ki hechino Adonai lemelech al yisrael vechi nisset malchuto baavur ammo yisrael", umatzinu bemalche yisrael hachavivin lefanav shekkeruyin banim, kemo shenneemar (Shmuel 2 7:14) bishlomo "hu yihye li leven vaani ehye lo leav". veod matzinu bedavid bemizmor 89 "hu yikraeni avi atta eli vetzur yeshuati" (tehillim 89:27):
targum: Eshtee keyama dayya amar chaviv kevar leabba li ant zakkaa keilu yoma den beretach:

rashi: Gam anochi chalila li. meachar shettaasu attem et shellachem lashuv el Adonai, gam anochi chalila li michadol mehitpallel baadchem:
targum: Af ana chas li milmechte kodam Adonai militmenaa letzalaa alechon vealef yatchon dithachun beorach takna vechashra:

rashi: Vegilu birada. keshettavo otah reada shekkatuv bah (Yeshayahu 33:14) "achaza reada chanefim", tagilu vetismechu im avadtem et Adonai:
targum: Pelachu kodam Adonai bedachala vetzalu birtita:

ohc: Gam hem gam attem. peshat hakkatuv hu gam hem keyisrael hakkerevin, gam attem baadam kemo shekkadam lomar atta vegomer tisu avon vegomer.

Verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru baarachin (arachin 11:) veze leshonam: tanya "gam hem gam attem" – attem beshellahem vehem beshellachem bemita, hem beshellahem enam bemita ella beazhara. amar abbayye: meshorer sheshshaar beshel chavero bemita, ad kan. vechatav Rashi delet leh leabbayye ha matnita dekatane "hem beshellahem enam bemita", veashkach tanna dekae kevateh, ad kan.

Verambam zichrono livracha beferek 3 mehilchot kele hammikdash katav veze leshono: o shessiyyea levi bimlacha sheenah melachto chayyav mita, shenneemar "velo yamutu", aval kohen sheavad avodat levi eno bemita ella belo taase, ad kan. vekashe lechol ma shekkatav rambam, ben ma shekkatav "o shessiyyea ben levi" vechulei, shehare lechol hassevarot shehevi baggemara lo mashma ken. im ketanna devarayta hare katane beferush hem beshellahem enam bemita, im ketanna shel maase rabbi yehoshua ben chananya, im kemo sheala al daat hattalmud sheamar tannae hi sherabbi yehoshua sover hammeshorer sheshshier beazhara velo gazru mesayyea verabbi yochanan sover bemita vegazru mesayyea, im ken ben lemar uven lemar mesayyea eno ella gezera midderabbanan, velamma pasak rambam "o shessiyyea ben levi vechulei bimlacha vechulei chayyav mita"? veim lefi ma sheddacha hashshas dechulle alma beazhara vechulei, im ken meshorer sheshshier mammash eno chayyav vechol shekken mesayyea. veim daat rambam hi keabbaye, shete teshuvot baddavar: 1 sheabbaye lo amar shessiyyea ella meshorer sheshshier, umiddivre hashshas muchach sheyyesh hefresh ben haose lamsayyea. 2 sheabbaye doresh chiyyuv laze mippasuk "vehazzar hakkarev yumat" (Bamidbar 18:7), verambam zichrono livracha katav dichtiv "velo yamutu" shehu pasuk "velo yamutu gam hem gam attem". ben ma shekkatav rambam bedin kohen sheavad avodat levi sheeno bemita kashe, ki mehabbarayta shehevi bashshas (arachin 11:) sheamra "attem beshellahem vehem beshellachem bemita", velo hevi hattalmud tanna shecholek baddavar, mashma shekken ala beyadam haddavar. velamma yachlok harambam al haggemara?

Venire ki rambam zichrono livracha tala zayneh bevarayta huvea besifre (sifre Bamidbar 116), veze leshonam: uchevar bikkesh rabbi yehoshua ben chananya lesayyea et rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda bahagafat delatot, amar lo: chazor laachorecha shekkevar atta mitchayyev benafshecha, sheani min hashshoarim veatta min hammeshorrim, ad kan. hare shebben levi chayyav al avodat ben levi acher, veanu shomin gam ken sheafillu eno ella mesayyea chayyav mita, vehu pesak rambam atzmo.

Vahagam shemmehattalmud mashma behefech, hichria harambam kegirsat sifre mishshene teamim: 1, ki ledivre hattalmud ben leka salka datach ben lema sheddacha hattalmud dechulle alma beazhara, ben lerabbi yehoshua ben lerabbi yochanan en hammeshorer yachol lihyot shoer, velo nechleku ella bimsayyea. im ken ma hu ze sheomer rabbi yochanan "chazor becha sheatta min hammeshorrim" vechulei, halo gam rabbi yehoshua yodea ze, velo haya lo lomar ella "chazor sheaf hammesayyea asur" mishshum gezerat rabbanan. veod, keshennomar shehammeshorer eno yachol lihyot shoer, ma li shoer levaddo o im acher, halo melechet hashshoarim kach hayta shehayu mitkabbetzim bichnufeya lahagafat shearim veliftichatam, vechullan nikraim shoarim. velichshennomar shemmeshorer sheshshier chayyav mita, ben shier levaddo ben shier im acherim. vetalmud arachin (arachin 11.) shehevin shehammesayyea mishshum gezera, lefi girsat habbarayta shehayta lo shello huzkar bah "shekkevar atta mitchayyev benafshecha", vehuksha lo lehattalmud bamme cholkim rabbi yehoshua verabbi yochanan, vehuchrach leyashshev machlaktam bederech ze, velomar shemmin hattora en issur ella levaddo velo mesayyea, vachachamim hu sheggazru mesayyea, uvaze nechleku rabbi yehoshua verabbi yochanan. aval lefi girsat sifre afillu mesayyea asur min hattora, vehassevara mesayyaat.

Vahagam shebbechol kayyotze baze en anu holchim ella achar girsat habbaraytot hammuvaim baggemara, veen anu choshshin lenusach habbaraytot zulatam, umikkol shekken ledavar shebba mevoar baggemara kemo ma shellefanenu sheomer hashshas beferush mesayyea gezera, kan yesh taam nachon baddavar, ki hare lefanecha abbayye sheomer beferush naktinan meshorer sheshshier beshel chavero bemita, ze yatzdik girsat sifre sheamar lo rabbi yochanan sheatta mitchayyev benafshecha, ki lefi girsa shehevi hattalmud dechuya hi daat abbayye kemo sheddacha hattalmud, vahagam shehashshas hiksha leabbayye vedacha devarav, lo haya bifne abbayye lomar sheittotav, veillu haya omed abbayye vadday shehaya mevi mehahi shehuvea bassifre.

Veod hitztzatzti mibben rise enav shel abbayye sheal otah shel sifre nata ohel appadno, mimma shehochiach chiyyuv mita lammeshorer sheshshier mippasuk "vehachonim" vegomer, shehu mimma shehochichu babbarayta shel sifre, sheamar sham achar shehevi hahi shel rabbi yehoshua ben chananya vechulei, veze leshonam: rabbi omer: eno tzarich, shehare kevar neemar "al tachritu" vegomer, meavoda lachavertah minnayin? talmud lomar "vehachonim lifne hammishkan" vegomer, uma talmud lomar "gam hem gam attem"? lefi shebba korach veirer al aharon hizhir hakkatuv et kol hainyan, ad kan. hinne devabbarayta shel sifre huvea hadderasha sheamar abbayye, ella shebbabbarayta lo nitparesh ikkar hallimmud minnayin, uva abbayye uferesh shemmissof hakkatuv hu doresh, degamar omer "vehazzar hakkarev yumat" bemay medabber hakkatuv vechulei, ella bezar deotah avoda, ad kan. umeatta bechayyotze baze matzinu lomar shehaamoraim lo hayu bekiim babbaraytot, velaze hattalmud lo yada girsat habbarayta kemo shehuvea bassifre, sheillu yedaah lo haya doche divre abbayye, gam lo haya omer mesayyea mishshum gezera. vetimtza shekkatvu hattosafot sheafillu bemishnayot nuchal lomar shello hayu bekiim, veze kefi hattayat haiyyun letzad hahechrechot veachar mishkolet tzidde hahattaya vehainyan ze sheanu danin alav. veda ki baraytot hassedurot bammechilta, sifra vesifre hem mezukkakot veenam kishar hattoseftot, velaze pesakah rambam.

Venishar lanu lefaresh lefi ze bamme cholkim rabbi yehoshua verabbi yochanan, venire ki rabbi yehoshua haya sover shello neesar ella meavoda kalla laavoda chamura, kemo shoer leshorer, aval meshorer leshoer shehi avoda sheose hammeshorer atzmo kesheyyigdal veyitkalkel kolo, uchemo shekkatav ramba""40 sham beoto perek atzmo, savar rabbi yehoshua sheyyachol asot. laze satar rabbi yochanan sevarato veamar lo: "chazor becha sheani vechulei veatta" vechulei. perush, en adam yachol laasot avodat chavero ella kol echad lema shennitmanna, vaani nitmanneti lihyot shoer veatta lihyot meshorer, veen adam ose davar shello nitmanna alav. velaze nitchakkem ramba""40 za""30 ufasak perat din ze sham veamar veze leshono: shello yesayyea hammeshorer lashshoer velo hashshoer lammeshorer, ad kan, lishlol sevarat rabbi yehoshua shehaya sover keshebba lesayyea rabbi yochanan.

Shuv shavti ledakdek divre rambam kede shello yihye hefech sevarat haggemara bedin hammesayyea, ki shene mine mesayyea hem: echad mesayyea baavoda sheyyesh bah shiur leotah avoda levad mimmennu, kegon shehayu shoarim hatztzerichim leotah haddelet uva lesayyea, hazze eno chayyav ella midderabbanan. vehashsheni mesayyea lehashelim hatztzerichin leotah avoda veze chayyav min hattora. velaze hattalmud mechamat yishshuv sevarat Rabbi yehoshua, lefi haggirsa shehayta lefanav, savar shehayu shoarim hammaspikim leotah avoda, velaze savar rabbi yehoshua lesayyea sheen issur baddavar. aval lefi girsat sifre sheamar lo "atta mitchayyev benafshecha", muchrachim anu lefaresh shello haya shiur maspik lashshoarim lehagif haddelatot. velaze dikdek rambam bidvarav veze leshono: haleviyyim vechulei muzharim shello yaase echad melechet chavero, shello yesayyea hammeshorer vechulei, ad kan. hinne mimma sheddikdek lomar "melechet chavero" velo amar "bimlechet chavero" yaggid shemmesayyea ze nichnas bechelek mehaavoda hammeyuchedet lachavero, vegamar omer "shello yesayyea", perush, vegeder ze hu sheani oser lecha bo hassiyyua, velaze lo amar "veshello yesayyea", vehaven.

Nimtzenu omrim ki hammesayyea baavoda sheen bah tzarche avodatah chayyav mita, kedaat rambam vechivrayta desifre, veen setira mehashshas laze. ella shennishar ladaat tamo shel rambam zichrono livracha lamma lo hochiach chiyyuv mita lelevi meshorer sheshshier mippasuk "vehachonim vegomer vehazzar hakkarev yumat", kemo sheamar babbarayta shel sifre uchedivre abbaye kemo shekkatavti lemala, vehalach lachzor achar pasuk acher shennire middevarav shehu pasuk "al tachritu mishpechot hakkehati" shebbesof parashat bammidbar. ki sham neemru shene maamarim shehevi harambam bifrat din ze: haechad "ish ish al avodato" vegomer, vesheni "velo yamutu". vahagam shekkatav "veal massao" uvefasuk "al tachritu" neemar "veel massao", bevadday shettaut sofer hu, ki lamma yanniach ma shenneemar bappasuk shebbo amar "velo yamutu" veyelech lechappes achar pasuk shebbefarashat naso, ki sham neemar "veal massao" vesham lo neemar "veyamutu". ella vadday tzarich lehaggiah beharambam "veel massao". vihi ma, kashe lamma nata middivre tannaim vaamoraim.

Venire ki harambam lakach derashat tanna sheddarash mippasuk "gam hem gam attem" al ze hadderech: gam hem – leviyyim al avodat hakkohanim, gam attem – kohanim al avodat leviyyim. umeribbuy tevat "gam" shello haya tzarich lomar ella "hem veattem", mizze doresh chiyyuv lelevi haoved avoda sheenah shello. uma shekkatav rambam "o shessiyya levi vechulei chayyavin mita, shenneemar velo yamutu", hu ma shenneemar befasuk "velo yamutu gam hem gam attem". uderasha zo mode gam ken rabbi, hagam sheamar "eno tzarich", hare gamar omer "ma talmud lomar gam hem vegomer, lefi sheirer vechulei chazar hakkatuv vehizhir" vechulei, hare shehitzdik derashat tanna kamma. vahagam sheabbayye darash mippasuk "vehazzar hakkarev" shehi derashat rabbi, kevan shennitgalla lanu sheen rabbi machchish bidrashat "velo yamutu" kannizkar, bachar harambam birayat "velo yamutu" shehi yoter meforeshet midderashat "vehazzar" vegomer shedderashatah beim eno inyan", shehakkatuv bemoshe veaharon neemar, dichtiv "vehachonim kedma mizracha moshe" vegomer, vehammaskil yavin sheenah derasha meforeshet, laze bachar rambam lehavi besifro mippasuk "velo yamutu gam hem" vegomer:

Uma shehevi reaya leazharat meavoda laavoda mippasuk "ish ish al avodato veal massao", mippene shezzulat ze minnayin lanu azharat meavoda laavoda sheyyavo aleha haonesh? uminnayin yaale mechush haissur bedavar ze lefaresh maamar "velo yamutu" al im meshorer sheshshier? laze hevi pasuk "ish ish al avodato veal massao". veefshar ki rabbenu (287) mefaresh divre rabbi shekkatavti lemala, veze leshono: eno tzarich, shekkevar neemar "al tachritu" vegomer, shechozer al inyan hakeravat Rabbi yehoshua lesayyeo bahagafat shearim, shehare neemar "al tachritu" vegomer vesham neemar "ish ish al avodato" vegomer. uma sheamar levassof "meavoda laavoda minnayin" eno chozer al haazhara ella al hachiyyuv – minnayin shechayyav mita, uchefi ze divre harambam hem divre rabbi, vehu zichrono livracha mevi besifro hadderasha hayyoter mevoeret:

Ulederech ze gam ken tzarich lehaggiah bedivre harambam "veel massao". uma sheppasak rambam shekkohen sheavad avodat levi eno chayyav mita, nire ki dan lefi ma shekkadam lanu shetztzarich hakkatuv lichtov haonesh vehaazhara, vechan befasuk ze lo neemra azhara umita ella livne levi, shekken katuv "lo yikrevu velo yamutu". vahagam sheggamar omer "gam hem gam attem" vehosif hakkohanim behaamur, en hechreach shechozer hakkatuv lishnayim leazhara vechiyyuv mita, veen lanu lomar ella al haazhara ba, kevan shello neemra azhara lakkohanim al avodat haleviyyim ella kan. veen ze hekkesh lomar "en hekkesh lachatzain", veyachol lehitparesh al ze hadderech: "gam hem" – al ma shehuzkar besamuch, "gam attem" – yesh lachem azhara al haddavar. veod, mimma sheamar rabbi "eno tzarich", velo neemar "gam hem gam attem" ella bishvil sheirer korach – mizze atta lamed sheen kan mita lechohen haoved avodat levi, sheim lo chen hare tzarich vetzarich, ki mikrae shehevi rabbi lo hevi bahem chiyyuv mita lechohen baavodat leviyyim ella azhara, kammuvan sham mehabbarayta. ella vadday shello ba maamar "gam attem" ella leazhara, velaze gam ken lo amar tanna desifre ella "kohanim al avodat leviyyim minnayin", velo amar "kohanim anushim umuzharim al avodat leviyyim minnayin" kemo shehitchil lomar balviyyim:

Uma sheamru babbarayta shehuvea baarachin "attem beshellahem vehem beshellachem bemita", velo hevi hashshas barayta hammenaggedet lah, shezze yaggid shebbarayta zo hayta muskemet levaale haggemara, omer ani ki keshennaamod al omek hassugeya mimmenna nachriach lalechet bedarko shel rambam, vehu ki sham mesayyem beotah barayta veze leshonam: hem beshellahem enam bemita ella beazhara, uferesh Rashi: hem beshellahem – levi meshorer shehegif delatot, ad kan. vekashe li lema shemmakshe hashshas besamuch ledivre abbaye sheamar meshorer sheshshier bemita, veze leshonam: metive, meshorer sheshshier veshoer sheshsharar enam bemita ella beazhara, vechulei ad kan. kashe lamma mechazzer hattalmud livrayta acheret lehakeshot ledivre abbaye velo hiksha mibberayta shellefanav mammash sheamra "hem beshellahem enam bemita". veod kashe perat ze shel levi meavoda laavoda hechan huzkar sheyyomar alav eno bemita ella beazhara, halo tanna lo ba ella lefaresh maamar "gam hem gam attem", umimma nafshach im sover hattanna lidrosh mippasuk ze gam levi meavoda laavoda, sheggam ze nichlal bemaamar "gam hem gam attem", im ken hammishpat shennaase bechohen sheavad avodat levi naase belevi sheavad avodat levi acher kevan sheshshenehem kelalam habbore bemaamar ze.

Veim tomar sheen lehacheriach mippasuk ze ella azhara, kemo chen gam ken en lechayyev hakkohen baavoda shel levi, ella muchrach atta lomar sheen tanna doresh issur levi baavodat chavero mippasuk "gam hem gam attem". im ken tanna ehecha kae sheomer hem beshellahem, ella vadday shezze yachriach lomar ki tevat "hem" taut hu vegarsinan bimkomah "attem", veze perusho: hem beshellachem bemita veattem beshellahem enam bemita ella beazhara. gam chaser mehabbarayta "hem beshellachem", ki leheyot shehammadpis raa shete tevot kefulot "hem beshellachem" vehem beshellachem" savar shehu kefel, laze hishmit achat mehem. veze hu nusach habbarayta al nachon: "gam hem gam attem" – attem beshellahem vehem beshellachem, hem beshellachem bemita, attem beshellahem enam bemita ella beazhara. velaze lo matza hattalmud lehakeshot leabbayye mibbarayta zo sheen bah zichron shete avodot leviyyim, vehiksha mibbarayta acheret. gam baze yihye sefa devarayta bidrashat hakkatuv "gam hem gam attem" shehevi hattanna, veamar ki haleviyyim beshel kohanim bemita, aval kohanim beshel leviyyim enam ella beazhara, vehattaam kemo shekkatavti beferush divre rambam. umeatta ala pesak rambam vesifre uvarayta daarachin bekane echad.

rashi: Veishshafta ittechem. etvakkach immachem:
targum: Uchean itattadu veitvakkach imchon kodam Adonai yat kol zachvata dayya daavad imchon veim avahatchon:

rashi: Vayyomer Adonai el aharon. lemoshe amar sheyyomar leaharon, lehazhiro al takkanat yisrael shello yikkanesu lammikdash:
Atta uvanecha uvet avicha. hem bene kehat avi amram:

Tisu et avon hammikdash. alechem ani mattil onesh hazzarim sheyyechetu veiske haddevarim hamkuddashim hammesurim lachem, hu haohel vehaaron vehashulchan uchele hakkodesh — attem teshevu vetazhiru al kol zar habba ligga:
Veatta uvanecha. hakkohanim:
Tisu et avon kehunnatchem. sheenah mesura lalviyyim, vetazhiru halviyyim hashogegim shello yiggeu alechem baavodatchem:
ohc: Atta uvanecha uvet avicha. perush bet avicha nire beenay shebba al moshe shehu meaviv, sheggam alav baa haazhara, deillu al hakkehatim halo kahem kishar yisrael behachenasat mishkan Adonai. veod mimma sheamar besamuch "vegam et achecha vene levi" vegomer yaggid shead atta lo haya medabber bahem. ella nire perush bet avicha ze moshe, ucheman deamar (zevachim kav.) shello paska kehunna mimmoshe, vaafilu leman deamar shello nitkahen moshe ella beshivat yeme hammilluim sover ani shello neesar likkanes limkom derisat ragle hakkohanim. verazal amru (sifre) veze leshonam: "bet avicha" ellu haleviyyim, melammed shehaleviyyim muzeharim al yede hakkohanim, ad kan leshonam. veze derech derash lidrosh bakkatuv hahalachot shehayu lahem missinay.

Ittach vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar ittach achar shehizkir aharon beferush. veulay shebba lomar shebbechol zeman muzharim yachad, leval tomar sheyyesh zeman shechayyav aharon veyesh zeman shechayyavim banav, talmud lomar ittach lomar shemmuzharim yachad bechol hazzemannim.

rashi: Nashsheku var. zarzu atzmechem bevar lev. (nusach achar) nashsheku var. arnishment belaaz, umenachem patar oto leshon taava kemo "veel ishech teshukatech" (Bereshit 3:16):
Pen yeenaf. pen yiktzof:
Vetovdu derech. keinyan shenneemar "vederech reshaim toved" (tehillim 1:6):
Ki yivar kimat appo. ki verega muat yivar appo alechem pitom, veotah shaa ashre kol chose vo – yihyu nikkarim ishshure hachosim bo:
targum: Kabbilu ulefana dilma yirgez utehovdun urecha metul deyechor kizer rugezeh tuveh lechol desavrin bememreh:

rashi: Vayyakhel alehem korach. bedivre letzanut, kol hallayla hahu halach etzel hashevatim ufitta otam — "kisvurin attem shealay levaddi ani makpid? eni makpid ella bishvil kullechem, ellu vain venotelin kol haggedullot, lo hammalchut uleachiv hakkehunna" ad shennitpattu chullam (sham):
Vayyera chevod Adonai. ba beammud anan:
ohc: Vayyakhel alehem vegomer. perush shello nikhalu lirtzonam, ella korach hikhilam, uchefi ze yaggid hakkatuv shevach haeda. o yirtze latet taam lemaamar Adonai shebba achar kach hibbadlu mittoch haeda vegomer vaachalle otam, veyomar haomer im korach vaadato chatu elle hatztzon lamma yichlu, laze hikdim veamar ki nikhalu lirtzon korach ulechibbato, velaze nirim kachafetzim bemaasav, velaze amar Adonai hibbadlu vegomer vaachalle otam.
Vayyera chevod Adonai vegomer. nitgallet shechinato yitbarach lechol haeda, kede sheyyakkiru ki hu haose mishpat katuv, vehu habborer harauy lesharet lefanav.

rashi: Yatzeu nitztzavim. bekoma zekufa — lecharef ulegaddef, kemo (Shmuel 1 17) "vayyityatztzev arbaim yom" degolyat (tanchuma):

Uneshehem uvenehem vetappam. bo uree kamma kasha hammachaloket, shehare vet din shel matta en oneshin ella ad sheyyavi shette searot, uvet din shel mala ad esrim shana, vechan avedu af yoneke shadayim (sham):
ohc: Vayyealu meal vegomer vedatan vaaviram yatzu vegomer. yodia hakkatuv otzem resha hakkelippot, sheafillu achar sherau sheyyisrael yaru lenafsham pen tidbakem haraa asher timtza et datan vaaviram, af al pi chen yatzu nitztzavim. umizze nitraggesh moshe veamar bezot tedun vegomer, perush, kevan sheraa shello hirgishu datan vaaviram mehahergesh sheasu yisrael shealu missaviv, veadrabba yatzu bekoma zekufa, dan moshe bedato bevadday ki harshaim choshvim beraatam ki moshe ose devarim ellu middato betachbulot vearmot, lomar lahem lehitrachek kede sheyyiru veyechattu velo middivre Adonai, laze amar bezot tedun ki Adonai shelachani laasot et kol hammaasim haelle, perush, afillu perate devarim ellu. vehitna ki millevad sheyyamutu, od lahem sheyyamutu mita meshunna mikkol hammitot, uvesamuch yitbaer od.

rashi: Vayyomer ed. bat kol yotzet veomeret: 'ed, veze echad mishshelosha mekomot shehofia ruach hakkodesh bevet din shel matta, kidita bemassechet makkot (23:2):
targum: Vaamar lehon sehed memra dayya bechon vesahed meshicheh yoma haden are la ashkachtun bidi midaam vaamaru sahid:

rashi: Healu. ketargumo, histalleku missevivot mishkan korach:
ohc: Dabber el haeda lemor. amar dabber leshon koshi beinyan ze sheeno ella tova lehatztzil nafsham, lehaggid ki yakpid Adonai al harotze lachavol beatzmo shello laalot, laze ba devar melech shilton lehachericho laalot leval yafsidu atzman shehem nichse shamayim. veamar tevat lemor paam sheniyya velo hispik bema shekkadam lomar vaydabber vegomer lemor, letzad sheamar dibbur leshon koshi hodia ki koshi ze atzmo hu lerommut am segulla sheyyakpid Adonai al chesronam. od nitkavven betevat lemor sheen chiyyuv lomar belashon ze atzmo healu vegomer ella belashon sheyyihye hammechuvvan bo healu vegomer vaafillu yomar belashon acher. velaze timtza shello amar "healu" ella "suru na" vegomer, uvimkom sheyyomar "mishkan korach" vegomer amar "meal ohole haanashim harshaim haelle":

rashi: Koder. leshon shacharut, kemo "vekadar alehem" (Micha 3:6):
targum: Emar leelaha ruchetzani lema ashlitani lema bekivla ezil bidchuk bael devava:

rashi: Ki matte echad. aapi shechillaktim lishte mishpachot, mishpachat kehunna levad uleviyya levad, mikkol makom shevet echad hu:
ohc: Veet shem aharon tichtov al matte levi vegomer. mimma shello tzivva mikkodem lakachat matte lematte levi, yaggid ki hu bichlal hashshenem asar mattot sheamar besamuch shenem asar mattot umatte levi bichlal hashshenem asar. veefshar lomar shekkacha asu, shellakchu etz echad vechillekuhu lishnem asar chalakim, vechol shevet lakach shiva mikkeshura, veen hefresh ben shel aharon leshel kullan, shebbaze yitzdak hammivchan. uvaze yeduyyak maamar hakkatuv vayyittenu elav kol nesiehem vegomer umatte aharon betoch mattotam, perush, chelek echad mittoch haetz shemmimmennu lakchu mattotam. shuv ba leyadi maamar razal (Bamidbar Rabba 18,23) sheamru kidvarenu.

rashi: Vayyaamod ben hammetim vegomer'. achaz et hammalach veheemido al korcho, amar lo hammalach, hannach li laasot shelichuti, amar lo moshe tzivvani leakkev al yadecha, amar lo ani shelucho shel makom veatta shelucho shel moshe, amar lo en moshe omer kelum millibbo ella mippi haggevura, im en atta maamin, hare hakkabbah umoshe el petach ohel moed, bo immi usheal, vezehu shenneemar vayyeshev aharan el moshe; daa, lamma vakketoret? lefi shehayu yisrael melizim umerannenim achar hakketoret lomar sam hammavet hu — al yado metu nadav vaavihu, al yado nisrefu chamishim umatayim ish — amar hakkabbah, tiru sheotzer maggefa hu vehachete hu hammemit (Mechilta Shemot 17):
ohc: Vayyaamod ben hammetim vegomer. yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (tanchuma, tetzavve 15) sheamru shettefaso lammalach hammashchit umenao mehashechit, umana hammumatim leval yosif alehem, vehu amro vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim, perush shehigbil mispar hammetim mibben hachayyim leval yosif hakkot od. velaze amar vayyihyu hammetim bammaggefa arbaa asar elef usheva meot, lomar elle hem sheamdu bemispar hammetim, vatteatzar hammaggefa, shello yosif od hakkot al mispar ze.

rashi: Vahem. adatecha:
ohc: Atta vechol adatcha heyu vegomer. kashe, haya lo lomar atta vechol adatcha veaharon vegomer, uvaze lo haya tzarich lachzor velomar atta vahem. ulay shennitkavven lehazemin hannoadim lavo machar levarer haddavar, venitkavven baze leval yihyu nishmatim miyyom el yom veyitrabbu alehem meohave hammachloket, laze ratza lehachericham lavo machar lifne Adonai. asher al ken lo hizmin ella habbaim bammachloket, korach vaadato, ma sheen ken aharon, ella shehizkiro sheyyikkach machtato immahem.

Od yirtze lomar sheyyachinu atzman bikdushsha uvetahara, kede sheyyihyu reuyim lihyot lifne Adonai, vehu maamar heyu lifne Adonai. veulay ki laze natan lahem zeman veamar machar, uvifrat ze lo shittef immahem aharon ki muchan veomed hu, ella shehizkiro achar kach veamar atta vahem veaharon sheggam hu yihye immahem. vahagam shekkevar amar lahem haddevarim atzman lemala, dichtiv "kechu lachem machtot vegomer lifne Adonai machar", lefi shehochicham bidvarim achare chen veamar lahem "hameat mikkem vegomer rav lachem bene levi" vegomer, tochen haddevarim yaggid hafekiyyut ma sheamar mikkodem. laze keshello kibbelu hattochachat chazar lomar devarim harishonim laasot mivchan hakketoret.

rashi: Vaani hinne natatti lecha. besimcha, leshon simcha hu ze, kemo "hinne hu yotze likratecha veraacha vesamach belibbo" (Shemot 4); mashal lemelech shennatan sade leohavo, velo chatav velo chatam velo heela vearkain, ba echad veirer al hassade, amar lo hammelech kol mi sheyyirtze yavo viarer lenegdecha, hareni chotev vechotem lecha umaale vearkain, af kan, lefi shebba korach veirer keneged aharon al hakkehunna, ba hakkatuv venatan lo 24 mattenot kehunna bivrit melach olam, velchach nismecha farasha zo lechan (sifre):
Mishmeret terumotai. sheatta tzarich leshomran betohora:
Lemoshcha. ligdulla (sham):
ohc: Vaani hinne natatti vegomer. taam amro vaani, nitkavven lomar ki bead ma shehittalti alechem laset avon hammikdash vegomer, gam ani kevar hikdamti latet lachem bead ze mishmeret terumotay lechol kadshe bene yisrael.

rashi: Halo ketzir chittim hayyom. vehaggeshamim siman kelala, vekashe beene hakkadosh baruch hu lehavi puranut chinnam, af al pi chen yesh bi koach, veekra el Adonai veyitten kolot umatar:
Udeu ureu. ki lo heyitem tzerichim lishol melech lezalzel bi:
targum: Hala chatzad chitin yoma den atzale kodam Adonai veyitten kalin umitra udeo vachazo are vishatchon sagia daavadtun kodam Adonai lemishal lechon malka:

rashi: Boker veyoda vegomer'. atta et shichrut hu lanu velo nachon leheraot lefanav, vehu haya mitkavven lidchot shemma yachzeru vahem (sham):
Boker veyoda Adonai et asher lo. laavodat leviyya:
Veet hakkadosh. lichhunna:

Vehikriv. otam aliv; vehattargum mochiach ken "vikarev lokodamohi", "yekarev leshimmusheh"; umia bakar, al moshe, gevulot chalak hakkabbah beolamo, yecholim attem lahafoch boker leerev? ken tuchelu levattel et zo shenneemar "vayhi erev vayhi voker vayyavdel" (Bereshit 1), kach "vayyibbadel aharon lehakdisho" vego' (20 23):
ohc: Boker veyoda vegomer. taam amro "boker" vegomer velo asa hammivchan beoto zeman atzmo, ulay shekkevar naasa ketoret shel ben haarbayim shebbo hammivchan. od shello yachsheduhu sheasa hammivchan bizman bilti hagun shehu ben haarbayim sheeno zeman haratzon, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha bazzohar hakkadosh (Zohar 10 39:) shehu zeman tigboret haddinim. od nitkavven baze ish haelohim latet lahem zeman hallayla lehitbonen bemaasehem, ulay yakkiru ki lo tov osim veyachzeru bitshuva, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Bamidbar Rabba 18,7) teamim acherim lamma ikkev ad boker, ellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

Et asher lo veet hakkadosh vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar et asher lo veet hakkadosh, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Zohar Bamidbar 176:) "asher lo" – zo leviyya, "hakkadosh" – zo kehunna, vetzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lehazekir inyan halleviyya kevan shello iraru ella al hakkehunna. ulefi ma shepperashti ki korach lakach gedole shevet reuven immo betaanato shettachzir haggedulla labbechor shebbaachim, laze huchrach lehashiv gam al hachalukka zo.

Od yitbaer behair od lamma kafal lomar veet asher yivchar bo yakriv elav, achen yirtze al ze hadderech letzad shebbeiruram yesh shene panim: haechad ki aharon eno rauy kol kach ki yesh bahem gedolim vetovim mimmennu, vehashsheni sheyyeshno lechayyotze bo baam haruyim laamod lesharet immo. laze keneged ma shennogea lichhunnat aharon sheyyesh rauy mimmennu amar et asher lo, perush, asher mezumman lo laavodato mittechillat habberia, al derech amro (Yirmeyahu 1:5) "beterem etztzarcha vabbeten" vegomer, veet hakkadosh perush, achar sheyyatza laolam kiddesh atzmo veasa atzmo keli rauy lesharet bakkodesh. vedikdek lomar vehikriv lirmoz shekkevar hikrivo vehishra shechinato al yado. ucheneged hammuvan mehem shertzonam lehosif alav amar veet asher yivchar bo yakriv elav, im yesh reuyim kayyotze beaharon laamod gam ken lesharet – yakriv elav:

rashi: Yerubbaal. ze gidon:
Bedan. ze shimshon, shemmishshevet dan ba:

Veet yiftach. hare shelosha kalle olam, im shelosha chamure olam, moshe veaharon ushemuel, lomar lecha, hakkal bedoro, kechamur bedoro, kol bet din hammitmanne al haddor, tzarich lelech acharav keillu hu abbir shebbaabbirim:
targum: Ushelach Adonai yat gidon veyat shimshon veyat yiftach veyat shemuel veshezev yatchon miyad vaale devavechon mischor sechor vitevtun lerochatzan:

rashi: Vechapper alehem. raz ze masar lo malach hammavet kesheala larakia, shehakketoret otzer hammaggefa, kidita vemassechet shabbat (Daf 89):
ohc: Kach et hammachta. leheyot sheamru ki sibbat hasserufim hayta bishvil haketarat hakketoret shehu sibbev mitat am Adonai, laze hera lahem ki hagam shehakketoret haya chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, adrabba atzar hammita meal yisrael, uvaze yatzdiku ki hakkol maase Adonai ki hu memit lachayyav been sovev. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (shabbat 89.) ki davar ze lemadu mism baaloto lekabbel tora.

rashi: Vehayta yad Adonai bachem uvaavotechem. kelomar vehayta bachem achar shehayta baavotechem, verabbotenu amru (yevamot 63 2): bachem uvaavotechem, chittute shechave, vehi makkat bizzayon al hammetim:
targum: Veim la tekabbelun lememra dayya utesarvun al memra dayya utehe mechata dayya bechon kema dahavat baavahatchon:

ohc: Vayyaas moshe kaasher vegomer ken asa. taam shekkafal haddavar yirtze al ze hadderech: vayyaas kaasher tzivva Adonai vegomer, perush techef umiyyad keshetztzivvahu velo icher, kaasher tzivva Adonai perush lehashiv ken asa, uchefi ze maamar kaasher nimshach lemala ulematta.

rashi: Hachattaim haelle benafshotam. shennaasu fosheim benafshotam, shennechleku al hakkabbah:
Rikkue. redudin:
Fachim. tassim meruddadin, tyndysh balaz:
Tzippuy lammizbeach. lemizbach hannechoshet:
Veyihyu leot. lezikkaron — sheyyomru, ellu hayu meotan shennechleku al hakkehunna venisrefu:
ohc: Hachattaim haelle benafshotam. ulay shennitkavven lehotzi millibbam leval yidagu al heyot haddavar besibbatam. gam leval yachshov adam miyyisrael ki hem hayu lahem sibba, laze amar hachattaim haelle benafshotam perush, shehem chibbelu beatzman vechisseru nafsham velo haya lahem sibba mizzulatam. veaf al pi chen matzinu shello hirgishu yisrael bechavvanat Adonai bidvarim ellu vayyillonu al moshe vegomer attem hamittem et am Adonai (Bamidbar 17:6).

Ki hikrivum lifne Adonai vayyikdashu. perush, taam sheani metzavvecha leharim hammachtot, lo shennitratztzeti bakketoret shehikrivu lefanay, ella bema shehikrivum, perush, legufan shel machtot, vekodem shennatnu alehem ketoret asher hi zara umeusa etzli kevar nitkaddeshu hammachtot, vehu amro vayyikdashu, umide dahava kemakriv kele chesef uchele zahav lammikdash shehem kodesh. vehagga atzmecha im hammakrivin hayu nimlachim vechozrim bahem velo hayu notnim hakketoret al haesh, mi hayu yotzin hammachtot lechullin? umeatta lo mippene shennatnu hakketoret alehen yatzu hammachtot mikkedushshatan. uma shettaan ramban keneged Rashi veze leshono: ze dome lezar sheasa kele sharet lehaketir bachutz – alav amar hakkatuv "hikrivum lifne Adonai" beohel moed, perush, shehikdishum vehevium lammakom hammekuddash.

rashi: Vaani zakanti vasavti. amru rabbotenu: zikna kaftza alav, kidita bemassechet taanit (5:2):
targum: Uchean ha malka medabber bereshechon vaana kashish vesavet uvenay ha inun imchon vaana halechet kodamechon mizeray ad yoma haden:

rashi: Panay velohay. hakkadosh baruch hu, shehu or panay velohay, adayin yesh li bo tikva, velamma tehemi?
targum: Ma titmakkechin nafshi uma tirgeshi alay orichi lelaha arum tuv ashabbechine befurekaneh demin kodamoy di hu elahi:

rashi: Vayyishlach moshe vegomer'. mikkan sheen machazikin bemachaloket, shehaya moshe mechazzer acharehem lehashlimam bedivre shalom (Sanhedrin 110):
Lo naale. pihem hichshilam, sheen lahem ella yerida:
ohc: Vayyishlach moshe likro vegomer. nitchakkem baze ledabber immam beyichud shello bishat havvaad, ulay yarviach datam echad leechad, gam beemtzaut hachashivut asher hu machshivam ledabber alehem mikkelalut hannoadim yitrakkech libbam lehattot ozen. vedikdek hakkatuv lomar vayyishlach moshe likro vegomer shello haya tzarich lezichron moshe veyismoch al zichrono besamuch, ella lehair mi hu hashsholeach – moshe melech yisrael unevi Adonai – likro lishne hedyotot, ulay baze yitashshetu lehattot aznam elav.

Lo naale vegomer hameat vegomer. amro lo naale, lefi ma shepperashti shennitchakkem moshe laasot lahem maala ledabber immahem beyichud, amru: en anu chafetzim bemaala zo sheatta machshiv otanu lishloach acharenu. gam nitkavvenu bemaamar ze lomar shehagam sheshshelichut ze yihye lahanaatam laasot lahem eze kavod umaala, af al pi chen lo naale, moasim hem otah hammaala asher tavo lahem mimmoshe.

Venatnu taam ledivrehem, veamru hameat ki heelitanu vegomer, perush, hakatan davar ze sheasita lanu sheheelitanu? perush, asita lanu haddavar begeder haalaa vechavod bitziat mitzrayim, vehaya tachlit haaliyya yerida meeretz zavat chalav udevash shehayinu sham lahamitenu bammidbar, im ken maalotecha enam ella hashepalot viridot. veamru ki tistarer vegomer, perush, en taamcha bechol hainyanim ella lehistarer, lo lehetiv lanu. gam bishlichut ze sheatta sholeach acharenu lo letovatenu atta mitkavven ella lehistarer, vehu amro gam histarer. gam nitkavvenu bechefel tistarer gam histarer lomar ki seraruto shel moshe hi kefula umechuppelet mehasserara shehayta alehem kodem tzetam mimmitzrayim, veze shiur haddevarim ki tistarer alenu beribbuy hasserarot, vehu amro gam histarer. veulay sheramzu lo gam ken shehu chafetz lehitakkev bammidbar lehameshich hasserara shel atzmo, lefi ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 5,23) ki malchuto shel moshe lo hayta omedet ella bammidbar, velaze amru gam histarer.

Vayyashav aharon vegomer vehammaggefa neetzara. chazar lomar vehammaggefa neetzara achar shekkevar amar "vatteatzar hammaggefa", lomar sheafillu achar shekkala anan hakketoret veshav aharon el moshe nishara hammaggefa atzura, shello tomar shello neetzra ella kol zeman shehaya ole anan hakketoret al derech amro (Shemot 17:11) "kaasher yarim moshe yado" vegomer:

Od yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (tanchuma, korach 12) sheamru shello kibbel hammashchit meaharon sheamar lo "ani shelucho shel makom", ad shehevio el petach ohel moed veshama mippi hashshechina. vehu amro vehammaggefa, perush, malach hammashchit nikra maggefa, gam hu hechlit leheatzer. velaze dikdek lomar vehammaggefa neetzara, ulemala amar vatteatzar hammaggefa, perush hayta lah menia meaharon aval hu lo haya rotze limmana, ma sheen ken achar kach gam hammaggefa hiskima lihyot neetzara.

rashi: Bechol makom. afillu bevet hakkevarot (sham):
ohc: Ki sachar vegomer chelef vegomer. chazar lomar haddevarim atzman sheamar lemala, lefi sheamar vaachaltem oto bechol makom shehu chullin gemurim, laze natan hattaam ki en bemaaser ze shum kedushsha katteruma o kaddome lah, ella mamon chol sheamar Adonai leyisrael lifroa lachem sechar avodatchem, umeatta ma kedushsha yesh bo.

Verazal (sifre Bamidbar 122.) amru shebba hakkatuv lomar sheim avad yittol, veim lo avad lo yittol. mikkan amru ben levi shekkibbel alav kol haavodot chutz meechad en lo chelek balleviyya, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.
Chassalat parashat korach

rashi: Vechelek lo yihye lecha betocham. af babbizza (sham):
ohc: Beartzam lo tinchal vegomer. besifre amru sheasar alav chelek haaretz vechelek habbizza, velaze kafal lomar lo tinchal vechelek lo vegomer, vechavvanat hakkatuv hi shehagam sheyyirtzu yisrael lachlok lo chelek immahem lo yomar shello nitkavven Adonai ella liftor yisrael mechelek aharon aval im yirtzu hare ellu meshubbachim, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sheviit 10,9) hammachzir chov bashsheviit ruach chachamim nocha hemennu, laze amar lo tinchal, veshomea ani davka nachalat haaretz hu sheyyeshnah belav aval chelek habbizza eno beissur, talmud lomar vechelek vegomer. vedikdek lomar betocham al derech amro (Mishlei 1:14) "goralcha tappil betochenu", perush, littol chelek keechad mehem hu sheasar alav, aval im ratzu lishloach lo doronot hare ze mekabbel mehem.

Ani chelkecha vegomer betoch bene yisrael. amro ani, perush ma shehu meyuchad li ani yihye chelkecha, vechazar uferesh ma hu haddavar, veamar betoch vegomer, sheen lecha davar sheosim yisrael sheen lehakkadosh baruch hu chelek immahem venotlo hakkohen, bitvuot haaretz, beferot hailan, ballechem, babbasar, bayyayin, bashshemen, ushear hachd mattanot.

Herommu mittoch vegomer. perush, lo al moshe veaharon hu medabber, ella al otam shello hayu bichlal hammallinim, vehaed hanneeman amro vaydabber vegomer lemor uferush laacherim, vedikdek hakkatuv lomar hazzot lehareot baetzba bammallinim lishlol zulatam sheenan bichlal hakkillayon. uvaze nityashshev lamma hutzrach lomar herommu vahare yachol Adonai lehamit rasha lifne tzaddik kemaase harigat bechore mitzrayim. ulefi devarenu sheal shear haam shello hayu bichlal hammallinim hu omer, lefi shehayu bichlal gezerat hammeraggelim yesh tzorech baddavar lehitrachek leval tifga bahem middat haddin. umaamar keraga perashti (Bamidbar 16:21).

rashi: Vihyitem gam attem. vetitkayyemu leorech yamim gam attem gam hammelech:
targum: Im tidchalu kodam Adonai vetiflechun kodamohi utekabbelun lememreh vela tesarvun al memra dayya vetehevun af attun veaf malka dimlach alechon batar pulechana dayya elahachon:

rashi: Veatta melachim hasekilu. nevie yisrael anshe rachamim, umochichim ummot haolam lasur meraatam (tanchuma, balak 1), shehakkadosh baruch hu poshet yad larshaim velatztzaddikim:
targum: Ucheden malchaya askilu kabbilu marduta negide ara:

rashi: Sheal mimmenni. hitpallel elay bechol et sheatta ba lehillachem beoyvecha:
targum: Vee mini veetten nichse ammaya achsantach vaachudatach shiltone seyafe ara:

rashi: Vahashikkoti. kemo "vayyashokku hammayim" (Bereshit 8), "vachamat hammelech shachacha" (Ester 7):
ohc: Vehaya haish asher evchar bo vegomer. velo hispik kol ma sheasa Adonai bekorach, ulay shehayu choshvim ki ma sheera lekorach hu al sheddibber neged moshe vechalak alav, vaAdonai yinkom nakam al kevod nevio neeman beto, uleolam efshar sheyyivchar bishar hashshevatim lesharto, laze tzivva Adonai laasot mivchan hammattot.

rashi: Im amarti asappera chemo. amar asaf: im amarti belibbi lesapper et hakkol kemo shehu, kol ma sheammo omer al zot:
Hinne dor banecha vagadti. kelomar asim otam bogdim ureshaim:
targum: In amaret ishtai dichmathon ha al dar benayich arsheit:

rashi: Laasot et kol hammaasim haelle. sheasiti al pi haddibbur, latet leaharon kehunna gedola uvanav segane chehunna, veelitzafan nesi hakkehati:
ohc: Bezot tedun vegomer ki lo millibbi. tzarich ladaat ech yachshov moshe leam Adonai sheadayin lo heeminu bo linvi emet? od lamma kafal lomar lo millibbi? veulay ki tzad hachashad haya al ze hadderech, ki letzad shemmatza moshe chen beene Adonai, keshehaya moshe chafetz latet gedulla leechad mikkerovav, kegon hakkehunna leaharon vehannesiut leelitzafan vechaddome, haya ose venimlach baAdonai vehaya Adonai maskim al yado, o haya chafetz vechoshek belibbo latet leachiv vechaddome vaAdonai natan lo taavat libbo, aval lo letzad sheyyesh ikkuv baddavar ki hu ze harauy lakkehunna. laze amar bezot tedun ki Adonai shelachani laasot et vegomer, lo shehayiti ose vehu maskim al yadi lema shehayiti chafetz bedati. ucheneged chashash hashsheni shehaya choshek belibbo al haddavar, amar ki lo millibbi, perush, lo hayiti ani chafetz baddavar vaAdonai maskim al ma shebbelibbi. veshiur tevat ki hu al ze hadderech: taam sheeni tzarich lehochiach she shelachani lishlol sheani ose ma shello hiskim Adonai alav, ella lishlol shello millibbi hayu haddevarim kannizkar, vehaven.

Im kemot kol haadam. perush, al derech amram befasuk "asher yaase otam haadam" afilu goy (bava kamma lach.), vechan nitkavven lomar sheafilu bemitat haummot shehi mita menuvvelet, ze beerech hammita atzmah. ucheneged hagguf amar ufekuddat kol haadam vegomer, al derech amro (Melachim 2 9:34) "pikdu et haarura vekivruha", kevura kederech kol haaretz. lo Adonai shelachani, perush, ella millibbi, vaAdonai lo micha bi. veim beria vegomer, shebbaze tihye lahem mita raa veyovdu guf kenefesh.

Dabber el bene yisrael vekach meittam. amro dabber vegomer vekach meittam shennire shehem shene inyanim, letzad sheyyetzav Adonai al yisrael lehavi hammattot veal moshe lakachat meittam, laze amar dabber vekach, vahagam shello hizkir havaat yisrael, remazah bechoach vav shel vekach. od nire taam amro vekach betosefet vav lehosif al inyan rishon millevad zichron hammachtot asher asaum rikkue fachim vegomer, od kach meittam vegomer lehareotam ki beaharon bachar lo yah.

Meittam vegomer meet kol nesiehem. taam shehutzrach lomar meittam velo hispik lomar "meet kol nesiehem", leakkev shello yikkach hammattot ella meittam velo yikkach moshe baadam. veim haya omer "kach meet nesiehem matte matte" lo hayiti mitchayyev lomar shehem yaviu, vehayiti omer shehu haddin sheyyikkach moshe bishvilam ushelucho shel adam kemoto, o hayiti omer shekkavvanat amro meet nesiehem vegomer sheyyihye mishshellahem uleolam moshe yikkach, laze ba maamar meittam leikkuv. vetaam haddavar kede shello yihye makom lomar ki moshe bachar lahem etz lo yitzlach.

rashi: Asher asa et moshe veet aharon. lihyot nechonim lishlichuto, lehotzi avotechem mimmitzrayim:
targum: Vaamar shemuel leama Adonai daavad gevuran al yede moshe veaharon udeasek yat avahatchon meara demitzrayim:

rashi: Vehikravtem ish machtato. hachamishim umatayim ish shebbachem:
ohc: Chamishshim umatayim vegomer veatta veaharon vegomer. kol ze meyuttar, shekkevar amar atta vechol adatcha vegomer veaharon. veim ratza lomar cheshbon kullam, lemala kesheamar "adatcha" sham haya lo lomar matayim vachamishshim, velo haya tzarich lachzor ulehazkir atta veaharon. veulay shennitchakkem lomar shello yitarev korach im hammatayim vachamishshim ella beyichud im aharon, veasa chen kede shello yihye makom lattoim achar korach lomar ki devakatto haraa letzad heyoto im ribbuy maktire hakketoret, aval im haya bifne atzmo haya keaharon. laze amar lo veatta veaharon bifne atzmechem ish machtato. vahagam shekkullan hikrivu yachad, im kol ze naasu shete kittot – kat achat korach veaharon, vechat sheniyya matayim vachamishshim ish.

rashi: Baavur shemo haggadol. asher yatza shemo alechem shehu moshiachem, ulemaan lo yitmaet shem gadlo:
Hoil Adonai. nishba, kemo (Shmuel 1 14:24): "vayyoel shaul et haam":
targum: Are la yarchek Adonai yat ameh bedil shemeh rabba are raava kodam Adonai lemebad yatchon kodamohi leam:

rashi: Veamru echa yada el. echa nuchal lomar sheyesh dea behakkadosh baruch hu, vetorato emet?
targum: Veyemrun hechden yeda elaha veit mandea beilaa:

rashi: Yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. yavo haor vitzavve Adonai chasdo lanu:
Uvallayla. bachoshech hatztzara:

Shiro immi. tehe chaniyyato betochenu, shira leshon chaniyya, kedimtargeminan "vayyichan" (Shemot 19:2) "ushera". zo lamadti mittoch masoret haggedola shechibber et ze im "vayhi shiro chamishsha vaalef" (Melachim 1 5:12), bealfa beta shel shete tevot hachalukim befitronan, limmed sheen ze leshon shir. umidrash haaggada potro leshon shir, vechach hu potro: shekkach yisrael omrim lehakkadosh baruch hu, zachrenu ma sheasita lanu bemitzrayim, mitzva achat shetztzivvitanu bayyom beerev pesach ushemarnuha, uvallayla gealtanu vesharnu lefanecha et hahallel, veachshav harebe mitzvot ani shomeret, veal zot omra leel sali lamma shechachtani vegomer:
targum: Yemam yifkod Adonai tuveh uvelelya tushebachteh imi tzelota leel di natir chayay:

ohc: Vayyerdu vegomer sheola. perush, shello shalta bahem haaretz lehargam, ella nisharu chayyim venittena haaretz befikkadon legehinnom, vehu amro chayyim sheola velo amar lishol. vahagam shekkol teva shetztzericha lamed bitchilla hittil lah hei besofah, im kol ze lo lechinnam yaase chen, vichavven sheachar sheyyardu lishol natan Adonai bahem koach velo metu, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 100.) shehakkadosh baruch hu noten koach barshaim lekabbel ansham, kemo chen ellu nisharu chayyim achar shehayu bishol atzmah kede sheyyirbe haregashatam. veim haya omer "lishol" haya nishma shello hayu chayyim ella ad haggaatam lishol uvehaggiam metu velo haya lahem chayyut achar shehiggiu lishol.

rashi: Teroem. terotztzem:
Beshevet barzel. hi hacherev:
Tenappetzem. teshabberem, vehu leshon nafotz bechol hammikra: cheres hammeshubbar lishvarim dakkim:
targum: Tetabberinun hech bechutera defarzela hech man difchar titreinun:
Vaazalu kol ama legilgala veamlichu taman yat shaul kodam Adonai begilgala unechisu taman nichsat kudeshin kodam Adonai vachade taman shaul vechol enashe yisrael ad lachada:
Vela tistun mibbatar pulechaneh vela tiflechun letaavata deinun lema velet behon hanaa vela meshezvin are lema inun:
Uzeiku kodam Adonai vaamaru chavna are shevakna yat pulechana dayya ufelachna yat bealaya veyat ashterata uchean shezvana miyad baale devavana veniflach kodamach:
Yehodun kodam Adonai metul chasdeh umishtaan perishvateh livne nasha:
Afkinun mechashocha vetula demota veshalshelvathon yitra:
Vaamar shemuel lechol yisrael ha kabbelet lememrechon lechol di amartun li veamlechet alechon malka:
Vaamar shemuel leama la tidchalun attun geramtun yat kol bishta hada beram la tistun mibbatar pulechana dayya vetiflechun kodam Adonai bechol libbechon:
Vetabbar beleuta libbehon atkilu velet desaid:
Vaamaru kol ama lishmuel tzale al avdach kodam Adonai elahach vela nemut are osifna al kol chovana bishta lemishal lana malka:
Vetzalu kodam Adonai bidayek lehon mimikathon parkinun:
Veitneshiu yat pulechana dayya elahahon umesar yathon beyad sisra rav chela dechatzor uvida diflishtae uvida malka demoav veagichu kerava behon:
Kad al yaakov lemitzrayim uzeiku avahatchon kodam Adonai ushelach Adonai yat moshe veyat aharon veappiku yat avahatchon mimitzrayim veotivinun beatra haden:
Ukera shemuel kodam Adonai vihav Adonai kalin umitra beyoma hahu udechal kol ama lachada min kodam Adonai umippitgame shemuel:
Uchean ha malka deitreitun di sheeltun veha mane Adonai alechon malka:
Vaamaru la ashaktana vela anastana vela kabbelta miyad enash midaam:
Vachazetun are nachash malka divne amon ata alechon vaamartun li la elahen malka yimloch alana vaAdonai elahachon malkechon:
Beram dechilu min kodam Adonai vetiflechun kodamohi bikshot bechol libbechon are chazo yat deasge lemebad imchon:

bart: Birkat hashir. it deamre nishmat kol chay, veit deamre yehallucha Adonai‏ kol maasecha. venahagu lememrinhu letarvayhu:

Ben shelishi larvii lo yishte. shello yishtakker veshuv lo yuchal ligmor et hahallel. veim tomar kevar meshukkar hu, shehare shata chol retzono betoch hasseuda. yayin shebbetoch hammazon eno meshakker, veshelleachar hammazon meshakker:
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. kegon eved shel shene shuttafim veshichrero echad mehen. i nammi, shekkibbel rabbo mimmennu chatzi damav veshichrer chetzyo beotan haddamim:
Tikkantem et rabbo. sheeno chaser kelum:
Lissa shifcha eno yachol. mippene tzad cherut shebbo:
Bat chorin eno yachol. mippene tzad avdut shebbo:
Kofin et rabbo veosehu ven chorin. vehu haddin im haya eved shel mea shuttafin veechad mehem shichrero, shekkofin et kullam leshachrero:
Beer achav. lo itperash hechan hu, veha ka mashma lan demayim chayyim hen:
Umearat pamyas. meara hassemucha lair dan shemmishsham yarden yotze. uvilshon yishmael korin ledan 132:
Rabbi yehuda omer hare hi vechezkat mutteret. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ad shettitztzal. ad sheyyachzeru hammayim tzelulim kidmeikkara. veen halacha kerabbi yishmael:
Mevarech al hayyom. battechilla kiddush hayyom veachar kach bore peri haggafen. shettechilla kadash hayyom veachar kach ba hayyayin, ucheshem shekkadam lichnisa kach kodem livracha:
Mevarech al hayyayin. techilla. vehu haddin limkaddesh al happat, shehayyayin o happat gormim lekiddush hayyom, sheim en lo yayin o fat lo yekaddesh:

Tzelochit. keli shennotnim bo hammayim hamekuddashim leachar shehishlich haefer letochan, karuy tzelochit, vehakkeli shennotnim bo hammayim kede lekaddeshan kodem sheyyittenu vahen haefer, karuy shoket:
Mayim kol shehen. sheenan kesherim lehazzaa:
Yazze shetayim. sheim mazze achat, shemma en kan min hakkesherim. aval ki mazze shetayim, i efshar delekka vachada minnayhu min hakkesherim. vehazzaa enah tzericha shiur:

Vachachamim poslim. kasavre hazzaa tzericha shiur veen mitztarfin hahazzaot. vahalacha kachachamim. verambam peresh, yazze shete hazzaot veyashlichem chutz lakkeli veyishshaer hashshear me chattat kesherim. ufelia hi veenay, divferek kol hazzevachim baggemara [daf 80] mashma kemo shepperashti:
Yannichenna vachamma vehattal ole. shedderech hattal laalot keneged hachamma. vechen hu omer (Shemot 16) vayhi vabboker vattaal shichvat hattal. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Yeare vechulei. merik ma shebbetoch hakkeli, veeno chasher lehanniach bo me chattat ad sheyyenaggev min hammashkim ume ferot:
Yeare veeno tzarich lenaggev. deim ita denishar mimmennu vakkeli haya rishshumo nikkar:
Me chattat. bimkuddashin ayre. aval mayim sheenan mekuddashin share, kidkatane sefa:
Efer chattat. afillu efer atzmo belo mayim:
Lo yaavirem benahar uvisfina. degazzur mishshum maase veadam echad shehaya maavir me chattat veefer chattat bisfina vayyarden venimtza chazzayit met tachuv bekarkaitah shel sefina:
Velo yeshitem al pene hammayim. dedame lisfina. vechen lo yaamod betzad ze shel nahar veyizrekem letzad sheni, degam ze dame ketzat lisfina:
Aval over hu. beraglav:
Bammayim. im me chattat shebbeyado:

Over hu hattahor lechattat. ben bisfina ben shat al pene hammayim, veeno choshesh. vechen nose veyado o meshit al pene hammayim keli shehu tahor latet bo me chattat keshehu rekam, o sheyyesh bo mayim sheadayin lo nitkaddeshu veefer para. shello gazru ella al hammayim hamekuddashim veal haefer bilvad, lo al haadam vehakkelim hattehorim (umayim sheenan mekaddeshin):

Shennittelu chippuyav. rabbotay pershu milleshon chafe potachat [shabbat daf 81], shehem hashshinnayim habboltim min hammaftechot shennohagim laasot beeretz yishmael, af kan regilim laasot bakkisse shel kalla kemin shinnayim boltim kede sheyyismechu alehen. verambam peresh chippuyav, pittuchin vetziyyurin sheosim meetzim o meavanim umadbikin otan bechisse hakkalla:
Bet shammay metammeim. deakkatti chazi lishiva:
Uvet hillel metaharin. delo chazi lechalla, vehave kenishbar:

Af malben hakkisse tame. kelomar af malben hakkisse bifne atzmo belo hakkisse uvelo chippuyav tame. kol shekken shehakkisse belo chippuyav tame. malben, tzurat levena merubbaat osin al hakkisse veyoshvin alav:
Kisse shekkevao vaareva. hevi kisse mimmakom acher ukevao baareva derech yeshivato. vaareva enah temea midras, dachazya lelisha velo leshev aleha:
Bet shammay metammein. delo batel kisse legabbe areva:
Uvet hillel metaharin. mimmidras, devatel kisse legabbe areva. aval kisse heasuy beguf haareva atzmah, modu bet shammay levet hillel detahor:
Shammay omer. af kisse heasuy baareva atzmah teme midras:
Kol hassefek tahor litruma. kol safek sheim nolad oto safek bitruma hatteruma tehora, im nolad kayyotze vo bechattat, tahor:

Vechol hattaluy litruma. vechol safek sheim nolad bitruma tolin lo ochlin velo sorfin, im nolad kayyotze vo bechattat, yishshafech haefer o hammayim hamekuddashim. uvemassechet tohorot perek hazzorek tuma, teninan lehu lassafek hattahor velassafek sheal yadav tolin bitruma:
Im asu al gabbav tohorot. im hizza veefer ze shennitma vassafek hattaluy litruma, veasa tohorot al yede otah hazzaa, tolin otam tohorot velo ochlin velo sorfin:
Harfafot. kemin sevachot shel etz:
Tehorot lekodesh litruma ulechattat. lefi sheenan kelim vegam enan reuyin lemidras:
Haradot. etzim sheenan mehuddakim yafe ze vaze uchesheadam nishan alehem roadim umitnaneim:
Temeot lechattat. peamim sheadam yoshev alehen ureuyin littamme moshav. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Ochel parud. kegon tzibbur shel egozim batnim ushekedim, shekkeshehen nifradim ze mizze en bahem kabbetza shehu shiur tumat ochalim letamme acherim:
Eno mitztaref. veim hen temeim venagu bahen tohorot keshehen tzevurin enan mitztarfin ze im ze letamme hattohorot, kevan sheen bechol echad mehen bifne atzmo keshiur tumat ochalin:
Asimon. asuy kemiddat hammatbea hayyotze, ella sheadayin lo tavu alav tzura. veen podin bo maaser sheni, dichtiv (Devarim 14) vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha, davar sheyyesh alav tzura:

Matbilin yadayim lachattat. mi shennaga boochalin umashkin temeim vechayyotze bahen middevarim shemmetammein et hayyadayim veen metammein kol hagguf, hare ze matbil yadav bilvad, vechasher ligga beme chattat ulehazzot meefer happara al hattame:
Im nitmeu yadav nitma gufo. vetzarich tevila lechol hagguf, demaala asu beme chattat sheim nitmeu yadav nitma gufo, ma sheen ken bitruma vekadashim:

Min hammodiit. shem makom rachok miyrushalayim mahalach chamishsha asar milin, vehu shiur mahalach adam benoni bime nisan vime tishre, shehayyamim vehallelot shavim, mehanetz hachamma ad ben haarbayim, shehu sheat hakeravat hakkarban:

Chutz leaskuppat haazara. afillu haya karov lirushalayim vechala venitakkev velo higgia leaskuppat haazara ad sof sheat hakeravat hakkarban, niddon bedin derech rechoka. verabbi akiva sover sheen lo ella din neenas, aval lo din derech rechoka, hoil vehaya min hammodiit velifnim. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Lefichach nakud al Adonai. shel rechoka. ani shamati lidrosh, rachok chamesh ammot measkuppat haazara, sheafillu eno rachok ella chamesh ammot bilvad besof sheat [hakeravat] hakkarban, niddon bedin derech rechoka:

Metamme et me chattat. vaafillu leachar shettaval, im lo taval leshem chattat keillu lo taval, ditnan beferek en dorshin (chagiga daf 18) taval lekodesh vehuchzak lekodesh asur bechattat. aval mishshettaval leshem chattat, afillu tevul yom deorayta sheppasul litruma ulekodesh, kasher lechattat, ditvul yom kasher befara:

Umazze me chattat bemagga uvemassa. uveha kulle alma lo felige. aval beezov hammuchshar lekabbel tuma, umishshum deochel hu tzarich hechsher sheyyavo alav mayim, vechen bemayim sheenan mekuddashim veomdim lekaddesh, ucheli rekam hattahor veomed kede lehanniach bo efer chattat, beha felige rabbi meir vachachamim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ir shel zahav. ateret zahav asuya kemin ir tzurat yerushalayim. velo chayshinan dilma shalfa umechavveya veatya laatoye arba ammot birshut harabbim:

Umafriche yonim. min mimmine hassechok. im takdim yonatcha leyonati etten lecha kach vechach. perush acher, shemmegaddel yona melummedet lehavi yonim labbayit baaleha, veyesh bahen gazel mishshum darche shalom velo gazel gamur:
Safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tahor. mishshum detuma overet hi veenah nacha bammakom, hilkach sefeko tahor vaafillu birshut hayyachid:

Masmer hashshulchani. shehashshulchani tole bo kaf hammoznayim. verabbotenu pershu, masmer kevua baammud shellifne hashshulchani lehaamid bo terise hachanut. umetaharin rabbanan mishshum detashmisho im hakkarka:
Vearon shel garosot. haosim gerisim shel pol barechayim shellahem, yesh lahen kemin aron shel etz:
Even hashshaot. even sheyyesh bah kavvim ureshumim alehem shemot hashshaot vetachuv bah masmer uvo mechavvenim et hashshaot. vekorin lo belaaz 267, uvaaravi 78:
