Rabbi tzadok metamme. oto aron, detorat keli alav:
Vachachamim metaharin. dichli etz heasuy lenachat hu veeno asuy littaltel. verabbi tzadok savar, peamim metakkenim oto letaltelo. veen halacha kerabbi tzadok:

Shenayim shennitarvu fischehen. reuven veshimon shennitarvu fischehen, reuven moshech lo echad veshimon moshech lo echad. reuven holech umamne immo echad min hashshuk, veomer kol makom shehu fesach shelli hare atta nimne alav, ureuven ba lo etzel pesach shemmashach lo shimon, veshimon ba lo etzel pesach shemmashach lo reuven, vechach omer lo reuven lihuda hannishar al pesach shemmashach lo shimon, im shellecha hu fesach ze, sheyyafe berer lo shimon techilla, hare yaday meshuchot mishshelli vahareni nimne immecha al ze, veim shelli hu fesach ze, shello chivvanti mittechilla livror yafe veen ze fesach shennimneta alav im shimon, hare yadecha mesullakot mishshellecha, vehimmane immi al ze. ulechach hutzrach kol echad lehamenot immo echad min hashshuk, sheim bau lehatenot keshehen yechidim velomar im shelli hu fesach ze veshellecha shellecha hare yafe vararnu, veim lav hare ani moshech yadi mishshelli venimne al shellecha. nimtza cheshehu moshech mishshello hare hu manniach et pischo belo vealim, sheadayin lo nimna alav acher, veha lekka lememar sheyyimmane chol echad al shel chavero kodem sheyyimshoch yado mishshello, deen nimnin al shene fesachim keechad, veen ze menuyav:
Hattame omed. metzora omed tachat haohel o tachat hailan:

Vetahor over. derech sham. safek naga safek lo naga, o safek heehil hailan vehaohel al shenehem venitma hattahor, safek lo heehil velo nitma, hare safek echad. o shehaya hattahor omed vehametzora over, ze safek sheni:
Tuma birshut hayyachid vetohora birshut harabbim. kegon chanut happetucha lirshut harabbim, safek nichnas safek lo nichnas:
O shettohora birshut hayyachid vehattuma birshut harabbim. hare shene sefekot acherot:
Rabbi yehoshua metamme. desavar hoil ureshut hayyachid meshuttefet bisfek tuma zo, have sefek tuma birshut hayyachid usefeko tame:
Vachachamim metaharin. desavre hoil usefek tuma birshut harabbim meshuttefet bah, have sefek tuma birshut harabbim usefeko tahor. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Lo yochlu mimmennu zavin. degabbe tame lanefesh ketiv ish, dedarshinan minneh ish nidche veen tzibbur nidchin, (aval gabbe ziva, af tzibbur nidchin):

Veim achlu peturim mikkaret. deochel kadashim betumat hagguf, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) kol tahor yochal basar, usemich leh vehannefesh asher tochal basar kulei‏ vetumato alav venichreta, basar hanneechol lattehorim, temeim chayyavin alav mishshum tuma, vesheeno neechol lattehorim, kegon pesach habba vetuma, en temein chayyavin alav mishshum tuma:

Af al biat mikdash. poter hazzavin vehazzavot, im nichnesu lammikdash peturim keshehappesach nidche mippene hattuma, dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh, bizman shettemee metim mishtallechin, zavin umetzoraim mishtallechin, en temee metim mishtallechin, en zavin umetzoraim mishtallechin. vetanna kamma lo daresh likra lehachi, dechullehu itzterichu lechallekam mimmachanotehem. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Efer kasher. efer para hakkasher lehazzaa:
Shennitarev beefer mikle. beefer kira:
Holchim achar harov letamme. im rov efer para, metamme. im rov efer mikle, eno metamme:
Veen mekaddeshin bo. vaafillu rov efer chattat, en mekaddeshin bo, hoil venitarev bo efer kira, vaafillu chol shehu:
Rabbi eliezer omer mekaddeshin bechullan. desavar rabbi eliezer lo vainan shiura behazzaa, vei efshar deleta fureta meefer chattat. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Ellu moshchin lahem echad. min happesachim. veellu moshchin lahem echad:
Echad. mibbene chavura zo ba lo etzel bene chavura zo, veechad mizzo ba lo etzel zo:
Vechach hem omrim. leoto yachid habba etzlam:
Im shellanu hu. oto happesach shemmashachnu elenu, yafe vararnu et shellanu, hameshech yadcha mishshellecha vehimmane immanu al shellanu:

Im shellecha hu fesach ze. hare atta alav, veyadenu meshuchot mishshellanu vihe livne chavura haacheret, venimninu al ze shellecha. nimtza im hechelifu hare nimshechu chol hachavura mishshellahem venimnu al oto shebberru. vechach omrim bene chavura hashsheniyya layyachid habba etzlam. veal karcham tzarich echad meellu lavo etzel ellu velimmanot immahen, velo amrinan yimshechu ellu mishshellahen bechol makom shehu veellu mishshellahen veyachzeru veyimmanu ellu al echad veellu al echad, mishshum deamrinan babberayta vaggemara deasur limmashech kol bene hachavura min happesach ulehannicho belo vealim, veshemma hechelifu verotzim limshoch mippischam velimmanot al acher, kesheamru hare yadenu meshuchot mishshellanu hare notar pesach belo vealim miyyad, veze asur. veachshav kesheechad mechavura zo ba etzel haacheret mimma nafshach en kan pesach belo vealim, im yafe verru lahem hare chol bene chavurato alav chutz min haechad shepperash mehen umashach yado, veim hechelifu hare halach echad mehem im pischo, ucheshemmashchu hannotarim yedehem hemennu, nishar hu alav:

Vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha. bene adam, shennitarvu fischehen. kol chavura vachavura moshchin lahem echad min happesachim, vachamishsha anashim shebbechol chavura vachavura mitchallekin [lachamishsha] fesachim, sheim hechelifu lo yehe chan pesach, sheen echad mibbealav harishonim alav:

Vechach hem omrim. keshennaasu atta hachavurot hachadashim omrim haarbaa laechad, im shellecha hu fesach ze hare yadenu arbatenu mesullakot mearbaa fesachenu bechol makom shehem venimninu immach, vechen hu ushelosha chozrin veomrin lashsheni, vechen haarbaa lechol echad shebbachavura. vechol chavura vachavura ken:
Chotzalot. machtzelaot asuyot miggemi vechayyotze bo, veyesh lahem safa saviv:
Temeot teme met. shehare yesh lahen bet kibbul. aval lo tumat mishkav umoshav, lefi sheen reuyot lishchiva velo lishiva:
Vachachamim omrim midras. dachazu nammi lishchiva:
Hakkeliot. chutin maase avot:
Tehorot. sheenan chashuvot arig veen ze beged:
Chutz mishshel galgilon. hakkeliot shel avnet shechogrim bo, shebbeged hu chashuv:
Kullam temeot. dechullam chashuvim beged, chutz min hakkelia sheosim mochre hatztzemer likshor bah aguddot shel tzemer:
Melilot. shibbolim shello bashlu kol tzarkan, vetoanan baavanim umashke zav mehen vetovel bo:

Yigmor. meachar sherissekan vechittetan meerev shabbat, yigmor veyochal beshabbat. velo dami lemashkim shezzavu sheasurin gezera shemma yischot, dehacha afillu yischot lekka issura deorayta, mishshum demashkim atu mimmela:
Lo yigmor. kede leechol leachar shekkiddash hayyom, daasurin kishar mashkim shezzavu. vahalacha kerabbi yishmael:
Happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim. shehaya machalif sela shebbeyado venotel perutot lehotziam letzarche seuddat maaser:
Bet shammay omrim. im ba lehachalif kol hasselaim shebbeyado bemaot yachalif:

Uvet hillel omrim, lo yachalif ella chetzyan. shemma lo yishhe bair ad sheyyotzi et kullan, veyafkidem bair ad regel acher, vehapperutot mitappeshot. veim yachazor veyachalifem bislaim nimtza shulchani mistakker shete peamim umaaser sheni nifsad:
Haddanim lifne chachamim. shimon ben azzay veshimon ben zoma vechanan hammitzri:
Bishlosha dinarim kesef uvedinar maot. hassela hu arbaa dinarim, ucheshebba lehachalif hassela lo yikkach ella bedinar echad perutot, ushelosha dinarim yihyu kesef:
Uvirviit kesef birviit maot. bedinar revii shel kesef lo yikkach ella birviito maot shel nechoshet ushelosha chalakim kesef, shennimtza lokeach maot echad mishshishsha asar besela bilvad:

Arbaa aspere chasef. haddinar chamishsha aspere, umatbea hu beeretz yavan shead hayyom korin lo aspero. nimtza hassela esrim aspero. keshehu mechallel bedinar yechallelennu al arbaa aspero kesef veaspero echad nechoshet. nimtza lokeach nechoshet echad meesrim besela bilvad:

Yannichenna vachanut veyochal kenegdah. lo yechallel kelal al perutot, shemma yishkach veyaase otan chullin. ella yanniach hassela etzel hachenvani veyochal kenegdah ad shettichle. vahalacha kedivre bet hillel bilvad:

Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim heid. millisrof et habbasar shennitma bivlad hattuma. bevalad shel valad kaamar. habbasar shehu shelishi, shennitma bevalad shel valad kelomar shennaga bashsheni venaasa hu shelishi, lo nimneu millesarfo im habbasar shennitma beav hattuma shehu rishon lattuma. ucheshennogea ze habbasar shehaya mittechilla shelishi babbasar shennitma beav hattuma, chozer lihyot sheni, shehare naga barishon venaasa sheni, venimtza shehosifu lo tuma al tumato, demeikkara shelishi vehasheta sheni, veaf al pi chen lo nimneu millesarfo im chamur mimmennu, dehoil veaf ze hakkal lisrefa omed lo chashu im metammeim oto yoter mimma shehaya. veaf al pi sheen ochel metamme ochel min hattora, shenneemar betumat ochalim tame hu, hu tame veen metamme ochel kayyotze bo, mikkol makom rabbanan gazru sheyyihye ochel metamme ochel:
Hashshemen. shel teruma shennifsal bitvul yom hu shelishi lattuma, ditvul yom hu posel et hatteruma min hattora veose oto shelishi:

Bener shennitma vitme met. hay ner shel mattechet hu velo shel cheres. dechol kelim chutz mikkele cheres shennagu betumat met naasu kemotah, im av av veim rishon rishon, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) bachalal cherev, vedarshinan cherev hare hu kachalal, shehacherev shennaga bammet naasa avi avot kammet atzmo. ucheshennaga bitme met shehu av, naasa gam ken hacherev av. vechol shear kelim kecherev ledin ze, chutz mikkele cheres. nimtza hanner shel mattechet shennaga bitme met naasa av hattuma. vehasheta hosif rabbi akiva al divre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim, shehare rabbi chanina lo hittir ella lehachazir hashshelishi sheni, verabbi akiva hittir lehachazir hashshelishi rishon, shehashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom shehu shelishi, keshemmadlikin oto bener shennitma bitme met shehanner atzmo naasa av kemo sheamarnu, nimtza shechozer hashshelishi lihyot rishon, veaf al pi chen lo nimneu, dehoil veyesh shem tuma alav lo chayshinan leh umuttar lehosif bayyadayim:
Kol ezov sheyyesh lo shem levay. shergilin lelauot immo shem acher, kegon hanach dimfaresh lekamman:
Ezov ze. kelomar ezov setam sheharoe oto omer ze ezov hu vistam:

Veshel teruma temea. sheezov shel ginna chayyav bitruma keshellikketo laachila. veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav shehu fachot mikkabbetza, sheeno metamme me chattat, afillu hachi hazzaato fesula, kevan shehaezov atzmo tame:
Veshel tehora lo yazze. mippene shemmafsid et hatteruma:
Temarot. kemin gargerin sheyyesh berashe haezov:
En chayyavin al hayyonkot. tame shehizzu alav beyonkot uva vehazzaa zo el hammikdash, eno chayyav:
Rabbi eliezer omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Givolim shello gamalu. kol zeman shehapperach munnach betoch kiso kodem sheyyippatach:
Venitbakkeu. shennishtahu vetoch hammayim zeman merubbe ad shennitbakkeu, o afillu lo nitbakkeu ella shennishtannu mare hammayim, pesulin:
Chippushit. tolaat shechora:
Ben kach uven kach. ben nitbakkea ben lo nitbakkea:
Mippene shehi chishfoferet. shel kane chalula vehammayim nichnasim mitztzad ze veyotzim mitztzad ze umitarev immahem hallachut shebbekirbah:
Dira. tolaat shebbachittin:
Kinna. min tolaat nammi haggadel battevua:
Kesherim. afillu nitbakkeu. veen ken halacha:
Bammedina. birushalayim. vehayu machalifin machatzit hashshekel laanashim, shemmeviim kol echad mimmatbea medinato veeno yodea kamma mehem yotzim lemachatzit hashshekel:

Yashvu vammikdash. lefi shehaya hazzeman mitkarev hayu yoshvim bammikdash, kede sheyyemaharu lehavi. verambam peresh shekkol are yisrael keruyin medina, uveesrim vachamishsha bo hayu yoshvim bammikdash birushalayim:
Hitchilu lemashken. mi shello hevi shiklo:
Et mi memashkenin leviyyim. laafoke mimman deamar sheen memashkenin et haleviyyim dichtiv (Shemot 30) kol haover al happekudim mibben esrim shana vamala, uleviyyim lo hayu nimnim mibben esrim:
Aval lo nashim. venatnu ish kofer nafsho (sham) ketiv, velo ishsha:
Velo avadim. deen avadim chayyavin ella bemitzvot shennashim chayyavot:
Uketannim. afillu hevi shete searot vehu pachot mibben esrim:
Shuv eno fosek. aviv, mishshehitchil. veim met aviv hu shokel al yede atzmo:
Veen memashkenin et hakkohanim. veaf al pi shechayyavin bemachatzit hashshekel:

Mippene darche shalom. lefi sheavodat hakkarbanot alehem cholkim lahem kavod vesomchim alehem shello yeakkevu et shiklehem. vei nammi yeakkevu velo yittenu, bet din matne alehem sheyyihye lahem chelef avodatam, kemo shennotnim mitterumat hallishka lishar ose melechet hakkodesh kedimfaresh lekamman:

Happesach achar chatzot metamme et hayyadayim. deha notar hu mechatzot vaelach, verabbanan gazru al hannotar sheyyetamme et hayyadayim, kede shello yitatztzelu baachilato. umenalan defesach leachar chatzot have notar, dichtiv bappesach (Shemot 12) veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze, uchetiv hatam veavarti veeretz mitzrayim ballayla hazze, ma lehallan ad chatzot, af kan ad chatzot:

Birkat happesach. asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu leechol happesach. birkat hazzevach, asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu leechol hazzevach. vezevach haamur kan hu chagigat yom arbaa asar. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre tora. kegon hannogea bechol avot hattumot:
Metamme et hakkodesh veet hatteruma. lefi shehu rishon, ose sheni bachullin uvammaaser, ushelishi batteruma, urevii bakkodesh:
Leachar biato. shettaval velo heeriv shimsho, yesh lo din sheni lattuma, veose shelishi batteruma, urevii bakkodesh:
Vachachamim omrim posel bakkodesh. keshem shettevul yom posel batteruma, ken posel bakkodesh, veeno metamme vakkodesh, dechevan shettaval kelisha tumato, ufasul meshavve, tame lo meshavve:

Veim ba el hammikdash. kol hattaun tevila min hattora shebba el hammikdash, dehaynu leezrat yisrael, afillu leachar shettaval kodem sheyyaariv shimsho, chayyav. veaf leezrat nashim asur tevul yom likkanes, aval eno chayyav ella veezrat yisrael:
Hashshevuya. eshet kohen shennishbet:
Ochelet batteruma. velo chayshinan shemma hannachri ba aleha vaasaah zona ufesalah min hatteruma:
Shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. keshem sheheeminuha kesheamra nishbeti, kach yesh lehaaminah kesheomeret utehora ani:

Arve fesachim samuch lammincha. kodem lammincha meat kemo chatzi shaa, bitchillat shaa asirit. detamid karev betesha umechetza, vehu zeman hammincha, vekodem lammincha chatzi shaa have vitchillat shaa asirit:

Lo yochal adam. kede sheyyochal matztza leteavon, mishshum hiddur mitzva. velechem peshita dela matze achel, dechametz asur mishshesh shaot ulemala. umatztza nammi ha amrinan bayrushalmi haochel matztza veerev pesach keva al arusato bevet chamiv. velo nitzrecha ella lishar ochalin, shello yemalle chereso mehen:
Ad sheyyasev. bammitta veal hashshulchan, kederech bene chorin:
Velo yifchatu lo. gabbae tzedaka hamefarnesim et haaniyyim:
Mearba kosot. keneged arbaa leshonot shel geulla sheyyesh befarashat vaera, vehotzeti, vehitztzalti, vegaalti, velakachti:
Vaafillu hu mitparnes min hattamchuy. dehaynu ani shebbaaniyyim, ditnan bemassechet pea mi sheyyesh lo mezon shete seudot lo yittol min hattamchuy:

Keli cheres matztzil al hakkol. keli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil matztzil al kol ma shebbetocho keshehu beohel hammet, velo yittamme kol ma shebbetocho, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vechol keli fatuach asher en tzamid patil alav tame hu, ha yesh alav tzamid patil tahor hu uma shebbetocho, lo shena kelim velo shena ochalin umashkin. uvichli cheres hakkatuv medabber, dichtiv vechol keli fatuach, bemi shemmittamme derech pitcho veeno mittamme derech gabbo:
Eno matztzil ella al ochalin umashkin veal kele chares. aval al shear kelim eno matztzil kedimfaresh veazel:

Mippene ma vechulei‏ mippene shehu tame al gav am haaretz. shekkol hannimtza etzel amme haaretz ben kelim ben ochalim umashkin kullan bechezkat temein, lefi sheenam bekiim behilchot tuma vetohora vechoshvin al tame shehu tahor:
Veen keli tame chotzetz. en matztzil mippene hattuma ella keli tahor bilvad, aval keli tame eno matztzil al ma shebbetocho, vechelim shel am haaretz hoil uvechezkat temeim hen enan matztzilin:

Leatzmo tiharnu. leam haaretz levaddo tiharnu, velo chayshinan dilma ate chaver leishtammoshe vehu, shehare hem bedelim mimmaggaam, uvelav hachi nammi kol maachalam tame, hilkach ochalin umashkin uchele cheres sheen lahem tohora bemikve, keshehayu betoch tzamid patil shel keli am haaretz amrinan lehu tehorim hen, veyishtammeshu bahen hen shemmachazikin kelehem bechezkat tehorim, veen lachosh shemma yishal hechaver mehen veyishtammesh bahen, shehare hen etzlo bechezkat temeim veen lahem tohora olamit. aval bichle shetef deikka lemechash shemma yishal hechaver mehen veyatbilem veyishtammesh bahem belo hazzaa shelishi ushevii, shello yeda shennitmeu beohel hammet, vechoshev ditvila bealma saggi lehu lehatztzilam mittuma shennitmain aggav am haaretz, vehayenu ditnan tiharta lecha valo, deate chaver leishtammoshe vehu, hilkach asu din shave lakkol, veamru deen keli shetef nitztzol betzamid patil lo beshel chaver velo beshel am haaretz. veim bau ligzor shelleolam keli cheres shel am haaretz lo yatztzil betzamid patil lefi shehu bechezkat tame veen keli tame matztzil (aval shel chaver yatztzil), lo hayu amme haaratzot mekabbelin mehen, lefi shehen sevurim shehen bekiin veshomrim kelehem betohora vechelim shellahem matztzilin:
Shenneemar vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho. kesheyyavo chodesh beoto hachodesh shemmet bo, yetze miggehinnom veyavo lehishtachavot lifne Adonai:

Shenneemar umidde shabbat beshabbatto. kelomar leachar sheyyihye baggehinnom kol kach yamim kemo sheyyesh miyyom rishon shel pesach deikre shabbat dichtiv (Vayikra 23) usefartem lachem mimmochorat hashshabbat vegomer‏ ad atzeret shehu mimmochorat hashshabbat hashsheviit yetze miggehinnom veyavo lehishtachavot:
Kol shello amar shelosha devarim ellu. shello feresh taman shel shelosha devarim hallalu:
Shatat mehen behema o chayya pesulim. mishshum mashke shebbefihen hachozer, vehammayim veharok shebbefihen mitarvin:
Motzetzet. veen hammashke shebbefiha chozer lammayim:
Malleket. lokeket bilshonah umitarev harok shebbilshonah im hammayim:
Af hannachash mippene shehi mekia. vechen halacha, veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Mee avattiach. hazzeronim vehammashke shebbetoch haavattiach:
Ukenivat yarak. alin meuppashim shemmesirim min hayyarak:
Mane umane uferas. kol achat mane vachetzi. uvetzir mehachi lo chashev gez, shezzo pachut shebbaggizzot:

Kol shehen. lav davka. divfachot mishshishshim selaim lo mechayyeve rabbanan bereshit haggez. ella mishshum derabbi dosa yahev shiura rabba, kare tanna leshiura zuta derabbanan kol shehen. vehassela mishkalo esrim vearbaa maim, umishkal kol maa shesh esre garine seora:
Tze uvakkesh. et haavud ushechot alenu:
Im shello nishchat rishon. hoil vehem amru lo shechot alenu, al shello hem nimnim veshellahem yissaref, defesach belo vealim hu, veochlin kullam mishshello:
Veim shellahen nishchat rishon. hu ochel mishshello, shehare lo nimna al shellahen. vehen ochlin mishshellahen, shehare chazru vahen min haavud umashchu yedehen mimmennu:
Vehen enan ochlin immo. shemma shellahen nishchat rishon umashchu yedehen mizze:
Veshellahen yetze levet hasserefa. shemma shello nishchat rishon, veen nimnin al hashsheni:
Ufeturin mippesach sheni. demimma nafshach barishon nimnu, vaachila lo meakkevet:
Amar lahen. oto hayyachid shehalach levakkesh et haavud, im echarti temannuni immachem veshachatu alay. vehem lo amru lo shechot alenu:
Hu ochel immahen. veshello yissaref, kevan shehimnuhu al shellahen hare nimshach min harishon vechazar bo mishshelichuto:
Veshello yetze levet hasserefa. shemma shellahen nishchat rishon venimshach [mishshello, shehare] asaan sheluchin:
Ufatur mippesach sheni. demimma nafshach barishon nimna, vaachila lo meakkevet:
Amar lahen. shachatu alay im echarti:
Veamru lo. bakkesh ushechot alenu:
Yochlu chullam min harishon. dehu shelucham vehem sheluchav:
Veim en yadua eze rishon shenehem yissarfu. ufeturim mippesach sheni:
Enan chayyavin beacharayut ze laze. en lahem taana ze al ze. en choshshin eze rishon, ella hu ochel mishshello, vehen ochlin mishshellahen:
Vechotev bichtav yado. shetar chov al hallove:
Vaacherim chotmim. edim kesherim hayu chotmim al hashshetar:
Vehittiru. veaf al pi shekkotev hashshetar hu hammalve, venogea beeduto:
Shehaishsha kotevet et gittah. veedim kesherim chatumim bo:
Et shovro. shetar mechila shemmachala lo ishto al ketubbatah:
Sheen kiyyum hagget ella vechotmav. haedim hachatumim al hagget hem ikkar sibbat kiyyum hagget, hilkach keshehaedim kesherim chatumim bo kasher veaf al pi shehu ketav yad haishsha:

Veal machat. sheyyadua bah shennitmet bemet, venimtzet bivsar hakkodesh keshechatchu oto baazara, vesafek im naga bah hassakkin vehaadam im lav, hassakkin vehaadam tehorin, disfek tuma birshut harabbim hi, shehaazara din reshut harabbim yesh lah leinyan tuma, usefek tuma birshut harabbim sefeko tahor:

Vehabbasar tame. devadday naga bo tuma. umatnitin ayre bevehemat kadashim sheheevirah bannahar samuch lishchitatah vaadayin mashke tofeach aleha, shehuchshar habbasar lekabbel tuma beotan hammayim. dei lav hachi lo haya habbasar tame, veaf al pi sherochatzim oto bevet hammitbechayim baazara, dechol mashke vet mitbechayya dachan, veen machshirin et habbasar lekabbel tuma. vei kashya heach habbasar tame vehayyadayim tehorot, vahalo ochalin temein metammein et hayyadayim midderabbanan. ha lo kashya mide, dekayma lan en tumat yadayim bammikdash, shekkesheggazru al tumat yadayim lo gazru bah bammikdash:

Haav zoche labben vechulei. lefi shekkarov teva habben lihyot dome leteva haav, vehannoy vehakkoach vehachachma vehashshanim adam zoche bahen mittechillat yetzirato kefi tivo, vehaosher adam morisho livno. vechachma deamrinan hacha, hi hassevara hayeshara, vehi baadam kefi tivo. vehashshanim, arichut hayyamim. veli nire, sheim adam zoche havyan leh banim naim baale koach baale chachma ashirim umaariche yamim:
Uvemispar haddorot lefanav. peamim shehakkadosh baruch hu mavtiach laav laasot tova lezaro ledor shelishi o ledor revii, vehaav zacha leoto haddor shettavo lahem otah hattova:

Hu hakketz. shekkatzav hakkadosh baruch hu leoto davar sheyyihye lizman peloni uledor peloni. kemo vaavadum veinnu otam arba meot shana, vedor revii yashuvu henna, hare mispar haddorot shehu dor revii hu hakketz shel arba meot shana:

Onen tovel veochel pischo laerev. deen aninut min hattora ella vayyom, shenneemar (Vayikra 10) veachalti chattat hayyom, yom asur, layla muttar. utevila vae, mittoch shenneesar ad achshav bekadashim atzrechuhu rabbanan tevila. aval lo achel onen bishar kadashim laerev, daaninut layla asura midderabbanan. ulegabbe fesach lo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet. aval achilat shear kadashim ase vealma hu, veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem (Shemot 29):
Hashshomea al meto. yom shemua have onen derabbanan. vechen mi shellikketu lo atzmot aviv veimmo amrinan bemoed katan mitabbel alehem kol oto hayyom velaerev en mitabbel alehem:
Tovel veochel bakkadashim laarev. daafillu yom gufeh midderabbanan hu:

Keforesh min hakkaver. vetzarich hazzaa shelishi ushevii. velo nechelku bet shammay uvet hillel ella bearel nachri shemmal beyom arbaa asar, devet hillel savre gezera shemma yitma leshana habbaa veyomar eshtakad lo taharti mikkol tuma ad yom erev pesach shettavalti veachalti, hasheta nammi etbol veochal, velo yada deeshtakad nachri hava velo mekabbel tuma, achshav yisrael hu umekabbel tuma. uvet shammay savre lo gazrinan. aval arel yisrael, kegon shemmetu echav mechamat mila, divre hakkol tovel veochel pischo laerev, velo gazrinan arel yisrael attu arel nachri:

Beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim. bet din sholchim bechol are yisrael umachrizin sheyyaviu shiklehen. lefi shebbeechad benisan tzarich lehavi karbenot tzibbur mitteruma chadasha, dichtiv (Bamidbar 28) zot olat chodesh bechadsho lechadshe hashshana, chaddesh vehave karban mitteruma chadasha, veyalfinan chadshe hashshana dehacha, merishon hu lachem lechadshe hashshana (Shemot 12), hilkach makdimin sheloshim yom, dehaynu meechad baadar, lehacheriz sheyyaviu shiklehem:

Veal hakkilayim. machrizin sheyyemaatu hazzera haacher ad shello yishshaer bo rova kav lisa, keditnan beferek 2‏ dechilayim kol sea sheyyesh bo rova kav mimmin acher yemaet. verabbotenu pershu dilachar sheggadlu hazzeraim afillu echad beelef tzarich laakor hakkol, dechol tere mile dechol chad lechudeh share veneesru al yede taarovet lo shayyach behu vittul, dedavka keshemmin acher meorav bishat hazzera en tzarich ki im lemaet, demiddeorayta chad bitre batil velo mikre zorea kilayim, ella mippene marit haayin bealma tzarich lemaet. aval leachar sheggadlu lo shayyach behu bittul vetzarich laakor et hakkol velo yeshayyer ella echad min hamminim:

Bachamishsha asar bo korin et hamegilla bakkerakkin. hammukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun. ayyde devae lemitne devachamishsha asar baadar shulchanot yoshvin bammedina, tane nammi kol ma shehayu osin bo bayyom:

Umetakkenim et hadderachim veet harchovot. hashshevakim shennitkalkelu baggeshamim bimot hachoref, metakkenim otam bishvil ole regalim. veit dimfarshe bishvil harotzchim hammakkim nefesh bishgaga, sheyyuchelu lanus mippene goel haddam, kedichtiv (Devarim 19) tachin lecha hadderech:
Veet mikveot hammayim. im nitrabba bahen tit menakkin otan, veim nechesar shiuran mamshichin lahem mayim sheuvim umashlimin otan lichshiur im haya sham rov arbaim sea min hakkasher:

Veosim kol tzarche rabbim. kegon dine mamonot vedine nefashot, vedine makkot, ufediyyat arachim vacharamim vehakedashot, vehashekaat sota, userefat para, uretziat eved ivri, vetohorat metzora, vesholchin liftoach borot shel mayim mechunnasim kede sheyyihyu metzuyin laam lishtot mehen bimot hachamma. dechol hanach tzarche rabbim ninhu:

Umetzayyenin et hakkevarot. shello yaahilu alehem hakkohanim veose tohorot. vehatztziyyun hu shemmemachim sid veshofchim oto seviv hakkever, uvimot haggeshamim haya hassid nimmoach vetzarich lachzor uletzayyeno:
Veyotzim. sheluche bet din:
Af al hakkilayim. veaf al pi shekkevar hichrizu alehem beechad baadar, lo hayu somchim al hahachraza, deshemma lo akarum bealim. vehayu hem yotzim veokrim otam:

Kol kohen sheshshokel eno chote. veaf al pi sheeno chayyav lishkol. vesalka datach amina im shokel nimtza karban tzibbur karev mishshel yachid, kamashma lan deeno chote, lefi shehu moser oto machatzit hashshekel latztzibbur legamre, velo chayshinan shemma lo yigmor lemasro yafe:

Kol kohen sheeno shokel chote. ukera dechol haover al happekudim daresh leh hachi, kol haover beyam suf, dehaynu kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim shekkullan avru et hayyam al happekudim, ben otan shennimnu levaddan ben otan shennimnu im yisrael, yitten terumat Adonai. veaf al gav divfarashat elle pekude ketiv vechesef pekude haeda meat kikkar vegomer‏ leshesh meot elef usheloshet alafim vechulei, hahu bitrumat haadanim hu dichtiv, uveotah teruma lo haya shevet levi, aval bitruma shel karbenot tzibbur hushvu bah kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim:

Leatzman. lahanaatan. velav derasha hi, dedavka beminchat kohen levaddo amar kera kalil tihye, velo beotah sheyyesh lo beshuttafut im hatztzibbur. vahalacha shekkohanim chayyavim litten machatzit hashshekel, veen memashkenin otan mippene darche shalom:
Happesach shennitarev. shelosha telaim, echad shel pesach veechad shel asham veechad shel ola, shennitarvu. kullan yiru ad sheyyistaavu:

Veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen. ola, deshemma hayyafe ola haya. uvidme hayyafe shebbahen asham, deshemma hayyafe asham haya. uvidme hayyafe shebbahen pesach, im kodem happesach nistaavu chullan, veim leachar happesach nistaavu yeviem lishlamim, deshemma hayyafe pesach haya. veoto motar shetztzarich lehosif al hashsheni ad sheyyaggiu lidme hayyafe, yafsid mishshello. vechetzad ose, im hayyafe shebbahen shave sela, mevi shalosh selaim mibbeto, venotel hassela haachat veomer, kol makom shehi haola hare hi mechullelet al sela zo, veyavi mimmennah ola. venotel hassela hashsheniyya veomer, kol makom shehu asham hare hu mechullal al sela zo, veyavi bo asham. vechen lishlamim:
Nitarev happesach bivchorot. shemmattan damam vedam happesach shave:

Rabbi shimon omer im chavurat kohanim yochelu. kullan bo vallayla, shehabbechor neechol lakkohanim. veyikrav pesach leshem pesach bechol makom shehu, uvechorot leshem bechorot bechol makom shehen, veaf al pi shehen memaatin bizman achilat habbechor, shehabbechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad, veachshav en ochlin oto ella ad chatzot kizman happesach, venimtzeu meviin kadashim levet happesul, rabbi shimon savar sheyyecholin lehavi kadashim levet happesul. verabbanan pelige aleh veamre yiru chullan ad sheyyistaavu, veyavi maot bidme hayyafe shebbahen, kidamran befesach shennitarev bizvachim. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Vehashsheni chametz umatztza immo bavayit. dichtiv (Bamidbar 9) kechol chukkat happesach yaasu oto, mashma mitzvot shebbegufo, kegon tzali veal matztzot umerorim yochluhu, osin oto kechol chukkat happesach, aval mitzvot sheal gufo mimmakom acher, kegon tashbitu seor velo tishchat al chametz, en osin oto kechol chukkat happesach:

Harishon taun hallel baachilato vechulei. dichtiv (yeshaya 30) hashshir yihye lachem kelel hitkaddesh chag, layil hamekuddash lechag shehu fesach rishon taun hallel, vesheeno mekuddash lechag eno taun hallel:
Ze vaze teunim hallel baasiyyatan. delayla miet kera mishshir, yom lo miet:
Shel chattat tame. dekodesh uteruma temeim hen etzel chattat:
Shenehen bishte yadav. shennose shel chattat beyado achat veshel kodesh o shel teruma beyado haacheret:
Shenehen temeim. shel chattat mishshum denaga beshel teruma beyado venitmeu yadav nitma gufo umetamme me chattat, veshel teruma tame mishshum nose me chattat:
Bishne neyarot. veaf al pi shehaadam tame mishshum nose me chattat, mikkol makom hatteruma tehora deha mafsik neyar veeno nogea batteruma veyado:

Shel chattat binyar veshel teruma beyado shenehen temein. dechi naga beyado beshel teruma nitma lechattat. uneyar divshel chattat eno chotzetz, deen monin rishon vesheni lechattat, venitma shel chattat, vehaadam tame mishshum nose me chattat vetimme et shel teruma shennaga bo beyado. aval shel teruma banneyar, chotzetz bo hanneyar, veaf al gav denaga beshel chattat beyado, shenehem tehorim, deaf al pi shehu tame mishshum nose me chattat, mikkol makom en me chattat chozrim umittammeim battuma habbaa laadam mechamat atzman:

Rabbi yehoshua omer shel chattat tame. rabbi yehoshua letaameh deamar battosefta tahor lechattat shehesit et hammafteach shehu tahor litruma, tame, shemma yishkach veyasit et haddavar hattame. vehacha nammi afillu vishne neyarot tame, dema shehu nose et hatteruma af al pi sheeno nogea bah have maddaf lachattat. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Hayu netunim al gabbe haaretz venaga bahem. shennatan yado achat al shel chattat veyado achat al shel kodesh o shel teruma:
Shel chattat tame. denitma haadam belagin shel teruma vetimme et shel chattat:
Veshel kodesh veshel teruma tehorim. shehare haadam tahor lekodesh velitruma, delo naga bamme chattat ella vallagin:
Hesitan rabbi yehoshua metamme. letaameh deamar tahor lechattat shehesit et hammafteach shehu tahor litruma, tame. velet hilchata kevateh:
Shamati. merabbotay:
Shettemurat happesach kereva. shelamim achar happesach:
Utemurat happesach enah kereva. veyesh temurat pesach sheenah kereva hi atzmah shelamim, ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi vedameha shelamim, demotar happesach karev shelamim:
Veen li lefaresh. shachachti al ezo shamati tikrav, veal ezo tire ad shettistaev:

Happesach. sheavad vehifrish acher tachtav venimtza fesach rishon kodem shechitat hashsheni, shehaya omed lefanenu bishat shechita, hare kevaattu sheat shechita beshem pesach, veze shello hikrivo dachahu veyadayim velo yikrav hu atzmo shelamim:
Ad sheyyistaev. sheyyippol bo mum, shello yihye rauy lekarban:
Vechen temurato. im hemir bo behemat chullin achare chen:
Leachar happesach. kelomar veim leachar shechitat hashsheni nimtza, hare lo kevaattu sheat shechita beshem pesach, velo nidcha veyadayim, veyikrav hu atzmo shelamim:
Vechen temurato. vehu haddin dematze rabbi yehoshua lemitne bappesach atzmo, yesh pesach karev veyesh pesach sheeno karev:
En shochatin et happesach beyachid. dichtiv (Devarim 16) lo tuchal lizboach et happasach vechulei, kelomar beyachid:

Afillu chavura shel mea. rabbi yose kaamar la, kelomar lo talya milleta ella vaachila. yachid veyachol leechol kazzayit, shochatin alav, mea veen kol echad mehem yecholin leechol kazzayit, en shochatin alehem. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

En osin chavurat nashim vaavadim. lishchot pesach, nashim vaavadim bachavura achat, mishshum hergel avera. velo ketannim vaavadim bachavura achat, mishshum peritzuta demishkav zachur. aval nashim vaavadim kol chada beanpe nafsha osin:
Ufershan rabbi yehoshua. ematay chayyav veematay patur:
Im laasot lah pe chayyav. mishshum bone:

Veim lehotzi mimmenna lecha patur. dimlacha sheenah tzericha legufah hi, shehappetach hi hammelacha, vezo enah tzericha lihyot lah petach meachshav, veen kan ella issura derabbanan umishshum tzaara lo gazur, vehave patur umuttar:
Im mitassek shello yishshechennu patur. deeno tzarich legufo shel davar hannitztzod, veim haya yodea sheyyaamod velo yishshechennu lo haya tzad. uvehay nammi lo gazru rabbanan, vehave patur umuttar:
Lefasin ironiyyot. kele cheres setumim asuyin kemin kaddur chalul mibbifnim, uleachar shemmelabbenim oto bakkivshan chotchim oto beemtzao vehu naase shene kelim:

Tehorot beohel hammet. kol zeman shello chatachuhu. dichli cheres en mekabbel tuma miggabbo, ella meaviro, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vechol keli fatuach, derech pitcho mittamme veeno mittamme miggabbo, vehay en lo avir:
Utemeot bemassa hazzav. betumot hesset. sheim nittaltelu o nitnaneu mimmassa hazzav, temeim, af al pi sheen lahem avir:

Mippene shello nigmera melachtan. dachaticha shechotchin otan beemtzaan zo hi gemar melachtan. veen halacha kerabbi elazar bar tzadok. ella libbunan bakkivshan hu gemar melachtan, hilkach mittammeot bemassa hazzav afillu kodem shechillekan:
Efer kasher shennetano al gabbe hammayim sheenam reuyim lekaddesh. have dina kedin me chattat shennifselu:

Metammein et hattahor litruma veyadav uvegufo. kedin kol shear me chattat hakkesherim. veen metammeim hattahor lechattat, sheen me chattat metammein hannosan vehannogea bahen ella lishar tumot, lo letohorat me chattat:
Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni. mi sheyyesh lo meot nechoshet shel maaser sheni uva lefartan besela kesef lehaalot lirushalayim mippene masseoy hadderech:
Bet shammay omrim bechol hassela maot. im ba lefartan, yachol hu lifrot kullan, venoten maot bishvil kol hassela:

Uvet hillel omrim. lo yifrot ella chetzyan. shekkesheyyavo lirushalayim yihye tzarich lapperutot miyyad liknot tzarche seudda, veim yarutzu hakkol etzel shulchani lifrot yokiru happerutot, venimtza maaser sheni nifsad. lefichach yissa perutot immahen lehotzi bemiktzat, velichsheyyichlu yifrot bakkesef shebbeyado meat meat. shekel hu chatzi sela:
En mechallelin kesef uferot al kesef. mi sheyyesh lo chatzi dinar kesef shel maaser, uferot shel maaser shavim chatzi dinar, lo yetzarfem yachad lechallelam al dinar:

Vachachamim mattirim. bichhay gavna al yede tzeruf perot, kevan sheen lo ella chatzi dinar kesef. aval lechallel dinar kesef, uferot shavin dinar, al chatzi sela shehu shene dinarin, modim chachamim sheen mechallelim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Bakkerem. shehayu yoshvin shurot shurot shel chachamim kecherem zo hannetua shurot shurot shel gefanim:

Al betza terufa. bikara, shennitarva hachelbon vehachelmon yachad unetuna al gabbe hayyarak, venaga tevul yom babbetza, af al pi shehi chullin, deen shayyach teruma bevetza, utevul yom eno posel bechullin, afillu hachi have chibbur venifsal hayyarak keillu naga bo:
Im haya chemin kova. shennitnappecha habbetza venaaset kemin kova al hayyarak vachalula tachteha:
Shibbolet shebbakkatzir. shiyyer biktzirato shibbolet achat shello katzar, verosh otah shibbolet maggia lakkama:
Im niktzera. im otah shibbolet niktzeret im hakkama, hare hi shel baal habbayit, shehakkama matztzilatah, delo karinan bah lo tashuv lekachto:
Veim lav. hare zo shichcha vehaveya laaniyyim:
Aris. chamesh gefanim hannetuot umudelot veshochvot al gabbe kelonsot o al gabbe gader keruyot aris, leshon al eres yetzuay:
Im yesh bah kimlo votzer vesallo. im hagginna gedola keshiur sheyyaamod bah botzer haanavim im sallo shemmachnis haanavim letocho keshehu melakket haanavim mikkol tzidde hearis:
Tizzarea. hagginna. vehu sheyyarchik hazzera min haggefanim kede avodat hakkerem shehem shishsha tefachim lechol ruach, vezorea hashshear:
Veim lav. sheen hagginna gedola kol kach:
Lo tizzarea. veaf al pi shemmarchik kede avodat hakkerem. mippene shehazzera nire im hakkerem keillu hem kilayim:
Hachoshev al me chattat lishtot rabbi eliezer posel. deippaslu lehu bammachashava:
Kesheyyatte. hechavit lishtot o likkach mimmenna mayim lishtot. aval bemachashava gereda lo fasel:
Bemayim sheenan mekuddashin. shemmillean kede litten bahen et haefer vaadayin lo natan:
Rabbi eliezer omer kesheyyatte. vehacha lo fasel lehu bemachashava. dechevan demayim kedoshim hen, immeloche mimmelich vechozer bo mimmachashavto, hilkach lo fasel rabbi eliezer ad sheyyatte:
Rabbi yehoshua omer kesheyyishte. mippene mashke shebbefiv shechozer umitarev im hammayim ufasel lehu:
Veim girger. leshon gargeret. kelomar shello shata kederech hashshotim ella shafach hammayim bigrono:
Kasher. delekka mashke fiv bechavit. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua betarvayhu:

Shennaga bemaddaf tame. elyono shel zav karuy maddaf, sheim hayu al gabbe hazzav eser michsaot zo al gabbe zo kullan temein maddaf, afillu haelyona shello naga bah hazzav. keshem sheeser matztzaot zo al gabbe zo veshachav hazzav baelyona kullan temeot deorayta mishshum mishkav veaf al pi shello naga battachtonot, kach hammichsaot haelyonot sheal gabbe hazzav temeim derabbanan mishshum maddaf veaf al pi shello naga bahen. veikka ven mishkav lemaddaf, shehammishkav naase av hattuma letamme adam vechelim, vehammaddaf eno ella velad hattuma letamme ochalim umashkim, ella mishshum chumra dechattat, adam vechelim shennagu vemaddaf temeim lechattat:
Lagin shel chattat. keli shetef hu verotze lehachenis bo me chattat:
Shennaga bemaddaf tame. vetzarich tevila:
Shennaga beochalin umashkin. vaafillu shehen tehorin litruma ulekodesh:

Beyado tame. kedin ochalin umashkin temeim shehen metammein et hayyadayim, shehattahor litruma ulekodesh posel bechattat, veod yesh chumra yetera gabbe chattat, denitma [yadav nitma] gufo, vehilkach keshennaga beyado beochalim umashkin tame:
Rabbi yehoshua metamme. degazar hesset attu negia. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Vechotem bigulla. kelomar mesayyem et hahaggada bevirkat geulla. velo feresh tanna kamma lemilleteh heach mevarchin otah, vaato rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva lefaroshe lemilleteh. rabbi tarfon omer poteach bah bevaruch veeno chotem bevaruch, mide dahava abbirkat happerot uvirchot hammitzvot, dechulla chada hodaa hi. ulerabbi akiva chotmin bah bevaruch, lefi shemmosif bah divre ritztzuy uvakkasha, ken yaggienu vechulei. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Veyippelu damav lindava. notnim otan hammaot latteva shebbammikdash umakrivin mehen olot nedava:
Lo yeviennu veno acharav leshem pesach. dahava leh pesach shemmetu vealav veen kan menuyin:
Tzelochit. shel me chattat:
Uva umetzaah mechussa pesula. sheani omer adam nichnas lesham vechissa otah, verov bene adam en tehorin lechattat:

Im yechola chulda lishtot hemenna pesula. aval im enah yechola lishtot lo faslinan lehu mittaam shemma adam tame nichnas vegilla otah, deen derech bene adam legallot ella lechassot mippene hashsheratzim, aval sheratzim darkan legallot veen darkan lechassot. vedavka mechussa umetzaah megulla chayshinan lechulda. aval megulla umetzaah megulla kemo shehinnichah, lo chayshinan, af al pi shechashu lisfek mayim megullin, dachamira sakkanta meissura:
O nachash ledivre rabban gamliel. deamar leel, af hannachash posel mippene shehu meki:
Hachattat. efer chattat o mayim hamekuddashim shehayu veohel hammet betoch keli sheyyesh alav tzamid patil:

Enan nitztzolin. venifsalin. middichtiv vehinniach bemakom tahor vehay lav makom tahor hu. aval kelim haomdim lehanniach bahen me chattat o efer chattat, vechen ezov hametukkan lehazzot bo, nitztzolin betzamid patil:
Kalal shel chattat. keli cheres sheyyesh bo efer happara. targum vechaddah al shichmah (Bereshit 24), vekuleta al katpa:
Shennaga besheretz tahor. deen keli cheres mittamme miggabbo:
Netano al gabbav. shennatan hakkalal al gabbe hashsheretz:

Vachachamim metammein. mishshum demunnach bemakom tame, vehattora amra vehinniach michutz lammachane bemakom tahor. verabbi eliezer savar hoil vehakkeli shehaefer betocho tahor hu, shappir karinan beh bemakom tahor. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Rabbi yose metaher. bemunnach al gabbe ochalim umashkim vechitve hakkodesh, kevan dimkomo tahor meav hattuma:
Vachachamim metammeim. detahor mikkol tuma bainan. vechitve hakkodesh rabbanan gazru vehu sheyyihyu metammein et hayyadayim. vahalacha kachachamim:

Ella bevaa min hakkatzir. kammaase shehaya shehalchu bene adam liktzor chittin uneshacho nachash leechad mehen umet, uvaa vehodia bevet din veshalchu umatzu kidvareha. velo hittiru ella dugmato, sheyyehe haddavar karov, aval mimmedinat hayyam enah neemenet:
Ella vahove. maase shehaya kach haya, vehu haddin lishar mekomot:
Sheen haachin nichnasin. lenachalat balah, derachamana amar al pi shene edim. vegabbe nissuim didah hu daakilu mishshum iggunah:
Missefer ketubbatah. minnussach shehitkinu lichtov bishtar ketubba:
Keshettinnasi leacher. vahare hi nisset veim ken tittol ketubbatah:

Shelosha kelachin uvahen shelosha givolin. givol echad bekelach echad. ushelosha kelachim devainan, yalfinan lekicha lekicha meaguddat ezov mippesach mitzrayim, ma lehallan shelosha, divhachi mikkere agudda, af kan shelosha:
Mefassego. mafrido umechalleko sheyyihyu hashshelosha kelachim meforadim ze mizze:

Rabbi yose omer mitzvat ezov shelosha. rabbi yose machmir tefe mittanna kamma, dilrabbi yose techillato shenayim pasul, uletanna kamma techillato shenayim kasher, veeno fasul ad sheyyehe techillato chishyarav, echad. udekaamar tanna kamma mitzvat ezov shelosha kelachim, lemitzva vealma velo leakkev. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Vegardummav kol shehu. gardumme haggivol kol shehu. usheyarav vegardummav tere mille ninhu, dishyarav havu sheyare hashshelosha kelachin, dehaynu shene kelachin, vegardummav hu haggivol atzmo deiggardum venishbar venishtayyer mimmennu kol shehu:
Shello yaasem takkala laacherim. sheyyiggeu vattit veyittammeu veme chattat shebbo:
Rabbi yehuda omer batlu. battit, vetu lo metammee meachar sheggibbelan:
Meet leet. im shechatah betoch meet leet shel shetiyya. aval shahata tefe mehachi, nitakkelu vemeeha:
Rabbi yehuda omer batlu vemeeha. vaafillu shechatah betoch meet leet besarah tahor. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda betarvayhu:
Kela. shezzorkim bo haavanim. kema deat amar (Shoftim 20) kolea baeven. (Shmuel 1 25) yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala:
Bet kibbul shellah. hammakom shemmesimin bo haeven sherotzim lehashelich:
Bet etzba shellah. kemin nekev katan shemmachnisin bo haetzba:
Bet happakia. habbet yad sheochez bo keshemmesabbev hakkela baavir verotze lehafekia ulehashlich haeven:
Lo raiti or yotze levet hasserefa. leachar shehufshat im nimtzet terefa. af al pi sheppesul ze haya bo kodem hefshet, hoil velo nikkar ella leachar hefshet:

Shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa. ha ka mashma lan rabbi akiva, daafillu bechor baal mum hannishchat bammedina al mumo velo hittiro hakkatuv ella baachila kedichtiv (Devarim 15) bisharecha tochalennu, aval im met, oro asur vetaun kevura, veashmeinan rabbi akiva dehecha delo hukkar terefuto ad leachar hefshet, hittirato shechitato vehefsheto leoro keillu nizrak damo bammikdash:
Yeotu hakkohanim beoro. veeno nisraf:
En lo raiti reaya. shemma lo era beyamav sheyyimmatze terefa leachar hefshet, veim era userafuhu hu lo raa:

Ella yetze levet hasserefa. hoil vekodem hefshet ba. vahalacha kerabbi akiva bivchor baal mum keshehittiro mumche. aval lo hittiro mumche lo. vahalacha kachachamim bivchor tamim, devasar bikvura veor bisrefa:
Kol harauy littamme midras. kegon kelim hameyuchadim lemishkav umoshav umerkav:

Maddaf lechattat. im hattahor leme chattat hesitan. afillu hen tehorin litruma nitma hammesitam keillu hen temeim midras. vechumra vealma hi kidamrinan [bachagiga 18] bigde ochle teruma midras lakkodesh. vekare leh maddaf, lefi shehi chumra derabbanan bealma. leshon kol ale niddaf (Vayikra 26):
Veadam kayyotze vahen. sheim hattahor lechattat hesit adam hattahor litruma, nitma lechattat, shehattehorim litruma nechshavim kezavim legabbe chattat:
Vechol harauy littamme teme met. kegon kelim delav bene midras:
Rabbi eliezer omer eno maddaf. veim hesitan lo nitma lechattat:
Rabbi yehoshua omer maddaf. im hesit afillu hattehorim, nitma lechattat. verabbanan pelige umechallekim ben temeim lithorim. veshalosh machalokot baddavar. vahalacha kachachamim:

Mi shehaya tame. sheellu peturin min hakkaret. hattame o shehaya vederech rechoka petaran hakkatuv millaasot pesach rishon, veikkar karet befesach rishon hu, lefichach im lo asu fesach sheni peturim min hakkaret:

Veellu chayyavin behikkaret. hashshogeg o haanus chayyavin hayu befesach rishon, ella shehashshegaga vehaones ikkavtan, ucheshehezidu velo asu fesach sheni chayyavin behikkaret, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 9) vehaish asher hu tahor uvederech lo haya vechadal laasot happesach venichreta, mashma deal kol shear shegagot voonasin sheeru varishon chutz mittame vederech rechoka, chayyavin karet im lo asu pesach sheni:
Shennaga betannur. vaafillu hu tahor lakkodesh, im naga bo hattahor lechattat:

Tame. vetzarich tevila lechattat, shehattahor lakkodesh posel bechattat. vedavka shennaga beyado, denitmeu yadav venitma gufo, aval beraglo tahor, divyado avud maala, beraglo lo avud maala, dumeya doochalin umashkin dilel:
Vehallagin betocho. keli shehichnis bo me chattat natun betoch yado:
Vechen haesel. mot shennotnim shene chaddin bishne rashav:

Uvo shene kelalot. shene chelim shehaefer natun bahem, shekkalal echad kashur berosh hammot haechad, vekalal echad kashur berosho hashsheni, vehasheta haadam vehaesel al gabbe tannur, vehallagin vehakkalal shebbahen hammayim vehaefer chutz lattannur:
Rabbi akiva metaher. sheen hakkeli shebbo haefer omed al gabbe hattannur, uvemakom tahor hu:
Vachachamim metammein. hoil veadam hannoso omed al gabbe tannur, chashvinan lakkeli keillu hu omed al gabbe hattannur uvemakom tame hu munnach. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:

Layla echad, ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva. matnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, veneechol bechippazon belayla echad, vechimmutzo kol hayyom, ufesach dorot chimmutzo noheg kol shiva. divfesach mitzrayim ketiv (Shemot 13) velo yeachel chametz hayyom attem yotzim, kare veh velo yeachel chametz hayyom sheattem yotzim bilvad:
Heviu lefanav. hayerakot, kede sheyyakkir tinok veyishal, lefi sheen derech lehavi yerakot kodem seuda:

Metabbel bachazeret. lav davka chazeret, detibbul rishon ze have vishar yerakot, ella im en lo shear yerakot metabbel bachazeret bimkom shear yerakot. velashon metabbel, ochel. ulefi shekkol achilatan al yede tibbul hayta, kare laachila tibbul. umihu tibbul ze lav bacharoset hu, middekatane lekamman heviu lefanav matztza vachazeret vacharoset, mikkelal daadayin lo huveu:

Ad shemmaggia lefarper et happat. laachilat matztza. veha ka mashma lan sheen achila acheret mafseket ben achilat yerakot laachilat matztza, dekodem sheyyaggia leoto chazeret shel mitzva shemmevarech alav al achilat maror ochel matztza techilla, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 9) al matztzot umerorim, matztzot beresha vahadar merorim:

Vacharoset. sheosim mitteenim veluzim uvatnim ushekedim vechamma mine ferot, umesimin bah tappuchim, vedachin hakkol bammedocha, umearvin bechometz, venotnin aleha tevalin kane vekinnamon keen petilot dakkot arukkot zecher lakkash, vetzarich shettihye ava zecher lattit:
Sheen charoset mitzva. ella lirfua, levattel seraf hachazeret shera vekashe lagguf keeres:
Rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer mitzva. zecher lattappuach shehayu yoldot sham benehem belo etzev, vezecher lattit:
Sandal shel sayyadin. minal shel etz shennoalin beraglehem hammitassekim bassid lehagen al raglehem shello yissarfu bassid. veim naal oto hazzav, tame midras:

Veal sheyare tannur arbaa. im haya gadol harebe venitma, veachar kach nishbar, lo taher ad shello yihye bishvarav gavoah arbaa, uleolam shevarav mekabbelim tuma keillu haya shalem ad sheyyihye hashshever pachot miggova arbaa. usetam tannur shebbammishna asuy kemin kedera gedola sheen lah shulayim umechabberin oto betit al gabbe karka veritzpat hakkarka hi tachtito shel tannur:
Shenayim mechippuyav. min halluchot haasuyot lemoshav:
Sherabbi akiva metamme. desavar af al pi sheeno rauy lishiva hu rauy lekabbel rimmonim, vetame mishshum keli kibbul:

Vachachamim metaharin. desavre hoil veikkaro lishiva avid velo levet kibbul, kevan shennitbattel haikkar shebbaavuro naasa, nitbattel hattafel, veeno mittamme afillu mishshum keli kibbul. vahalacha kachachamim:
Me chattat shennifselu. kegon shennishtannu marehen shello mechamat atzman, vechayyotze vaze min haddevarim shepposlim me chattat:

Metammeim et haadam hattahor litruma. ben shennaga bahen beyadav ben shennaga bahen begufo, dichme chattat kesherim chashive. vetuma zo derabbanan hi, demiddeorayta kevan shennifselu parcha mehen tumatan hachamura. umishshum hachi tane metammein et haadam
Hattahor litruma. demashma davka litruma aval lo lechullin:

Veet hattahor lechattat lo veyadav. kelomar en metammein hattahor lechattat ben naga bahen beyadav ben naga bahen begufo, dichme chattat kesherim chashive, unehi dehannose me chattat sheyyesh bahen kede hazzaya o nogea bahen, tame lechol mille, lechattat miha tahor:

Nitmeu metammeim et hattahor litruma. keme chattat kesherim. aval et hattahor lechattat metammeim oto im naga beyadav, dechevan denitmeu lo gerie mishshear ochalim umashkim temeim dimtammeim et hayyadayim, vekayma lan divtohorat me chattat mi shennitmeu yadav nitma gufo:

Maftirin. ani shamati leshon yaftiru vesafa (tehillim 22), kelomar potchin veomrim. verabbotay pershu leshon hanniftar mechavero, keshenniftarin min hasseuda en mesayyemin otah baafikoman, beappiku manaychu, kelomar totziu chelechem mikkan venelech venochal bemakom acher, lo fat velo shum davar, gezera dilma ate lemechal min happesach bishne mekomot. aval leechol devarim acherim bimkomo harishon share, uvilvad shello yaakor mechavura zo leachlam im chavura acheret. veit baggemara man deferesh en maftirin achar happesach afikoman, appiku mine metika. dilachar sheachlu et happesach en niftarin min hasseuda baachilat mine metika uferot shergilin leechol lekinnuach seuda, vaafillu vimkoman, shello yovad taam happesach mippiv. vechen ikkar. ucheshem sheen maftirin achar happesach afikoman, kach en maftirin achar matztza afikoman, shetztzarich sheyyochal kazzayit matztza vaacharona bizman sheen pesach, veachar otah matztza en niftarin mimmenna baachilat davar acher:

Yashnu kullam lo yochlu. im hitchilu leechol pischehen veyashnu chullan, shuv lo yochlu, denire cheochel bishne mekomot, demeachar sheyyashnu hissichu datam milleechol od, vechashev leh kaachilat shene mekomot. vechumra vealma hu. vehu haddin nammi lematztza bazzeman hazze:

Rabbi yose omer nitnamnemu yochlu. aresha kae, deamar tanna kamma yashnu miktzatan yochlu, veata rabbi yose lememar hane mille im nitnamnemu, shello nishkeu veshena, aval im nirdemu miktzatan lo yochlu ellu hannirdamim lichsheyyeoru mishshenatam. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Kol hametammein beohel. kegon hammet vehannetzel umelo tarvad rakav, vechol otan hashshenuyin resh perek 2‏ deohalot:
Shennechleku. shiurehen lachatzaim:
Vehichnisan. keshehen mechullakin:
Letoch habbayit. dehaynu letoch ohel echad:
Rabbi dosa ben harekinas metaher. desavar lo mitztarfe lichshiur:

Hannogea bechishne chatzae zetim min hannevela. patach beohel umefaresh nevela, lomar lecha dechi hechi disvira leh lerabbi dosa sheen mitztarfin letumat ohel, hachi nammi sevira leh sheen mitztarfin tumat magga umassa, ben bemet ben binvela:

Hannogea bachatzi zayit umaahil al chatzi zayit. shehammaahil al hammet tame keillu haya im hammet baohel. vechol hanach maahil deresha, betuma retzutza ayre, sheen ben hattuma uven haohel poteach tefach, umishshum hachi chachamim metammeim, deohel ki hay, negia hi. vesefa ditnan aval hannogea bechachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav vechulei‏ demodu rabbanan detahor, mayre kesheyyesh poteach tefach ben hattuma uven haohel, divha modu rabbanan deen mitztarfin, dingia veohel shene shemot hen, vechol shehen mishshene shemot en mitztarfin. verabbi dosa savar daafillu betuma retzutza en mitztarfin:

Amar rabbi meir vechulei. rabbi meir paleg attanna kamma deamar dichsheyyesh poteach tefach ben hattuma vehaohel modu rabbanan detahor veen mitztarfin, veamar ihu deaf bezo pelige rabbanan al rabbi dosa veamre dingia veohel chad shema hu, hilkach mitztarfin lichshiur umetammein. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Chutz min hammagga im hammassa. kegon shennaga bachatzi zayit vehesit chatzi zayit:
Vehammassa im haohel. shehesit chatzi zayit veheehil al chatzi zayit:
Mishshem echad. kegon magga umagga, massa umassa, ohel veohel:
Vechan habben shoel. bechol hassefarim en katuv vechan, ella vechen, kemo ken benot tzelafchad dovrot (Bamidbar 27). kelomar vedin hu shebbimzigat kos sheni yihye habben shoel ma nishtanna:
Hallayla hazze chullo tzali. bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam haya habben shoel kach:
Matchil bignut. mittechilla ovde avoda zara hayu avotenu vaavadim hayinu:
Umesayyem beshevach. shekkervanu hammakom laavodato vegaal et avotenu mimmitzrayim:
Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim. kegon achal ochalin temein, veshata mashkin temein, vehayyadayim, vehakkelim shennitmeu vammashkin, vechayyotze vahen:
Vachachamim osrim bammaaser. vahalacha kachachamim:
Leachar biato. leachar shettaval, miyyad huttar bechullam veen tzarich heerev shemesh:
Veim ba el hammikdash patur. delo asra tora biat hammikdash ella al mi shennitma veav hattuma deorayta, kedichtiv (Vayikra 5) betumat adam o bivhema temea o bechol sheretz tame:

Hayu okrim umashlichim lifnehem. lifne baale hassadot kede sheyyitbayyeshu. vehayu baale sadot semechim shemmenakkeshim lahem sedotehem, veod shehayu notnim otan lifne behemtan. hitkinu sheyyihyu mashlichim otan badderachim. vaadayin hayu baale sadot semechim shehayu menakkeshim lahen:
Hitkinu sheyyehu mafkirin kol hassade. dehefker bet din hefker:

Teni. keli shel mattechet shebbaale battim mesimim bo gerutaot veshivre kele mattachot. verabban gamliel metamme hakkissuy, desavar hu nammi chashuv keli, mishshum dechissuy nammi yesh lo bet kibbul. vachachamim metaharin, desavre kevan delo naasa ella lechassot eno chashuv keli:
Uteloy hammagredot. masmerim shettolim bahem hammagredot bevatte merchatzaot, vehannichnasim sham kol echad lokeach magredet umegared bah raglav vegufo:
Vegalme chele mattachot. shetztzerichim lashuf legared lehakkish bekurnas, o shemmechussar ogen o ozen, enan temeim ledivre chachamim ad shettiggamer melachtan:

Tavla shennechleka lishnayim. tavla shel cheres sheyyesh bah livzebzin, venaaset shete chatichot shavot sheen achat mehen gedola mechavertah, beha felige rabban gamliel vachachamim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Haya omed chutz lattannur. shehattannur mafsik beno lakkotel, vechallon bakkotel uvo hallagin shel me chattat:
Veheeviro al pi hattannur. shekkol tannurehen pihen lemala:
Rabbi akiva metamme. desavar keluta chemi shehunnecha damya uveshaa sheheeviro al pi hattannur hare hi cheillu hinnicho vetocho venitma:
Vachachamim metaharin. savre lo amrinan keluta kemi shehunnecha damya. vahalacha kachachamim:
Uveyado keli rekam. delo vaena vehinniach bemakom tahor ella veefer happara uvemayim hamekuddashin al yede haefer:
Im yesh bah kabbetza. deochel pachot mikkabbetza eno metamme:
Ben tehora ben temea hammayim temeim. detohorat teruma, temea hi etzel chattat:
Vehaochlah chayyav mita. denitma veme chattat beshaa sheochlah, uteruma vetumat hagguf bemita:
Rabbi yose omer battehora hammayim tehorim. disvira leh lerabbi yose sheen hattahor litruma metamme et me chattat. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Shehichnis rosho verubbo letoch me chattat. rabbanan gazru tuma al habba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin, kamforash perek kamma deshabbat, vehu mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo vayyom, ume chattat mayim sheuvin ninhu, hilkach keshehichnis rosho verubbo vahem nitma, umishshennitma veeno tahor leme chattat, chozrim me chattat umetammeim oto venaase rishon letuma, sheen me chattat metammeim et hattahor lahem, aval kesheeno tahor lahem metammeim oto:

Karshine teruma. baaravi korin lah karsena. vehem maachol laggemallim veen bene adam ochlin mehem ella middochak bishnot reavon. umafrishin mehem teruma, hoil veneechalim laadam lifrakim al yede haddechak. veenah kedosha kishar terumot:
Shorin. otan bemayim:
Veshafin. al (besaran) [habbasar]: betohora betohora.
Bintilat yadayim. kedin kol shear ochalim shel teruma. shessetam yadayim sheniyyot hen ufoslot et hatteruma:
Umaachilin. labbehema:
Betuma. veeno choshesh im metamme otan bayyadayim beshaa shemmaachilan labbehema. aval kol zeman sheeno maachilan labbehema, asur letammean bayyadayim:

Shorin betohora. sheshsheriyyatan bammayim machshiratan lekabbel tuma, veim shore otan betuma nimtza hechsheran vetumatan baim keechad. veze bilvad osrim bet hillel, mishshum hekker kede sheyyedu shehen teruma:

Yeachlu tzarid. leshon yovesh. kemo tzarid shel menachot, shehu makom shel menachot shello higgia sham shemen. af kan yeachlu yeveshim shello yehe alehen mashke bishat achila, kede shello yihye nikkar shehuchsheru lekabbel tuma:
Kol maasehem betuma. vaafillu hashsheriyya. vahalacha kevet hillel:
Menaggevo. kede shello yitarvu mayim hakkesherim bappesulim:
Af al pi shenniggevo pasul. veaf al pi shello nitma, mishshehuchshar lekabbel tuma pasul:
Likketo lechattat. lehazzot bo me chattat:
Kimlukkat leetzim. umenaggevo vehu chasher. vechen halacha:

rashi: Lo Adonai shelachani. ella ani asiti hakkol middati, uvedin hu cholek alay:
Nasu lekolam. bishvil hakkol hayyotze al beliatan:
Vayrakkeum. aytyndrysh belaaz:

Zot asu kechu lachem machtot. ma raa lomar lahem kach? amar lahem, bedarche haggoyim yesh nimusim harbe vechumarim harbe vechulam (en) mitkabbetzim bevayit echad, anu en lanu ella Adonai echad, aron echad, vetora achat umizbeach echad vechohen gadol echad, veattem rn ish mevakkeshim kehunna gedola, af ani rotze vechach, he lachem tashmish chaviv mikkol, hi hakketoret hachaviva mikkol hakkorbanot, vesam hammavet nittan betocho, shebbo nisrefu nadav vaavihu, lefichach hitra vahem vahih haish ashar yabachar Adonai hu hakadash — kevar hu vikdushato, vechi en anu yodeim shemmi sheyyivchar hu hakkadosh? ella amar lahem moshe, hareni omer lachem, shello titchayyevu, mi sheyyivchar vo yetze chay vechullechem ovedin (tanchuma):
Machtot. kelim shechotin bahem gechalim veyesh lahem bet yad:

Rav lachem bene levi. davar gadol amarti lachem; velo tippeshim hayu, shekkach hitra vahem vekibbelu alehem lekarev? hem chateu al nafshotam, shenneemar "et machtot hachattaim haelle benafshotam" (Bamidbar 17:3), vekorach sheppikkeach haya ma raa lishtut ze? eno hitattu, raa shalshelet gedola yotzea mimmennu — shemuel sheshakul keneged moshe veaharon — amar bishvilo ani nimlat, vechd mishmarot omedot livne vanav, kullam mitnabbeim beruach hakkodesh, shenneemar "kol elle vanim leheman" (Divrei Hayamim 1 25 5), amar efshar kol haggedulla hazzot atida laamod mimmenni vaani eddom? lechach nishtattef lavo leotah chazaka, sheshama mippi moshe shekkullam ovedim veechad nimlat, "asher yivchar Adonai hu hakkadosh" — taa vetala veatzmo, velo raa yafe, lefi shebbanav asu teshuva, umoshe haya roe. — tanchuma:
Rav lachem. davar gadol netaltem beatzmechem lachalok al hakkabbah:

Vayyomer moshe el korach shimu na bene levi. hitchil ledabber immo bidvarim rakkim, kevan sheraahu keshe oref, amar ad shello yishtattefu shear hashevatim veyovdu immo, adabber gam el kullam, hitchil lezarez bahem "shimu na bene levi" (tanchuma):
Velaamod lifne haeda. lashir al hadduchan:
Shuva Adonai. mecharon appecha:
Vehinnachem. chashov machashava tova al avadecha:
targum: Tuv Adonai ad ematay tesagfinana vetuv min bishetta di maleletta lemebad leavdach:

rashi: Sabbeenu vabboker chasdecha. beyom haggeulla vehatteshua, shehu boker lelel hatztzara vehaanacha vehachashecha:
Unerannena venismecha bechol yamenu. kelomar bechol hatztzarot sheaveru alenu beyamenu elle:
targum: Sabba yatana lealma dimtil letzafra tuvach uneranen venechde bechulehon yomana:

rashi: Sammechenu kimot innitanu. sammechenu limot meshichenu keminyan yamot sheinnitanu baggaluyyot, ucheminyan shenot asher rainu raa:
targum: Samach yatana hech yomin desagiftana hech shenaya dachamena bishetta:
Yitchame leavdach ovade nisach veshivhorach al benehon:

rashi: Vihi noam ado' elohenu. shechinato vetanchumav:
Umaase yadenu konena alenu. leshon techinna hu, konena kemo "shomra" (Tehillim 25:20) "shofta" (Tehillim 82:8):

Konenehu. konen oto, ushene peamim umaase yadenu konenehu: echad al melechet hammishkan, shebberechan leyisrael vehitpallel shettishre shechina bemaase yedehem bammishkan, veachat shettehe beracha bemaase yedehem:
targum: Vihe vesimuta degan eden min kodam Adonai alana veovade yedena mineh yittaknun:

rashi: Betoch mattotam. hinnich baemtza, shello yomru, mippene shehinnicho vetzad shechina parach (tanchuma achare mot):
Lemishmeret leot. lezikkaron shebbacharti beaharon lechohen velo yillonu od al hakkehunna:

Utechal telunnotam. kemo utechalle telunnotam; lashon ze shem mifal yachid leshon nekeva, kemo telunnatam, mrmvrysh balaz; veyesh chilluk ben telunnotam litlunnatam, telunnatam telunna achat, telunnotam shem davar bilshon yachid vaafillu hem telunnot harbe:
Vegam achecha. bene gereshon uvene merari:
Veyillavu. veyitchabberu alechem, lehazhir gam et hazzarim millikrav alehem:
Vishortucha. bishmirat hashearim ulemannot mehem gizbarin vaamarkalin (sifre):
Vezar lo yikrav alechem. etchem ani mazhir al kach:
Velo yihye od ketzef. kemo shehaya chevar, shenneemar (Bamidbar 17) "ki yatza hakketzef" (sifre):
Lachem mattana netunim. yachol laavodatchem shel hedyot, tal "laAdonai", kemo shemmeforash lemala, lishmor mishmeret gizbarin vaamarkalin:
Avodat mattana. bemattana netattiha lachem:
Min haesh. leachar haktarat haishim:
Kol korbanam. kegon zivche shalme tzibbur:
Minchatam chattatam vashamatam. kemashmao:
Asher yashivu li. ze gezel hagger (Sham; Zevachim 44):
Bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu vegomer'. limmed al kodshe kodashim sheen neechalin ella baazara lezichre chehunna:
Terumat mattanam. hammuram min hattoda umehashelamim umeel nazir:
Lechol tenufot. shehare ellu teunin tenufa:
Kol tahor. velo temeim; daa: kol tahor lerabbot ishto:
Reshitam. hi teruma gedola:
Kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin. shel shelamim shenneechalin lakkohanim velinshehem livnehem uleavdehem lishne yamim velayla echad, af habbechor neechal lishne yamim velayla echad:
Lach yihye. ba rabbi akiva velimmed, vehosif lecha hakkatuv havaya acheret, shelo tomar, kechaze veshok shel toda sheeno neechal ella leyom valayla (Zevachim 57):
Kol terumot hakkodashim. mechibbatah shel parasha zo kelalah battechilla uchelalah bassof ufarat baemtza (80' Sifre):
Berit melach olam. karat berit im aharon bedavar habbari umitkayyem umavri et acherim (sham):
Berit melach. kabberit hakkeruta lammelach sheeno masriach leolam:
Vehem. halviyyim — yisu avonam shel yisrael, shealehem lehazhir hazzarim miggeshet alehem:
Venechshav lachem terumatchem kaddagan min haggoren. terumat maaser shellachem asura lezarim velitmein, vechayyavin aleha mita vechomesh kitruma gedola shennikret reshit dagan min haggoren:
Vechamlea min hayyakev. terumat tirosh veyitzhar hannittelet min haykavim:
Malah. leshon bishul — tevua shennitmallet:
Yakab. hu habbor shellifne haggat shehayyayin yored letocho, vechol leshon yekev chafirat karka hu, vechen "yikve hammelech" (Zecharya 14), hu yam okeyanos, chafira shechafar malko shel olam:
Ken tarimu gam attem. kemo sheyyisrael merimim miggornam umiyyikvehem, tarimu gam attem mimmaaser shellachem, ki hu nachalatchem:

Mikkol mattenotechem tarimu et kol terumat Adonai. bitruma gedola hakkatuv medabber, sheim hikdim levi et hakkohen bakkeri vekibbel maserotav kodem sheyyittol kohen teruma gedola min hakkeri, tzarich lehafrish hallevi min hammaaser techilla echad mechamishim litruma gedola, veyachazor veyafrish terumat maaser (sifre):
Baharimechem et chelbo mimmennu. leachar shettarimu terumat maaser mimmennu:
Venechshav hammotar lalviyyim chullin gemurin:

Kitvuat goren lisharal, shello tomar hoil ukerao hakkatuv teruma — shenneemar "ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai teruma" — yachol yehe chullo asur, tal "venechshav lalviyyim kitvuat goren", ma shel yisrael chullin, af shel levi chullin (80' Sifre):
Velo tisu alav chete vegomer'. ha im lo tarimu tisu chete:
Velo tamutu. ha im techallelu tamutu:

Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Holiness 10:11-: And concerning the punishment of one who blemishes the breath emerging from his mouth, it shall be explained to you by what is explained in the Zohar (Parashat Beshalach, page 59a), concerning (Ecclesiastes 1:14), "all is vanity [hevel] and vexation of spirit" - it says there that it cannot be said that this "hevel" mentioned in the verse refers to something in Atzilut, in the secret of the seven "hevels" [breaths] above in Atzilut, called "the utterance of the mouth of the LORD," as explained in the Zohar (Parashat Tazria, page 47b) - for if it were there, it would not be "vexation of spirit," but rather it is explained to be in the external forces - and he says, in these words: come and see, at the time deeds are made fit below, and a person considers the service of the holy King, that matter he does becomes a "hevel" [breath] from it above, and there is no "hevel" that does not have a voice that ascends and is crowned above and becomes an advocate before the Holy One, blessed be He. But all those deeds a person engages in that are not the service of the Holy One, blessed be He, that matter he does becomes a "hevel" that goes and roams the world, and when a person's soul departs, that "hevel" rolls him about in the world like a stone in a sling, as it is written (1 Samuel 25:29), "and the soul of your enemies He shall sling out from the hollow of the sling" - who slings it out? That "hevel" that leads him about the world. Then all matters done, which are under the sun, that are not the service of the Holy One, blessed be He, a "hevel" is made from them - "hevel" is the breaking of spirit that breaks the spirit and ascends and descends in the world - this is what is written (Ecclesiastes 1:14), "vanity and vexation of spirit." But that matter which is the service of his Master, this is called "above the sun," and a holy "hevel" is made from it, and this is the seed a person sows in that world, and its name is charity, as it is written (Hosea 10:12), "sow for yourselves according to charity" - this leads the person, when his soul departs from him, and raises it up, to be found in the place of glory above, to be bound in the bundle of life - this is what is written (Isaiah 58:8), "and your charity shall go before you" - to lead you, to raise you from place to place, as it is written, "the glory of the LORD shall gather you" - to this point.

Behold, it is explained in this teaching that every unfitting deed becomes a "hevel" [breath] that clothes the soul and slings it in the hollow of the sling, and it is "vexation of spirit" - and this is what he was precise about in saying, "who slings it, that 'hevel' that leads him about the world" - and in saying "about the world," he alludes to the secret of this matter alluded to. And all the more so when the breath emerging from his mouth is in vain, in falsehood, and the like, going to the place of this evil "hevel," which is "vexation of spirit," and a garment is made from it to clothe his spirit, to sling it within the hollow of the sling.

And in the Tikkunim (page 117b) Rashbi explained the secret of the "hevels" [breaths] on the side of holiness and the "hevels" on the side of the husk - he says there that there is a good "hevel" and an evil "hevel." The "hevel" of Torah is a flame [lahav], of which it is said (Psalms 29:7), "the voice of the LORD hews flames of fire," and this "hevel" is on the right side, comprising seven "hevels" corresponding to the seven names in the Name of forty-two, Alef-Bet-Gimel Yud-Tav-Tzadi, and so on - and he says, six ascend, which are flames, in the six rings of the windpipe, and the seventh "hevel" is of the mouth - and corresponding to them David said, seven voices, "give to the LORD, O sons of the mighty" (Psalms 29:1) - and concerning these seven it is said (Deuteronomy 8:3), "for man does not live by bread alone, but by every utterance of the mouth of the LORD does man live" - and these seven voices ascend in seven firmaments. And there are seven on the left that descend into seven lands, and of them Kohelet says (Ecclesiastes 3:21), "for who knows the spirit of the sons of man, whether it goes upward," and so on (the explanation refers to the end of the verse, "and the spirit of the beast, whether it goes downward to the earth"). Seven good "hevels," these are the seven days of the week corresponding to them, and others correspond to the seven years of famine - these are the "hevels" of life and these are the "hevels" of death, and therefore there is "hevel" [singular] and there are "hevels" [plural] - to this point.

And he says further there, the "hevels" of the Other Side, of them it is said (Jeremiah 10:15), "they are vanity, a work of delusion" - for those "hevels" ascend through vulgar speech and falsehoods, and they all ascend to the brain - there is a sun, moon, stars, and constellations in the firmaments that are the husks, of which it is said (Isaiah 5:18), "woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood," and of them it is said (ibid. 51:6), "for the heavens shall vanish like smoke," "the moon shall be ashamed and the sun confounded" (ibid. 24:23), and they have many "hevels," all full of falsehood and vanity - and whoever utters false words, how many destroying angels open their wings to receive them - this is what is written (Ecclesiastes 10:20), "for a bird of the heavens shall carry the voice" - and these utterances are the sons of several buildings - to this point.

Behold, it is explained in these teachings the difference between the holy "hevel" from the occupation with Torah and the like, and the unholy "hevel," for the unholy "hevel" ascends to the husk and builds vain buildings - "vanity, a work of delusion" - as explained.

The general rule is that as a person builds in this world, there his soul ascends after his death, as explained in the teaching from Parashat Beshalach that we copied - unless he repents fully and strongly, to nullify all those firmaments and lands he built on the side of the husk.

And so he says further there in the Tikkunim (page 118a), that all the "hevels" of prayers ascend and bind to the holy "hevel," which is the Shechinah, and there is a "hevel" of idle words, and it is in the husk - in these words, in brief: there is "hevel" of which it is said (Genesis 4:2), "his brother, Hevel [Abel]," and there is "hevel" in prayers and good service, and there is "hevel" of idle words, empty words, of which it is said, "vanity, a work of delusion," and so on - to this point.

And further there he explains that between these two "hevels" there is a middle "hevel," which is neither holy nor impure, but rather ordinary conversation, which is the need to use the matters of this world - concerning this we say, "who separates between holy and profane," and concerning the external "hevel" we say, "and between Israel and the other nations."

Now, when a person considers what we wrote above, that a person is obligated to sanctify his limbs because in every single limb of his the Name YHVH is found, and in sanctifying that limb he sanctifies the Name - all the more so is he obligated to sanctify his mouth, in which the Name YHVH is found in several aspects, whether in the limbs that produce speech, and the five points of articulation participate in producing speech, and it is necessary that the Name YHVH be in each and every one, since they are distinct organs - throat, palate, tongue, teeth, lips - or in the aspect of voice and speech itself, in which the Name YHVH is found, as explained above. And so it is fitting that he consider that in prayer he utters several mentions [of the divine Name] from his mouth, whether in psalms or in blessings, and therefore it is fitting to sanctify his mouth, so that the Name YHVH not go out through a blemished mouth.

And in the Tikkunim (page 132a) it says, in these words: a crooked mouth - the Holy One, blessed be He, does not rest in it, for it is a blemish; all the more so its crooked speech, of which it is said (Ecclesiastes 1:15), "what is crooked cannot be made straight." Mouth and heart correspond to the Written Torah and the Oral Torah - voice and speech that emerge from both are Vav-Heh, which must be brought forth in the fear and love of Yud-Heh, and if not, YHVH does not rest there - to this point. And what he says, "mouth and heart correspond to Torah," the intent is that the heart is the Written Torah and the mouth corresponds to the Oral Torah - for just as the mouth reveals what is hidden in the heart, so the Oral Torah reveals what is concealed in the Written Torah. And the intent of this is to teach us that his mouth and his heart should be equal, and through this he unifies - but if he speaks one thing with his mouth and another with his heart, he separates and "cuts the shoots."

And from the sum of the teaching it is understood that wherever there is a blemish in his mouth or his speech, the Name YHVH does not rest there, and he shall be obligated to come into transmigration (according to what our Rabbis, of blessed memory, taught us, as mentioned above) to repair what he twisted. And just as the punishment is great, so the reward of one who sanctifies his mouth is great, for he sanctifies the Shechinah, called "mouth," and therefore he merits the holy spirit, as we explained above.

And concerning profane speech, our Rabbis, of blessed memory, warned us in the Mishnah, saying (Avot, chapter 1, mishnah 17), "I have found nothing better for the body than silence" - and "for the body" is explained as, for the affairs of the body, as they said, of blessed memory, in Chullin (89a), on the verse (Psalms 58:2), "do you indeed speak righteousness in silence [elem]," in these words: Rabbi Yitzchak said, what is the meaning of "do you indeed speak righteousness in silence, do you judge uprightly, O sons of men"? What is a person's craft in this world? Let him make himself as one silent [as an "elem"]. One might think even concerning words of Torah - therefore Scripture says, "speak righteousness." One might think he should be arrogant - therefore Scripture says, "judge uprightly, O sons of men" - to this point, their wording.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Holiness 10:23-: And so King Solomon, peace be upon him, warned us concerning this and said (Ecclesiastes 5:1), "do not be rash with your mouth, and let not your heart be hasty to utter a word before God, for God is in heaven and you are on earth, therefore let your words be few." And it must be examined how it gives the reason for words being few as being that "God is in heaven and you are on earth" - for on the contrary, this indicates the removal of providence, and it should rather have said words indicating providence - "for God is in heaven and on earth" - along the lines of (Psalms 113:6), "who humbles Himself to behold the things that are in heaven and on earth." And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, explained in the Sifrei (Ha'azinu 4): Solomon said, if even the weakest of the weak above overcomes the mighty, when he is below and He above, all the more so is He the mightiest of the mighty - and so it says (Deuteronomy 32:6), "do you thus repay the LORD" - to this point, their wording.

However, what appears to us in explaining this verse - even if it be lengthy - because of the great benefit reaching the tongue from it, we shall not be concerned about length. It is this: one must examine precisely the words "al tevahel al picha" - it should have said "al tevahel picha" or "et picha" - what is the "al" [upon/about]?

Rather, the matter is that the mouth comprises the five points of articulation of the letters, and so it is explained in the Tikkunim (page 132a), in these words: there are five repairs in the mouth, of which it is said in Sefer Yetzirah, Alef-Chet-Heh-Ayin, Bet-Vav-Mem-Peh, Gimel-Yud-Chaf-Kuf, Dalet-Tet-Lamed-Nun-Tav, Zayin-Samech-Shin-Resh-Tzadi - and through them complete stones shall be built for the Holy One, blessed be He, in several prayers and services, and concerning them Jacob said (Genesis 28:11), "and he lay down in that place [vayishkav bamakom hahu]" - "vayishkav" is "Vav-Yud-Shin-Kaf-Bet" [could be parsed as] "Yesh-Kaf-Bet" [Yud-Shin, Kaf-Bet], "in that place" - "Yesh" - "to cause those who love Me to inherit substance [yesh]" (Proverbs 8:21); "Kaf-Bet" - "in you [bekha] shall Israel bless" (Genesis 48:20) - to this point.

And in Sefer Yetzirah (chapter 2, mishnah 6) it says that the Holy One, blessed be He, fixed in our mouth twenty-two letters at five points of articulation - twenty-two foundation letters, engraved in voice, hewn in breath, fixed in the mouth at five places: Alef-Chet-Heh-Ayin, Bet-Vav-Mem-Peh, Dalet-Tet-Lamed-Nun-Tav, Zayin-Samech-Tzadi-Resh-Shin, Gimel-Yud-Chaf-Kuf. And my teacher, peace be upon him, explained that the word "fixed in the mouth," said there, teaches us a great matter - namely, that the reality of the five points of articulation is rooted very high, in the head, and they are the root of all existing things, as explained in the Idra - however, they descend and are revealed from world to world in the aspects of Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, Asiyah, and the Holy One, blessed be He, out of His love for man, fixed these letters in his mouth so that he might be able to cleave to his Creator - for in mentioning these letters below, in his Torah or his prayer, he shakes and arouses above the supernal roots - and this is the word "fixed" [kava], which is like one who fastens a chain, one end in one place and its other end in another place - for even if that place is distant, when a person shakes the end of the chain in his hand, he shakes the whole chain, however large it may be. And so he also says at the end of Sefer Yetzirah (chapter 6, mishnah 8), "he bound the twenty-two letters on his tongue, and the Omnipresent revealed to him His secret" - and the word "bound" [kesher] also indicates what is being expounded in the word "kava" [fixed].

And through this we shall understand the virtue of the early ones, peace be upon them, whose prayer was answered immediately, because they were careful not to blemish the twenty-two letters, which are the five points of articulation fixed in their mouths, with idle talk and the other things that blemish the tongue - therefore their prayer would split the firmaments and ascend higher and higher to arouse mercy - and so it says in the Zohar (Parashat Shemot, page 14b) that at the time Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, peace be upon him, was occupied with Torah, several thousands and tens of thousands of ministering angels would hear his voice - and the reason is that because the points of articulation emerging from their mouths were pure, they would bind and unify all the worlds, for the voice and speech emerging from their mouths would become satisfaction above.
